descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapid growth of AWS business and customers 24x7. We commit to maintain the critical facility infrastructure of AWS and ensure the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency and cost. The DCEO Team is seeking individuals who are motivated, self-starters, eager to learn, passionate and committed to join us. As part of the Infrastructure Operations Team, you will have the chance to work on the most advanced technologies in a dynamic environment. If you enjoy working in a strong, close-knit and diverse team, Infrastructure Operations Team is the place to be!


Key job responsibilities
- Rotating shift work is required to maintain 24/7 operations coverage
- Monitor and operate electrical and mechanical equipment in the data center
- Perform routine rounds and record daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment (e.g. temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.).
- Respond to emergencies and perform troubleshooting to resolve facility equipment issues.
- Arrange and supervise contractors and vendors to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment, and follow up on maintenance records accordingly
- Participate in emergency drills and support facility emergency response per established protocols
- Participate in the on-call rotation and report to site for emergencies as required

主要職責：
- 需輪班工作以維持24/7的運作
- 監控及操作數據中心內的電氣與機械設備
- 進行每日例行巡檢，記錄所有機械及電氣設備的運行數據（如溫度、電壓、電流等）
- 響應緊急事件，並進行故障排除以解決設施設備問題
- 安排及監督承辦商和供應商，確保所有設施設備的正常運作及維護，並相應跟進維護記錄
- 參與緊急演習，並按既定程序支援設施緊急應變
- 參與待命輪值，並按需到場處理緊急事件


A day in the life
Also expected from the EOT is the ability to execute small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve moderate amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in controlled environments. The EOT will be tasked with creating and delivering key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results. The goals of such projects are to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- A Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline is typically required
- 具備電氣/機械/屋宇設備工程或相關學科的文憑
- 2+ years of electrical or mechanical practical and technical experience
- 2年或以上機電或冷氣系統及樓宇設備相關之經驗
- A valid Registered Electrical Worker (REW) Certificate, Grade A or above
- 持有機電署註冊電業工程人員牌照(A0或以上)
- A valid Construction Industry Safety Training Certificate (Green Card) and a Construction Workers Registration Card are required.
- 持有效建造業安全訓練證書（綠卡）及建造業工人註冊證
- Work on a rotating shift to maintain 24/7 operations coverage.
- 需輪班工作以維持24/7的運作
- Basic knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems and equipment, including their operation and maintenance
- 具備電氣及機械系統與設備的基本知識，包括其操作及維護
- Basic knowledge of BMS and EPMS control systems
- 具備樓宇管理系統（BMS）及電力監控系統（EPMS）基本知識
- Basic proficiency in computer applications, including Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Word, Excel, Outlook).
- 基本電腦知識及操作，例如 Microsoft Office （ Word、Excel、Outlook）
- Basic English proficiency in spoken and written communication.
- 具備基本英語口語及書寫能力

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of electrical or mechanical practical and technical experience
- 5年或以上機電或冷氣系統及樓宇設備相關之經驗
- Higher Diploma or bachelor’s degree in electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related discipline
- 具備電氣、機械、屋宇設備工程或相關學科的高級文憑或學士學位
- A valid Registered Electrical Worker (REW) Certificate, Grade B or above
- 持有機電署註冊電業工程人員牌照(B0或以上)
- Advanced knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems and equipment, including their operation and maintenance
- 具備電氣及機械系統與設備的進階知識，包括其操作及維護
- Advanced knowledge of BMS and EPMS control systems
- 具備樓宇管理系統（BMS）及電力監控系統（EPMS）進階知識

title: Architecte Solutions, Verticale Manufacturing, AWS France
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons des Architectes Solutions pour accompagner les clients français d’Amazon Web Services (AWS). Alliant connaissance métier, compréhension technique, et capacités relationnelles, vous participerez à la conception d’architectures cloud aidant les clients à innover. Devenir Architecte Solutions, c’est accéder au meilleur de la technologie, rejoindre une équipe soudée, travailler au succès des entreprises françaises et développer sa carrière dans un contexte où l'intelligence artificielle redéfinit les possibilités des entreprises et de leur transformation numérique.

Nous cherchons des bâtisseuses et bâtisseurs venant de tous horizons. Les qualités principales recherchées sont la curiosité, l’envie d’apprendre, le travail en équipe, et le goût de la relation client. Les Architectes Solutions viennent de nombreux domaines et types d’entreprises. L’étendue des missions et des opportunités proposées permet à différents profils d’utiliser leurs forces et de bénéficier des ressources mises à disposition pour développer d’autres domaines de compétence.

Key job responsibilities
Ce poste est au sein de l’organisation française AWS, et se concentre sur les clients grands comptes AWS en France.

Auprès des clients, vous :
- Établissez un réseau de contacts pour les accompagner efficacement et les rendre autonomes
- Animez des sessions d’échange sur les meilleures pratiques
- Facilitez des ateliers et des revues d’architecture

- Construisez avec les équipes du client : prototypes, preuves de concept et co-développement dans leurs environnements, pour passer de la théorie à la démonstration ("Show, don’t tell")
- Accompagnez l’ensemble des phases des projets, de la conception à l’opération
- Guidez la montée en compétence, sur le plan technologique, gouvernance


Au sein d’AWS, vous :
- Contribuez, au sein de l’équipe de compte, à la définition de la stratégie commerciale et technologique
- Assurez la coordination entre les différentes équipes AWS pour représenter au mieux les intérêts de vos clients
- Partagez votre expérience dans les communautés sur les domaines technologiques ou industriels
- Participez à des programmes internes sur des sujets technologiques, organisationnels, de recrutement

Au sein des communautés externes, vous :
- Présentez votre expérience, les enjeux et les solutions appropriées dans des présentations ou des vidéos
- Contribuez à la création de contenus tels que des billets de blog, des livres-blancs, des articles
- Participez aux programmes AWS auprès des communautés et des clients

A day in the life
Vous aidez vos clients à être compétitifs, sécurisés, et durables. Membre d’une équipe de compte, composée de profils métiers, commerciaux, consultants ou support, votre mission est d’établir un lien de confiance technologique avec vos clients. Vous travaillez à tout niveau de l’organisation, dont équipes de direction. Vous analysez les besoins et opportunités, et accompagnez vos clients sur l’utilisation optimale des technologies cloud. Selon le contexte, vous ne vous limitez pas au conseil : vous construisez aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie du client, dans des cycles courts et cadrés, pour démontrer la proposition de valeur. Vous aidez les équipes AWS à comprendre les besoins de vos clients et à les intégrer dans leurs plans. Vous partagez votre expérience avec d’autres équipes dans le monde entier et êtes actifs dans la communauté publique AWS.

En tant qu'Architecte Solutions chez AWS, vous agissez pour la révolution de l'intelligence artificielle. Vous concevez les architectures cloud qui permettront à nos clients d'exploiter les dernières innovations de l'IA générative et agentique, et vous aiderez les entreprises françaises à tirer le meilleur parti des capacités de l'IA dans leurs activités. Cette position vous offrira l'opportunité de développer une expertise pointue, de créer des architectures et solutions de référence, et de jouer un rôle déterminant dans la transformation numérique de nos clients.

About the team
Depuis plus de 10 ans, AWS investit localement pour aider à la transformation numérique en France, à travers des infrastructures techniques et des équipes d’accompagnement client. Avec une attention constante sur l’apprentissage, l’excellence opérationnelle et le partage, nous travaillons quotidiennement avec nos clients. Des sociétés du CAC 40 aux nouveaux fleurons de l’industrie et de la French Tech, ainsi que les acteurs internationaux innovants, AWS est le moteur des entreprises accompagnant les Français à chaque instant.

Basic qualifications

- Capacité à communiquer efficacement dans des contextes divers et à différents niveaux, à orchestrer des équipes et travailler efficacement en interne et externe
- Expérience professionnelle dans ou avec des organisations importantes, en implémentation ou gestion de projets IT complexes
- Expérience en infrastructure informatique, opération système, ou développement
- Capacité à apprendre et appliquer de nouvelles technologies rapidement
- Français courant pour les interactions client, anglais professionnel (parlé, écrit) pour les échanges internes

Preferred qualifications

- Formation technique : Informatique, Ingénierie, Mathématiques ou équivalent
- Connaissance ou expérience de migration ou transformation vers le cloud AWS et/ou des offres Cloud Public ou Hybride, en entreprise
- Goût et pratique de la construction hands-on (prototypes/POCs), y compris avec des outils de développement agentique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Referent Brandschutz (m/w/d), RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineer) Erfurt
descriptionHtml:
Diese Position ist für unser Fulfillment Center in ERF1. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Position Schichtarbeit erfordert.

Wir sind Pioniere.

Ein Tag, um den ersten Schritt zu tun. Ein Tag, um sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen. Und heute könnte der Tag sein, an dem Sie selbst Teil einer großen Idee werden. Ein Tag, an dem Sie Ihre eigenen Ideen verwirklichen können. Kommen Sie zu einem Unternehmen, das sich jeden Tag neu erfindet. Bei Amazon zu arbeiten, ist immer wieder aufregend.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Erfurt suchen wir einen

Referenten (m/w/d) für den Bereich technischer und organisatorischer Brandschutz.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die konstante Betriebsbereitschaft und ordnungsgemäße Funktion der vorhandenen Brandmelde- und Löschanlagen sowie weiterer Brandschutzeinrichtungen. Sie sind zuständig für die Durchführung regelmäßiger Instandhaltungen sowie die Umsetzung technischer Projekte, wobei ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative erwartet wird.

WIR BIETEN:

Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance, an verschiedenen Schulungen und Seminaren teilzunehmen, die von Amazon und externen Partnern angeboten werden.
Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit beschränkten Mitarbeiteraktien (Restricted Stock Units der Amazon.com, Inc.) und Mitarbeiterrabatt.
Zusätzliche Leistungen wie z. B. Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie eine Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Mütter sowie Eltern in Elternzeit).
Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für die Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten.
Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und unser Tandemprogramm helfen dir, Kontakte zu knüpfen und ein internes Netzwerk aufzubauen.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der konstanten Betriebsbereitschaft der Brandschutzsysteme
- Durchführung von Schalthandlungen an der Brandmeldeanlage
- Dokumentation und Planung der wöchentlichen Sprinklerprüfung
- Organisation der gesetzlichen Sachverständigenprüfung
- Erstellung von Fehleranalysen an den Brandschutzüberwachungssystemen
- Kontrolle von Bussystemen und Kommunikationsschnittstellen
- Ausführung und Kontrolle von Bestellvorgängen für die technische Abteilung
- Betreuung von Gewerken und externen Firmen
- Koordination abteilungsübergreifender Tätigkeiten
- Mitarbeit an der Ausarbeitung und Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie Modernisierungen

A day in the life
Ihr Tag beginnt mit dem Blick auf den Status der Brandmelde- und Löschanlagen – Sie prüfen Meldungen, werten die Überwachungssysteme aus und stellen sicher, dass alle Brandschutzeinrichtungen einsatzbereit sind. Sie führen Schalthandlungen an der Brandmeldeanlage durch, dokumentieren die wöchentliche Sprinklerprüfung, organisieren Sachverständigenprüfungen und stimmen sich mit externen Gewerken sowie anderen Abteilungen ab. Treten Störungen auf, gehen Sie ihnen mit gezielten Fehleranalysen auf den Grund. Daneben bringen Sie sich in technische Projekte und Modernisierungen ein und tragen so dazu bei, die Sicherheit an unserem Standort langfristig zu stärken. Im Rahmen der Rufbereitschaft sind Sie zudem ein wichtiger Ansprechpartner, wenn es außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeit darauf ankommt.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Mechanik, Elektromechanik, Mechatronik, Elektrik oder eine berufliche Ausbildung im Bereich Werk-/Berufsfeuerwehren sowie artverwandte Ausbildungen in technischen Bereichen
- Mindestens zweijährige Erfahrung im Umgang mit Brandmeldesystemen
- Selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
- Teamfähigkeit
- Englischkenntnisse
- Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
- Teilnahme an der Rufbereitschaft

Preferred qualifications

- Brandschutzbeauftragter
- Fachkraft für Brandmeldeanlagen
- Fachkraft für Wasserlöschanlagen
- Weiterbildung mit Abschluss als Meister oder Techniker in der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau
- Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen im Bereich Gebäude-, Brandmelde-, Sprinkler-, Sicherheits- und Gebäudeleittechnik

Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Software Development Engineer II, EU INTech - Prime and Marketing Tech
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to shape how millions of EU customers discover and engage with Prime — both on Amazon and across the digital landscape? EU Prime Marketing & Incentives Tech is seeking a Software Development Engineer II to build scalable and robust systems at the intersection of generative AI, personalization, and large-scale distributed architecture. You'll leverage GenAI and ML technologies to power Prime customer engagement across marketing channels — from social media platforms to emerging digital channels.

This role offers the unique opportunity to start with EU-scale challenges while building solutions for worldwide impact. You'll architect cloud-native systems on AWS that drive how Prime reaches customers wherever they are, combining serverless, event-driven, and microservices patterns with AI-driven innovation. Bring your ownership mindset and passion for end-to-end delivery as you translate ML models into production systems that enhance customer experiences at massive scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable, cloud-native distributed systems using serverless architectures, event-driven patterns, and microservices on AWS to support EU Prime customer engagement across marketing channels
- Collaborate with data scientists and product teams to integrate GenAI/LLM technologies and ML pipelines into production systems that drive personalized customer experiences at scale
- Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle including code reviews, architecture reviews, testing, deployment, and operational excellence activities while mentoring team members on high-quality engineering practices
- Drive technical decisions and design solutions for ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives that balance new feature development with system reliability, performance optimization, and maintainability
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving team operations, documentation, and processes to reduce single-threaded dependencies and build team resilience

A day in the life
You'll design and ship features that leverage GenAI-powered services and modern AWS architectures, collaborating closely with scientists to translate ML models into reliable production systems. Your day balances building innovative capabilities with maintaining operational excellence — participating in architecture and code reviews, using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, and ensuring systems perform reliably at scale. You'll work across teams to shape technical direction while staying current with emerging technologies like GenAI and ML to solve real customer problems.

About the team
EU Prime Marketing & Incentives Tech builds the technology powering Prime customer engagement across marketing channels. Our scope spans personalized onsite experiences to large-scale marketing integrations — including social media platforms, YouTube, and emerging digital channels — driving Prime acquisition, retention, and engagement for millions of EU customers. We're a collaborative team that values deep technical ownership and continuous learning, embracing GenAI and modern engineering practices to solve complex challenges at the intersection of marketing technology, audience targeting, and multi-channel content delivery. Every engineer has autonomy to shape how Prime reaches customers wherever they are — on Amazon and beyond.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: AWS Senior Financial Analyst, AWS Central FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) seeks a Senior Financial Analyst to join the Central FP&A team. The successful candidate will provide cross functional leadership across multiple teams and initiatives, and drive the overall Income statement reporting. This high visibility role will drive strategic initiatives to improve the quality and timelines of business insights provided to AWS and Amazon leadership, including ongoing efforts around existing process improvements.

We are looking for a consummate Finance leader who can thrive in a fast-paced, highly ambiguous environment, and who exercises high standards and good judgment. The successful candidate has strong leadership skills and business acumen and is comfortable at influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.


Key job responsibilities
- Liaise across the AWS finance community to drive core financial processes including annual operating plans, monthly/quarterly business reviews and assessment of risks/opportunities, and month-end close.
- Collaborate with teams to simplify, standardize, and automate reporting processes and analytics.
- Leverage AI tooling to drive automation of financial modeling for headcount and headcount cost forecasting to improve accuracy and agility of planning.
- Ensure compliance with finance and accounting controls and systems.
- Lead and manage special projects, working cross-functionally with various AWS finance and business teams.
- Foster constructive and proactive communication across organizational boundaries.



About the team
This role is part of the AWS Central FP&A team. We centrally manage AWS headcount and headcount cost modeling to support AWS senior leaders and finance teams. We also coordinate and consolidate deliverables and establish financial controls and mechanisms by building tools that improve the speed of decision making, and providing insightful financial analysis on the short and long term strategy of AWS.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field, or Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Program Specialist, Amazon Customer Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Network Control Center (NCC) owns real-time observability, situational awareness, and coordinated intervention across the network to rapidly detect and eliminate issues before the customer journey is degraded.

The Real-Time Remedies Execution (RTRE) function within NCC acts as the centralized communications liaison between Amazon's Recovery teams, Business teams, and Amazon's customers. The mission is to help prevent contacts to Amazon by executing bulk actions on accounts and communications to customers impacted by large-scale issues. RTRE team is responsible for communicating to millions of D2customers each year across more than 20+ languages and owns all bulk actions such as large-scale physical and digital order refunds, cancellations, and more.

Do you want to join a team focused on critical communication and incident recovery, and play a role in the decision-making processes that restore/retain customer trust? Are you a passionate learner willing to relentlessly Deep Dive into data sets and partner with business analysts, advocates across leadership, and business teams? Do you thrive in a culture where Customer Obsession and the Bias For Action are highly valued?

As a Program Specialist, you will play a key role on the team by managing stakeholders on large-scale customer-impacting issues, owning relationships with partner teams, validating data, investigating customer issues, and driving the communications process from creation to execution. You will also contribute to NCC's broader mission of detecting and resolving incidents before customers are impacted, collaborating across multiple teams within the network. You will be detail oriented and results driven to ensure flawless communication execution as well as ensure the needs of both the customers and the business are addressed. Outside of these day-to-day duties, Program Specialists will own and have to work on process improvements.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own and drive bulk recovery action for D2 customers, including data validation, stakeholder coordination, and flawless execution.
2. Publish customer-facing mass communications, independently assessing situations and advocating for the most customer-centric path forward.
3. Manage high-severity incidents by collaborating cross-functionally to mitigate risks to business, customer experience, and associate experience.
4. Serve as the liaison between business analyst teams, product teams, and recovery stakeholders on complex issues requiring data assistance or tooling alignment.
5. Execute high-impact mitigation actions using various tools while performing quality checks to ensure ideal customer outcomes.
6. Plan, prioritize, and deliver team-related projects, balancing day-to-day operations with longer-term improvement initiatives.
7. Identify process improvement opportunities, propose changes, and amend SOPs once approved.


A day in the life
Our team supports customers impacted by issues with Amazon's first-party products and services (Kindle, Echo, Appstore, Prime Video, etc.). We provide critical communications and take proactive actions to resolve their concerns, reducing the need for customers to contact customer service and improving their overall experience.

The role delivers through the main annual planning cycles (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG), optimizing Amazon's plan of record for non-sort inbound network investments. The Senior PM owns end-to-end planning processes, from establishing non-sort demand forecasts and capacity requirements to identifying solve options and driving execution through Supply Chain and Engineering teams. This requires deep analysis across vendor/seller behavior patterns, non-sort inbound program trends, and seasonal demand patterns to develop risk-aware build plans that address demand uncertainties.

Working closely with Finance, the role defines optimal investment levels through rigorous evaluation of solutions, including new permanent/temporary sites, retrofits, and determining optimal timing and sequencing of network launches. Critical trade-off decisions balance multiple factors:
• Cost/Risk optimization vs. operational flexibility
• Fixed vs. variable capacity investments
• Short-term operational needs vs. long-term network sustainability

The Senior PM leads complex analytical approaches to evaluate planning challenges, particularly around non-sort node optimization (TNS sites, IXD non-sort flows, 3P solutions, and specialty handling requirements). They articulate recommendations to leadership based on comprehensive analysis of economics and operational viability. Key areas include the Non-Sort DNA framework defining optimal network configurations, floor-stack vs. rack storage trade-offs, heavy/bulky item flow optimization, and depalletization strategies for non-sort volumes.

Beyond cyclical planning, this role requires constantly redefining the non-sort network strategy in response to the rapid evolution in the Inbound space. They ensure that developments are captured via continuous improvement in EU-wide planning processes. This requires:
• Creating frameworks to evaluate complex business problems specific to non-sort operations
• Developing innovative solutions leveraging data-driven insights
• Building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
• Driving execution through multiple organizations

Examples include developing the Non-Sort solve strategy, and evolving the EU peak non-sort inbound strategy to strengthen network resilience against demand volatility.

The Senior PM must identify high-impact opportunities across the non-sort network, develop comprehensive solutions considering multiple constraints (vendor/seller behavior, real estate, labor, technology, specialty handling requirements), and drive initiatives through complex organizational structures to successful conclusions. This requires careful balancing of upstream supply chain needs with downstream fulfillment requirements while maintaining focus on long-term network optimization.


Key job responsibilities
The role covers the following responsibility areas:
1. Strategic Network Planning & Architecture
2. Partnership with demand forecasting & capacity solve
3. Annual Planning Cycle Leadership (SPS, OP1, OP2, QxG)
4. Cross-Functional Influence & Stakeholder Management
5. Peak Inbound Strategy & Resilience
6. Leadership Communication & Decision Enablement

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

title: Senior Program Manager, Canada Transportation - NDPE
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's transportation network is a critical driver of the customer experience flywheel, where faster delivery speeds and lower shipping costs attract more customers, generate more volume, and enable continued investment in network expansion. As a Senior Program Manager on the Canada Transportation team, you will be the single point of accountability for Canada's overall Cost to Serve (CtS) owning strategy and execution across last mile, middle mile, air, linehaul, sort center and network design. You will drive LMPP improvement, New facility sort point planning, linehaul capacity planning for events, and end-to-end FC and FDI launches. This is a senior strategic role that blends network design optimization, financial planning ownership, and hands-on execution, requiring you to influence across operations, finance, and planning organizations and drive parity with the best in class in the network.



Key job responsibilities
- Own Canada's overall Cost to Serve as the single point of accountability — consolidating tracking, reporting, and delivery across all network segments and partnering cross functionally for integrated CtS management
- Drive LMPP metric improvement through leading indicators (fill rate, touch ratio, length of haul), and influencing to reduce IRIS/IRA deviation versus plan
- Own Length of Haul (LH) model validation — establishing the LH Plan of Record, measuring deviation between modeled and actual performance, and revising to improve accuracy
- Deliver high-fidelity OP1, OP2, QXG, and STP input submissions for Touch Ratio, Length of Haul, and Package Cube forecasts to Finance and planning partners; serve as POC for financials across all planning cycles ensuring PoP, YoY improvements with levers identified and entitlement substantiated,
- Manage linehaul HVE planning and capacity optimization converting constraints into speed and cost goals, and systemically addressing constraints
- Own end-to-end launches — planning sort points and dock door requirements, creating launch playbooks, working backwards plan, coordinating network design changes, and managing execution - Partner with Finance leadership on Canada finance strategy alignment,
- Responsible for driving cost improvement initiatives for all planning cycles, reporting out WBR/DBR/Planning Cycle updates to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing Cost to Serve performance and leading indicators across all miles. By mid-morning, you lead a linehaul capacity review ahead of an HVE, converting a middle-mile constraint into an addressable plan. After lunch, you validate Athena model outputs against actuals and revise recommendations ahead of the OP2 submission. You close the day coordinating a 1P FC launch playbook with network design and partners, quantifying CX and cost impact for senior leadership. High visibility role requires all encompassing view of supply chain and ability to multi task on initiatives with conflicting delivery timelines.

About the team
The Canada Transportation team sits within Global Transportation Services (GTS) and Network Design & Planning Execution (NDPE). We own the strategy and execution of Canada's outbound delivery network — Cost to Serve, capacity planning and execution across last mile, middle mile, network design and optimization and facility launches. We partner with fulfillment, sort centers, middle mile, last mile, air, external carriers, Finance, cross border teams and planning organizations to move packages efficiently from shelf to doorstep. We are a collaborative, data-driven team solving complex logistics and financial-planning challenges at scale, with a mandate to drive parity with the US network.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

title: Programme Manager ISX Italy , Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
descriptionHtml:
Travel Requirement: This role requires frequent national travel within Italy, approximately 50% of working time. You will spend significant time in the field visiting partner and carrier locations across the Italian network — observing the live customer returns experience, coaching partner teams on the spot, and gathering the insights that shape how network-wide improvements are rolled out. All travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with Amazon's travel and reimbursement policy.

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In Italy, we deliver that experience across more than 17,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Program Manager, Italy owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole Italian network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire Italian network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in Italy, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager in Italy and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the in-store returns experience in Italy across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
• Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
• Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
• Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
• Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
• Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
• Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
• Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the Italian market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.


A day in the life
You start the week by reviewing performance data for Italy and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the Italy rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.

About the team
Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.

Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works — because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.

title: Sr Data Engineer - Music DISCO, Music DISCO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Music is awash in data! To help make sense of it all, the DISCO (Data, Insights, Science & Optimization) team: (i) enables the Consumer Product Tech org make data driven decisions that improve the customer retention, engagement and experience on Amazon Music. We build and maintain automated self-service data solutions, data science models and deep dive difficult questions that provide actionable insights. We also enable measurement, personalization and experimentation by operating key data programs ranging from attribution pipelines, northstar weblabs metrics to causal frameworks. (ii) delivering exceptional Analytics & Science infrastructure for DISCO teams, fostering a data-driven approach to insights and decision making. As platform builders, we are committed to constructing flexible, reliable, and scalable solutions to empower our customers. (iii) accelerates and facilitates content analytics and provides independence to generate valuable insights in a fast, agile, and accurate way.

This domain provides analytical support for the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions while launching new features and evaluating existing features with the end goal of improving the customer experience.
DISCO team enables repeatable, easy, in depth analysis of music customer behaviors. We reduce the cost in time and effort of analysis, data set building, model building, and user segmentation. Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools.

If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services.

We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. Duties include big data design and analysis, data modeling, and development, deployment, and operations of big data pipelines. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university.
DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. Your team will manage the data exchange store (Data Lake) and EMR/Spark processing layer using Airflow as orchestrator. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines.

Key job responsibilities
You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization. You will serve as a leader for Data Engineers in DISCO MPT team.

A day in the life
-Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK).
-Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity.
-Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data.
-Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency.
-Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users.
-Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks
-Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks.
-Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information.
-Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects.
-Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability.

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. title: Engineering Operations Technician, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life

title: System Development Engineer, AWS Manufacturing Infrastructure Services
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to build massively scalable systems that are used by the world's largest cloud infrastructures?
Would you enjoy broad yet equally deep scope that impacts all AWS systems globally?
AWS Manufacturing Infrastructure Services continues to pioneer and our team is architecting, building, and operating scalable services that are at the core of AWS infrastructure.

What do we do?
We own all AWS platforms, services, infrastructure, and tools that ensure the health of AWS hardware by testing every new system across all AWS manufacturing sites and ensure they are healthy when delivered to data centers. Our platform enables service owners such as EC2, EBS, S3, and other to deliver healthy servers for their service. Our team leads a large-scale service that sets the bar for Amazon and the industry in platform level services, effectively enabling the hardware at scale by designing and developing the software that manages the verification and testing of every server and rack in AWS manufacturing sites.

Why it’s high-impact?
We set the bar high to ensure that AWS customers get the capacity they need to run their applications on a healthy hardware server.

What’s the challenge?
There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast-moving space. Our platform is mission critical and requires deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love.

What you will do?
You will be a part of a team to build the next generation of platform level software and systems that enables us to deliver healthy hardware to AWS customers. You design and deliver technology solutions which solve difficult business problems.

Who would succeed in this role?
Deeply technical engineers, who stay close to the customer as well as the systems architecture and design. They think about customer experience and the outcome. A person who works autonomously and dives deep in to a problem to deeply understand how things work, when to make subtle change, and when to disrupt the status quo to achieve the right results.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the reliability of manufacturing networking, systems, and platform infrastructure across AWS manufacturing partner sites globally.
- Develop infrastructure-as-code to stand up and manage distributed manufacturing services at new and existing sites.
- Build monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems that identify infrastructure failures before they impact manufacturing throughput.
- Develop troubleshooting tools and runbooks that enable rapid diagnosis and resolution of site infrastructure issues.
- Consult with ODM/CM IT teams on network design and infrastructure standards, working across organizational boundaries where partners don't report to AWS.
- Drive site expansion readiness, ensuring new manufacturing sites are infrastructure-ready within target onboarding timelines.
- Implement security and operational best practices for manufacturing environments, including credential management, network segmentation, and access controls.
- Contribute to architecture decisions for manufacturing platform evolution.
- Develop and build systems that enables operating manufacturing infrastrcure operation at scale

About the team
We are EC2 Manufacturing Infrastructure Services. We exist to make sure that a working rack delivers to our customers in AWS data centers.

Every server that powers EC2, every rack that runs AI/ML workloads, every piece of capacity that AWS customers depend on passes through our systems before it ships. We own Server Level Testing, Rack Level Testing, Firmware Upgrade services, code deployment into manufacturing sites, network architecture at contract manufacturers, and all infrastructure installed at those sites. When yield drops or a test pipeline breaks, we are the team that responds.

Nothing reaches an AWS data center without passing through us first. If our services go down, manufacturing lines stop. If our infrastructure is unreliable, capacity doesn't ship. The blast radius of what we do is measured in billions of dollars of customer workloads.

We are a small team with enormous scope. You will own real systems on day one. We don't have layers of abstraction between you and the problem. You build it, you ship it, you operate it, you improve it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting and experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications
- Experience in enterprise scale infrastructure or development-based cloud programs/projects in a related industry
- Experience with automation or working with scripting languages like Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell, or equivalent
- 3+ years of systems engineering, network engineering, or SRE experience
- Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, network segmentation
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems, firewalls).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Knowledge of security technology and concepts (Authentication, Authorization, Single sign-on, Cryptography, etc.)
- Experience with AWS services in edge/hybrid environments (EC2, VPC, IAM, Outposts, CloudWatch, S3)
- Experience with on-premise infrastructure (servers, storage, campus networking, firewalls)
- Familiarity with PXE boot, IPMI/BMC, or bare-metal provisioning
- Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar)
- Experience working with external partners or vendors on shared infrastructure
- Experience with manufacturing environments, industrial networking, or factory automation systems

descriptionHtml:
Design and build the electrical systems that power next-generation automation robots, working hands-on in our engineering lab to transform prototypes into production-ready solutions. You'll partner directly with mechanical engineers, software engineers, and technicians to create industrial control panels, integrate sensors and components, and solve complex technical challenges that impact Amazon's operational efficiency across hundreds of fulfillment centers.

Key job responsibilities
As an Senior Electrical Engineer you will:
- Design industrial control panels using EPLAN, selecting and specifying components including PLCs, IPCs, motor drives, sensors, and safety devices to meet system requirements
- Research, evaluate, and select sensors, actuators, motors, and other electrical components for integration into automation systems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability
- Perform system-level electrical design and integration, ensuring electrical subsystems work cohesively with mechanical and software components across the complete
- Create wiring harness designs and electrical documentation, including connector specifications, wire routing, cable management, schematics, wiring diagrams, and bills of materials for prototype and production systems
- Build, assemble, and test prototype wiring harnesses and control panels in the lab, conducting electrical validation using standard equipment and iterating based on test results; aide field deployment and troubleshooting as needed

A day in the life
As an Senior Electrical Engineer on our team, you'll focus on designing industrial control panels and developing electrical systems for robots that operate at scale across our fulfillment network. Your day might include selecting and specifying components like PLCs, motor drives, and sensors using EPLAN; researching and evaluating new electrical components for integration into automation systems; or building and testing prototype wiring harnesses in our lab. You'll work alongside mechanical and software engineers to ensure electrical subsystems integrate seamlessly with other components, then iterate quickly based on test results. Beyond regular design work, you may conduct electrical testing using oscilloscopes and multimeters, generate technical documentation like schematics and wiring diagrams, or assist field deployment and troubleshooting at fulfillment centers to ensure systems perform reliably in real-world environments.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Sr Ops Engineer - Mechanical Equipment SME, One MHS
descriptionHtml:
OMHS Integration & Deployment is building the team that installs and commissions Amazon's next-generation material handling systems. We are looking for a mechanical equipment subject matter expert for our installation programs, providing technical leadership across the full portfolio of equipment.

If you have spent your career with installing or keeping MHE running, you know exactly which installation shortcuts cause the failures maintenance teams live with for years. This role puts that knowledge at the front of the equipment lifecycle. You will develop the installation job plans that define how Amazon's material handling equipment gets assembled, aligned, torqued, and turned over, preventing reliability problems before the equipment ever runs its first package.

You will own mechanical installation quality end-to-end: authoring installation job plans and standards, validating contractor execution against them, and driving continuous improvement as system complexity scales.


Key job responsibilities
Develop installation job plans for MHE equipment, translating equipment expertise into task-level installation procedures with torque specifications, alignment tolerances, assembly sequences, and acceptance criteria
Author and maintain mechanical installation standards and pre-turnover punch list criteria for all OMHS equipment types.
Apply failure mode knowledge from equipment service history to identify the installation practices that drive long-term reliability, and build them into every job plan
Validate mechanical installation work in the field; identify deficiencies, document findings, and drive corrective action to closure
Partner with site installation teams to interpret engineering drawings, resolve field fit-up issues, and validate alignment and tolerance requirements
Develop mechanical commissioning protocols and equipment turnover packages that set up site RME teams for success from day one
Collaborate with the rest of the team to create integrated system acceptance packages
Analyze early-life failures to identify systemic installation quality gaps and feed corrections back into job plans
Create training content for field supervisors and 3P crews on mechanical installation quality expectations
Represent OMHS I&D in cross-functional forums with Design Engineering, RME, and Construction on mechanical installation best practices

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience

- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment

Preferred qualifications

title: Facilities SVS Sr Area Manager, 施設管理部管理課/RME-Facilities
descriptionHtml:
「守る」だけの施設管理は、ここにはない。

全国に広がるアマゾンジャパンの物流ネットワーク。そのすべてが24時間365日稼働し、毎日数百万個の荷物をお客様に届けています。この物流インフラを支える「施設の番人」でありながら、同時に「施設の進化」を推進するのが、Facilities Service Area Manager（FSAM）です。

本ポジションでは、フルフィルメントセンター（FC）の施設管理全般を担当します。設備保全はもちろん、Cafeteria運営、シャトルバス管理、廃棄物管理、省エネルギー推進まで—施設に関わるあらゆることが、あなたの裁量で動きます。

なぜこのポジションが面白いのか：

・事業インパクトの大きさ — あなたが管理する施設には千人規模の従業員が出勤し、お客様の注文を処理しています。施設が安定稼働し続けることで、全国の配送が支えられています。そのやりがいと面白さがここにあります ・オーナーシップ — 「どんな施設にしたいか」をあなた自身が考え、提案し、実行できます ・サステナビリティ — 省エネ施策の提案・実行により、環境負荷の低減に直接貢献できます。数字で見える成果が出るからこそやりがいがあります ・全国ネットワーク — 全国のFSAMとナレッジを共有し、ベストプラクティスを標準化。自拠点だけでなく全国に影響を与えられます ・ワークライフバランス — 基本日勤・土日祝休み（年数回の計画的な夜勤あり）

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
・25％ 建屋に関する建築、電気、空調、衛生、消火、昇降設備に関わる保全計画のプランと実施。各種取引先との交渉、関係構築。省エネルギー管理 ・20% 施設の省エネ管理、廃棄物やリサイクル品処理のオペレーションとコスト管理、関連するコンプライアンス遵守 ・15% 予算管理及び予算削減の提案・契約書の見直し ・15% 全国での改善横ぐし活動のリード ・10% 各種レポートの作成・契約書の見直し ・10% Cafeteriaや売店において、従業員に対し安全でおいしい食事が提供できる環境作り ・5％ シャトルバスの運行管理や行政や地域対応

※基本的に日勤、土日祝休みですが年に数回夜勤があります。

A day in the life
出勤したらまず施設の巡回。空調の運転状況、消防設備の状態、清掃品質を確認し、保全計画の進捗を頭の中で整理します。午前中は協力会社とのWeekly MTGで設備保全の進捗をレビューし、新規契約の見積もり内容について交渉。続いて廃棄物・リサイクル品の処理状況とコストを確認し、コンプライアンス上の課題がないかチェックします。昼食時にはCafeteriaの運営状況を確認—衛生管理やメニューの改善点を委託先と協議します。午後は省エネルギー施策の効果データを分析し、予算削減につながる次の改善案をまとめます。月次レポートの作成や契約書の見直しを進めた後、全国の施設管理メンバーとのオンライン共有会で自拠点の成功事例を発表し、他拠点から学ぶ—この「横のつながり」が成長を加速させます。夕方にはシャトルバスの運行状況を確認し、地域の行政対応に必要な書類を整理して一日を締めくくります。

突発的な設備トラブルも発生しますが、あなたは直接手を動かす作業者ではなく、全体を見渡し判断するマネージャーです。協力会社を適切に指揮し、再発防止の仕組みづくりまで見届けること—それがこの仕事の醍醐味です。

About the team
RME-Facilities（施設管理）チームは、全国のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）、ソートセンター（SC）、デリバリーステーション（DS）、入荷仕分けセンター（IXD）など多様な物流拠点の施設管理を担っています。チームメンバーはゼネコン、ビルメンテナンス、製造業、商業施設など多様なバックグラウンドを持つプロフェッショナル集団です。
・チーム規模: 全国で約100名以上のメンバーが連携
・出身業界: ゼネコン設備部門、サブコン、ビルメンテナンス会社、製造業の工務部門、商業施設FM会社など
・キャリアパス: FSAM → Sr. Area Manager → Facility Manager（大規模拠点）→ Regional / Global Roleへの道も開かれています

Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。[https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp](https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp)

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing external vendors, distributors, partners or learning providers
- Experience in cost/benefit analysis of project proposals
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- 施設管理の実務経験 7年以上（総務・ビル管理・プロパティマネジメント含む）
- PCスキル：Excel、PowerPoint、Word、生成AI

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing change in a multiple site environment and across multiple direct reports
- Bachelor's degree, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること
- 製造業または物流業での施設管理経験 5年以上

- 建築物環境衛生管理技術者、エネルギー管理士、電気主任技術者、消防設備士などの資格
- 省エネルギー施策の立案・実行経験
- 建物・設備の改善改良を計画から実施までリードした経験

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities
* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience managing a team of 20+ employees

MULTIPLE POSITIONS AVAILABLE

Employer: AMAZON DATA SERVICES, INC.
Offered Position: Manager III, Tech Ops Eng
Job Location: Fairless Hills, Pennsylvania
Job Number: AMZ10140063

Position Responsibilities:

Lead, mentor, and coach a team of skilled Construction Managers, solving problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Manage a fast-moving team of professionals and the regional construction program delivering data center capacity to support Amazon’s growth in the Eastern United States and other potential sites in North America. Own and drive the construction life cycle from pre-construction, through procurement, to managing the onsite construction work. Support, grow, and nurture the team delivering efficient and sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems to customers. Hire and develop new Construction Managers and Project Engineers. Coach, mentor, and lead a large Construction Management team. Responsible for the strategic and tactical management of construction capacity delivery within their region. Communicate and provide guidance to Finance during the development and execution of capital budgets. Coordinate with various teams supporting the data center development and launch. Develop and manage metrics quantifying performance within their region. Coordinate with Business Development on land and facility acquisition. Manage the safety, cost, and quality of the data center deliverable.

Position Requirements:

Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field and one year of experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Employer will accept five years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation as equivalent to a Bachelor's degree and one year of experience. Domestic travel up to 25% may be required to perform role responsibilities.
