- Author the full year plans and planning documents for your segment through Amazon's annual and three-year planning cycles, and present recommendations to Director and VP leadership.
- Lead cross-organizational workstreams on network strategy, such as regionalization and inventory placement, with Operations, Finance, Engineering, and Retail partners.
- Analyze and synthesize data to identify opportunities for enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency in the network.
- Define metrics, develop mechanisms, and invent and simplify processes to drive decision-making in complex network situations.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across functions, influencing and facilitating agreements to achieve shared network goals.

A day in the life
In this role you own the long-term plan for AMXL's upstream storage and cross-dock network. You work with our science, finance, supply chain, engineering, and operations partners to model what the network needs to look like over the next three years, and you write and present the recommendation to senior leadership. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Electric Vehicle Charger Specialist ,  Amazon Maintenance Operation Centre (AMOC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our operation is built on the way teams’ bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.
Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge we committed to be net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, 10 years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people that are dedicated to making a meaningful impact on the sustainability of our products and supply chain.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

Purpose of job

Amazon is a global leader in sustainable transportation solutions, dedicated to advancing the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and reducing our carbon footprint. Our state-of-the-art EV charging infrastructure continues to grow and span the globe, providing reliable and accessible charging solutions to drivers around Amazon’s transportation network. As an Electric Vehicle Charger Escalation Specialist, you will play a critical role in maintaining the functionality and reliability of our global network of Electric Vehicle (EV) chargers. You will be part of a 24/7 team responsible for remote coordination and escalation of maintenance and technical issues to ensure minimal downtime and optimal performance of our charging network.


Key job responsibilities
• Continuously monitor the performance of EV charging stations worldwide, identifying any technical issues or anomalies.
• Respond and process incoming alarms, trouble tickets, purchase orders, invoices following SOPs and processes.
• Serve as a point of contact for customers in the field when technical problems arise. Escalate issues to the appropriate vendors or teams for resolution.
• Maintain detailed records of technical issues, escalations, and resolutions. Use reports and dashboards to track the performance and reliability of the charging network.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including RME field, operations, sustainability and external stakeholders, to ensure efficient issue resolution.
• Develop and improve training materials and resources to improve troubleshooting skills, reducing the need for escalations.
• Recommend process improvements and enhancements to the charging infrastructure based on insights gathered from issue analysis.

A day in the life
Your job is simple to describe and never boring to do: keep the EV chargers up and running.

You'll start each morning with the most urgent cases — the chargers that are down. For each one, you'll play detective: fix it remotely in minutes, or send someone to the site? When the cause isn't obvious, you'll dig into the charger's history to find the root problem, and know when to escalate.

Much of your day is making things happen through others — coordinating technicians and vendors, joining alignment meetings, and handling the paperwork: purchase requests, technical reports, quotes, and invoices.

About the team
You'll join a team that brings together two kinds of expertise. On one side are escalation specialists who come from a range of different backgrounds, united by solid experience in customer service and support — they know how to stay calm under pressure, keep people informed, and drive an issue through to resolution. On the other side are senior EV charger specialists, the technical experts who know these chargers inside and out and can get to the bottom of even the trickiest problems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
- Experience working independently and collaborating effectively in a remote team environment
- Experience in a 24/7 environment
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Experience in technical support, escalation management, or a similar role.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience in Electric vehicle charger industry or related industries
- Proficient in other languages

title: Sr. Infrastructure Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Reliability & Quality
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Senior Infrastructure Reliability Engineer you will be proactively driving the reliability risk identification, assessment and mitigation for datacenter infrastructure equipment (Example: Busduct, Tapoff Box, MV Transformers, LV SWGR, Breakers, UPS, Power Distribution Cabinets etc.). You will also be responsible for root cause analysis of critical equipment failures and drive the continuous improvements to improve datacenter availability for AWS customers. You will work closely with both internal and outside partners including suppliers to drive key aspects of product specification, risk identification plan and execution. You must be ownership minded, independent, action and results oriented to succeed in an open collaborative environment.

The candidate should have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based approach to develop and implement both analytical and empirical approaches for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during product design, manufacture as well as deployment stages. The individual should be able to drive AWS application-specific requirements in carrying out both lifecycle environmental and operational stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical, chemical and mechanical stresses so to identify overstress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. Candidate should be capable of evaluating not only product design quality/reliability risks, but also have the skills and experiences in assessing electronics manufacture process related quality/reliability issues. Knowledge of statistical techniques and models is required to analyze test as well as field data.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification and the associated vendor selection and qualification requirements. The candidate will be expected to use knowledge of process capability for electronic component production as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical to quality and reliability metrics.
At the system level, the individual will develop datacenter system level reliability model and related reliability quantification and risk analysis for datacenter configuration optimization. The candidate will be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and data analytics.

During sustaining stage, candidate will be responsible for monitoring product performance in the field and will be responsible to drive root cause analysis of any critical failures and the associated corrective and preventive actions. The individual should also be able to drive effective vendor auditing and quarterly review process to drive the continuous improvements of datacenter availability.

The successful candidate should be considered as an expert in the reliability engineering field and have a proven track record of success in not only product reliability leadership, as well as business negotiations and program management. Strong skill-set in problem analysis and solving as well as communication and vendor management are necessary. Candidates should also be able to travel internationally.

title: Senior Supply Chain Manager, Rapid & Rural Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by solving complex network design problems at scale? Amazon's Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) Supply Chain team is looking for a Senior Supply Chain Manager to lead site selection and launch planning for our Sub-Same Day (SSD) delivery network. In this role, you will conduct topology analysis, evaluate real estate options, and develop jurisdictional proposals and volume plans that shape where and how we expand. Your recommendations feed directly into financial modeling and capital approval decisions, making your work a critical input to one of Amazon's fastest-growing delivery programs.

This is a high-visibility opportunity at an inflection point: the SSD network is preparing for its largest expansion yet, and the team is investing in scalable, automated launch and expansion processes to support rapid growth in the years ahead. You will partner with Finance, Real Estate, Operations, S&OP, and Delivery Experience (DEX) teams to turn data into actionable plans that get new sites open on time and on budget.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct topology analysis using demand estimation and optimization tools to develop jurisdictional coverage proposals and volume plans for new and existing metro areas.
- Partner with Finance and Real Estate to translate site proposals into financial payback models that support the site selection and capital approval process.
- Collaborate with S&OP, launch, and DEX teams to align demand forecasts, capacity allocation, and launch timelines across the network.
- Identify and implement process improvements that scale and automate the jurisdictional planning and launch functions, reducing manual effort as annual launch volume grows.
- Manage trade-offs across competing priorities — building size, coverage boundaries, timeline, and cost — and present clear recommendations to leadership.

A day in the life
You will spend much of your time working in optimization and planning tools, estimating zip-code-level demand and mapping it against real estate options to build the strongest possible site proposal. From there, you will join cross-functional working sessions with planning and launch teams to align on timelines and capacity targets. When a live coverage gap surfaces, you may step in to help resolve it quickly, but most of your work is proactive and roadmap-driven. Expect a mix of heads-down analytical work and collaborative problem-solving with partners across the organization.

title: SDE II, AWS Invoicing
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building systems that power global commerce? AWS is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a team at the heart of the AWS Invoicing organization—responsible for generating, delivering, and ensuring the compliance of invoices that AWS sends to customers around the world. Our systems process a significant share of AWS revenue, serve customers across dozens of countries, and are continually expanding with automation and new product capabilities.

As an SDE on this team, you'll design and build services that generate invoice documents, deliver them through email and APIs, and integrate with government tax and e-invoicing systems across the globe. You'll tackle problems spanning distributed systems, large-scale document rendering, and regulatory compliance—all operating at high scale and reliability.

You'll own features end to end: designing, implementing, testing, and operating the services you build. You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, and compliance partners to turn complex regulatory requirements into reliable, maintainable systems. The problems are real, the impact is tangible, and you'll regularly ship work that matters to customers paying their AWS bills worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
Write and ship production code — Develop, test, and deploy high-quality code for backend services that generate and deliver invoice documents (PDFs, emails, structured data) to AWS customers worldwide.

Own software components — Take ownership of well-defined components within the invoicing platform, such as a rendering module, a delivery workflow, or an integration adapter with a government tax portal. You'll be responsible for the quality, correctness, and operational health of your components.

Test thoroughly — Write unit tests, integration tests, and regression tests for your code. Validate invoice templates against thousands of test cases to ensure zero cosmetic defects or compliance issues in legal financial documents.

Debug and troubleshoot — Use logs, metrics, alarms, and debugging tools to identify and resolve software defects. Support team during on-call rotations by investigating service issues, responding to alerts, and driving incident resolution with guidance from senior engineers.

Deploy and operate software — Follow best practices for safe deployments across multiple environments. Monitor the health of services you contribute to and respond to operational issues to maintain high availability.

Participate in code reviews — Review teammates' code to find basic errors, improve readability, and learn team conventions. Incorporate feedback from code reviews on your own contributions to continuously improve code quality.

Learn and grow with guidance — Work on well-defined projects scoped by your manager and senior engineers. Actively seek feedback, learn system design approaches, and build your understanding of the team's distributed architecture and compliance domain over time.

Collaborate across the team — Partner with senior engineers, product managers, and compliance experts and tax PoCs across globe to understand requirements. Ask clarifying questions, communicate progress, and flag blockers early


About the team
Our team sits within the AWS Invoicing organization and owns the end-to-end lifecycle of invoice artifacts—from creation to delivery to government reporting. Based in Seattle, we're a group of engineers who care deeply about reliability, compliance, and customer experience. Our systems generate invoices at scale, send delivery notifications, and report to tax authorities across many countries.

We're in an exciting growth phase: expanding e-invoicing to new countries, building a reusable invoicing platform for teams across Amazon, and investing in automation to streamline compliance work. We have a strong mix of senior and early-career engineers, and we actively invest in growing SDEs through mentorship, well-scoped projects, and a culture of learning.

We share knowledge openly, encourage engineers to research before they build, and give people room to experiment and turn what they learn into something the whole team benefits from. Whether you're drawn to distributed systems, document processing, international regulations, or applied AI, there's room here to explore and grow into the engineer you want to become.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Ground Gas Specialist
descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Worldwide (WW) Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Ground Gas Specialist you will help protect one of the safest real estate programs in the world. You will partner with stakeholders and teams across Amazon to develop and run our ground gas mitigation program in continental Europe, spanning standards and policy development, implementation, and execution; your work directly reduces environmental and human-health risk across our facilities.
To be successful you will bring strong contaminated-land and ground gas or vapour-intrusion expertise, including risk assessment, mitigation system design, construction, operations, maintenance, and monitoring (OMM); you will understand how ground gas and vapour intrusion are regulated within European contaminated-land frameworks and be able to extend that understanding across the countries in scope. We welcome experienced geo-environmental generalists with demonstrable ground gas exposure, and Amazon will sponsor specialist accreditation and training to deepen your expertise.
This role is based in continental Europe and covers Amazon's European portfolio, coordinating country-specific regulatory work through qualified local partners and consultants. Travel is variable and project-driven, concentrated during site investigation, construction, and startup phases; it is not a fixed continuous commitment.



Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Provide a single point of contact to internal teams to develop, understand, and execute Amazon's ground gas program in continental Europe, coordinating country-specific coverage through qualified local consultants and partners.
• Complete due diligence reviews of properties to assess ground gas risk.
• Complete reviews of mitigation system designs, construction plans, and construction verification, startup testing, and OMM data.
• Inspect and/or oversee field personnel inspecting systems during construction, startup, and operation to evaluate conditions and confirm design and operating assumptions.

title: System Development Engineer I, Enterprise Productivity
descriptionHtml:
Are you someone who thrives on building reliable, scalable systems and making the lives of engineers around you easier? As a System Development Engineer I at Amazon, you will play a key role in improving the development, testing, deployment, and operations of the systems your team depends on. You will solve real problems that directly impact how quickly and reliably your team delivers for customers. From writing clean, maintainable code to automating repetitive tasks and strengthening system resilience, your work will have a tangible effect on the quality and speed of everything your team ships. If you are curious, collaborative, and excited to grow your technical skills while making meaningful contributions from day one, this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver software, tooling, and automation that improve the reliability, efficiency, and performance of your team's systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full product development lifecycle.

- Write well-tested, logical, and maintainable code while actively seeking design and code reviews from peers, incorporating feedback to continuously raise the quality of your work.
- Identify points of failure in managed systems and develop monitoring metrics and automated solutions that reduce manual effort, improve system resilience, and help your team deliver more quickly.
- Collaborate with teammates to improve documentation, runbooks, and operational processes, and evaluate opportunities to integrate generative artificial intelligence tools responsibly to augment productivity and output quality.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing system health dashboards and responding to alerts before diving into a coding task — perhaps building a new automation script or refining an existing deployment pipeline. After a design review with your team, you could spend the afternoon debugging a tricky operational issue, tracing it across multiple components to find the root cause. Along the way, you will pair with teammates, ask questions, and pick up new techniques that sharpen your skills and broaden your understanding of how your systems fit into the bigger picture.

About the team
Our team is focused on making it easier, faster, and more reliable for builders at Amazon to develop and operate their systems. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. Every team member has a voice in design discussions and prioritization, and we invest in mentoring one another so that everyone grows. If you are looking for a team where your contributions matter, where you will be supported as you learn, and where you can help shape how we build for the future, we would love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer II, AWS Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) organization is the analytics backbone of AWS — we build and operate the data platform that powers business decisions across more than 150 AWS services. Every insight surfaced to AWS product leadership, from service adoption trends to revenue drivers, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains. We operate at massive scale — processing petabytes of data daily through thousands of jobs consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards.

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our team. This individual will be a significant and autonomous contributor, owning a major portion of the team's data architecture — solving difficult problems, building logical data models, and delivering data pipelines that are stable, performant, and consistently high quality. You will work with engineers and stakeholders across AWS to design data contracts, build ingestion flows, and deliver analytical models that increase self-service access to datasets and business effectiveness.

The ideal candidate applies appropriate technologies and best practices, writes pragmatic and maintainable code, and takes ownership of ongoing data quality. You are proficient with SQL, ETL, and data processing, with experience using cloud-based data services such as AWS EMR, Glue, Redshift, and Lake Formation. The candidate should have exposure to AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, and a foundational understanding of Agentic Frameworks — including autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, and tool integration. You are trusted with autonomy in ambiguous environments where data design is not well defined, able to balance customer requirements with team priorities, and passionate about building data platforms using AI to accelerate the next generation of analytics at AWS scale.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Key job responsibilities
Identify and resolve data quality issues in processing tools, contribute to improvements and innovation, and ensure best practices in pipelines you design and maintain. For example: optimizing ingestion flows for new data sources, or building efficient transformation patterns within the team's domain.

Build and optimize logical data models and data pipelines for difficult datasets — ensuring solutions are testable, maintainable, and efficient while addressing security, scalability, and cost considerations.

Make appropriate technical trade-offs at the dataset level, balancing pragmatic short-term decisions with sustainable long-term approaches.

Produce high-quality code — solutions that are pragmatic, secure, maintainable, and flexible without over-engineering. Write code that engineers unfamiliar with the system can understand. Limit the use of short-term workarounds and minimize incidental complexity.

Contribute to infrastructure decisions within the team's data architecture. Efficiently manage resources (system hardware, data storage, query optimization, AWS infrastructure) and build solutions that are stable and performant.

Solve difficult problems — for example, designing data models that integrate multiple sources within the team's domain, or combining datasets to unlock new analytical capabilities. Identify issues that may lead to data inconsistency or gaps in data quality, and proactively resolve them.

Break down project work into manageable tasks, deliver independently, and collaborate effectively with peers on shared dependencies. Resolve discordant views and build consensus among team members.

Mentor peers, participate in hiring, and contribute to team knowledge-sharing

Drive data engineering best practices within the team — code quality, data certification, dependency management, and operational excellence. Establish SLAs, automate manual processes, and improve self-service access to data.

Drive improvements through code reviews, design discussions, team planning, and operational reviews.

Participate in on-call rotation and take ownership of operational health for data systems you own — contribute to monitoring, alarming, runbooks, and incident resolution.

- 5+ years of data engineering experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using SQL experience
- 5+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- 3+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using OLAP technologies experience
- Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage

The ideal candidate will have experience in using Physics-of-Failure based models to develop and implement both analytical and empirical solutions for product quality/reliability risk identification and assessment during the product design, manufacturing, testing and deployment stages. The candidate should be able to drive Amazon Leo's requirements by carrying out stress driven risk analysis, including thermal, electrical and mechanical stresses in order to identify over-stress and fatigue-related product weaknesses. They should also be comfortable in assessing electronics manufacturing process related quality/reliability issues.

At the component level, the individual will drive critical component identification, support vendor selection and define component qualification requirements. The candidate will also be expected to use their knowledge of PCBA manufacturing, electronic component derating, as well as system-level performance requirements to establish critical quality and reliability metrics.

At the system level, the candidate will support development of system level reliability models and perform reliability assessments and risk analyses for optimization of design. The candidate will be also be expected to be familiar with system reliability engineering tools, such as reliability block diagram, statistical modeling and on orbit data analytics.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

- Review, guide, and support subsystem team component selections, derating and FMEAs
- Support component and manufacturing process qualification
- Drive root cause investigation and failure analysis for hardware failures

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably with a focus on satellite systems or space applications.
- Knowledge of reliability engineering principles, methods, and tools.
- Knowledge of environmental testing
- Proficiency in failure analysis techniques and materials characterization methods.
- Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or Doctorate degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS).

This is a role in the Media and Entertainment Go-To-Market (GTM) focusing on Application Modernization, Container Services, Serverless, Opensource technology skills and Migration/Modernization experience. This role is responsible for partnering with leading strategic Media and Entertainment customers and enable them to better adopt the portfolio of AppMod, Containers, Serverless, Opensource and Migration and Modernization that includes: Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS), Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), AWS Fargate, Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR), and AWS App Mesh.

You will also demonstrate Customer Obsession, representing the voice of the customer as you work with product teams across AWS to evolve AWS services. As a part of the team responsible for GTM of the Container Services portfolio for AWS, you will also develop scalable motions to establish new business in target market segments, support, and enable the global field organization to drive their day-to-day customer interactions. You will be the single-threaded owner for developing and executing the GTM plan for Media and Entertainment customer segment as well as the extension of the AWS Container Services product team for this set of customers, understanding their use cases, gathering customer feature requests and feedback, and influencing product direction.

You will use your business savvy to identify new workload patterns and use cases, drive lighthouse wins, and develop and execute scalable adoption programs. Your background in cloud-friendly, scalable architectures will help customers understand how to scale their infrastructure on the cloud. Your excellent verbal and written communication skills will allow you build sales enablement tools, evangelize our platform with our enterprise customers, start-ups and valued partners. Previous experience with AWS is desired but not required. Domain and working experience with different Media and Entertainment segments (corporations, studios, subsidiaries) would be essential for this role. A keen sense of Ownership, Insist on Highest Standards, and Bias for Action is a must and are hallmarks of a successful person in this role.

• Experience in taking new products or services to launch, and developing and executing a GTM strategy to drive adoption across multiple customer segments.
• Experience with cloud-native workloads, in-depth knowledge of containers ecosystem and knowledge of how customers are adopting containers to drive business outcomes.

descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our team of innovative Software Engineers and build the next generation service platforms for AWS, EC2 and our customers. These services are key components of the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) web service.

Our platform handles a significant load of Internet traffic generated by internal and external customers that build their solutions on EC2. On any given day we use Java, Kotlin, Typescript, Python, Ruby, Go and C++ as well as various Native AWS services and Amazon-internal tools. We don't expect you to be an expert in, or know all these technologies, but we do expect you to have strong programming fundamentals and be excited to learn about these technologies.

Our team invents, designs and builds software that is stable, scalable and performant. We write and support code that is easy to understand with solutions that are pragmatic. We keep a high bar in code reviews to ensure high quality code.

Engineers in our teams have great ownership, a drive to innovate and aim to have resounding impact in whatever we build.

As a member of this team, you will own and contribute to the development of quality designs & solutions, solving complex problems. You are able to operate with limited guidance and take a long term view of your team’s services and how they fit into the broader architecture. The services that your team own are used by many teams and you will have opportunities to work and influence engineers and teams outside of your own team to build out EC2 architecture that supports Amazon scale business needs.

We follow a DevOps model and we assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a more well rounded engineer that will enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. This position includes on-call duties which is on rotation with the rest of the team. Our team values work-life balance.

As an Amazonian, you will enjoy interacting with some of the most talented engineers in our industry through breakfast talks and demos, internal communities and extensive training material that spans all aspects of our business.

We are looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, curious, empathic, motivated and reliable. The development opportunities are plentiful and we're only just starting to scratch the surface. If this sounds intriguing to you, then come build with us.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.


About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: FBA FC Ops Sr. Manager, FBA - Fullfillment by Amazon
descriptionHtml:
This FBA FC Ops Manager leads a team of FBA Operations Managers distributed across Amazon Fulfillment Centers in Brazil. The role serves as the critical bridge between FC Operations and FBA Business teams, driving end-to-end operational excellence across Inbound, Outbound, and Inventory Management. The position combines strategic program leadership — identifying systemic opportunities, designing cross-functional process improvements, and building business cases — with hands-on operational management, including daily performance monitoring, escalation management, and stakeholder coordination across Operations, S&OP, Program, Sales, Transportation, Network Losses, and Legal. The ideal candidate is both analytically rigorous and operationally resourceful, capable of translating data insights into tangible process changes that improve Seller Experience and operational efficiency at scale. A strong background in both FC Operations and Project/Program Management is essential — this role demands someone who can fluently navigate operational and business environments, speaking the language of FC floor realities and strategic business priorities with equal credibility.

Key job responsibilities

- Operations–Business Integration — Serve as the primary liaison between FC Operations and FBA Business teams (Program, Sales, S&OP), ensuring operational realities inform business decisions and business priorities translate into actionable operational plans. This requires the ability to navigate both environments seamlessly — translating FC floor-level constraints into business-language trade-offs, and business priorities into executable operational plans.
- Process Improvement & Optimization — Map existing Inbound, Outbound, and Inventory Management workflows; identify gaps, pain points, and efficiency opportunities; design and implement cross-team process improvements with measurable impact.
- AI-Driven Process Innovation — Identify opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation tools to accelerate process improvements, enhance decision-making, and unlock operational efficiencies. Proactively explore use cases where AI can reduce manual effort, improve forecasting accuracy, or surface insights from large-scale operational data, and champion adoption across the team and stakeholders.
- Metrics Ownership & Performance Management — Build, own, and continuously refine the FBA Ops metrics framework and reporting cadence; monitor key performance indicators, distinguish isolated incidents from structural issues through deep-dive analysis, and drive data-informed corrective actions.
- Impact Quantification & Business Case Development — Size the impact and potential of identified opportunities and pain points, making them tangible through data-backed analysis; develop business cases to support Product Roadmap prioritization for both Latam and Global teams.
- Stakeholder Influence & Product Partnership — Influence Product teams on roadmap prioritization by translating operational insights into compelling product requirements; propose programmatic solutions and initiatives that address root causes rather than symptoms.
- Seller Experience Enhancement — Champion creative solutions that directly improve the Seller Experience, connecting operational improvements to seller-facing outcomes.
- Escalation & Trade-off Management — Anticipate bottlenecks, provide proactive escalation management, and make sound trade-offs balancing business needs against technical and operational constraints.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience in process improvement

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Contas Enterprise - Sao Paulo - Brazil, Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
Você gostaria de ingressar em uma das equipes de maior crescimento da AWS? Buscamos uma pessoa engenheira de contas enterprise (conhecida também como TAM - Technical Account Manager), para assessorar clientes de forma técnica, além de ser a “voz do cliente” dentro da AWS. Esta posição ajuda a criar e executar estratégias para impulsionar a adoção de melhores práticas e o uso efetivo dos serviços da AWS. A pessoa nessa posição possui perspicácia técnica para representar efetivamente a AWS no ambiente do cliente e conduzir discussões com suas lideranças sobre incidentes, compensações, escopo proativo e gerenciamento de riscos. A pessoa também ajudará a planejar e criar soluções usando metodologias padrão e manter os ambientes AWS de seus clientes operacionalmente saudáveis e eficientes, criando um relacionamento próximo com o cliente para entender suas necessidades comerciais/operacionais e desafios técnicos, ajudando-o a obter o maior valor dos serviços AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Fornecer suporte para resolver dúvidas de clientes em relação ao serviço de nuvem da AWS.

- Analisar e apresentar revisões periódicas do desempenho operacional ao cliente, além de fornecer análises detalhadas de interrupções de serviço, métricas, planejamento detalhado de pré-lançamento.

- Garantir que os ambientes da AWS permaneçam operacionalmente saudáveis, reduzindo custos e complexidade, além de promover relacionamentos de confiança com clientes, entendendo suas necessidades de negócios e desafios técnicos.

- Liderar discussões técnicas com a liderança sobre incidentes, trade-offs, escopo proativo e gerenciamento de riscos, além de trabalhar diretamente com equipes globais de engenharia e serviço da AWS para resolver os problemas do cliente.

- Disponibilidade para viajar de 10 a 25% do tempo, conforme necessário.

A day in the life

title: Interim Delivery Trainer (IADT), Delivery Training & Programs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking self-motivated Delivery Trainers to join our team on an interim bases and help build a network of customer-centric Delivery Associates in the communities where we operate. As a Delivery Trainer, you have a passion for mentoring others; you are comfortable teaching and guiding conversations in large groups; and you believe in hands-on training and conducting drive-alongs with Delivery Associates to instill safe practices.

As a Delivery Trainer, you are responsible for establishing the right delivery training culture in your delivery station, setting up the training experience, and independently instructing training sessions. You educate Delivery Associates on the foundational safety, quality, and productivity aspects that are an important part of the Delivery Associate daily routine. You enable the success of Delivery Associates by adapting to different learning styles and taking a hands-on training approach to demonstrate what good looks like. You exhibit Learn and Be Curious by answering all Delivery Associates’ questions and finding the answers if you are not sure of the correct response.

As a Delivery Trainer, you are expected to lead by example and demonstrate the Amazon Leadership Principles at all times. title: Software Development Engineer , DC Console/InfraMap
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 14, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon's Data Center Bridge (DC Bridge) organization builds and operates the software that runs AWS's worldwide data centers. The DC Console team is hiring an experienced frontend-leaning full-stack engineer to build the platform that lets every builder in DC Bridge ship data center operator experiences — not just the team that owns the console.

InfraMap is the UI for AWS data center power and cooling: real-time and historical visualization from world level down to individual sensors, used by Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), the Facility Operations Center (FOC), Field Engineering, Data Center Capacity Planning, and DCGS management to prevent and remediate Critical Site Events (CSEs) and Large Scale Events (LSEs). It has also become a bottleneck: every new page had to be built by one team, inside one monolith, on one deployment pipeline. DC Console exists to remove that constraint.

You should be a strong web engineer with real depth in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React, browser fundamentals, and high-volume real-time UX — and you should be genuinely interested in build systems, deployment, and the mechanics of how frontend code gets to a browser, because half of this role is platform engineering. You should have a background in the fundamentals of software development, deep understanding of best practices across languages and technologies, and take personal pride in interfaces that operators trust during an incident.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the platform that lets engineering teams across the organization ship features into a shared operator console — independent packages, independent pipelines, composed into one product at runtime.
- Own the console shell: navigation, routing, page registration, and the shared services that feature teams build against so no team reimplements the same plumbing.

- Solve the cross-origin problems a federated frontend creates — authenticated module loading, edge authentication, content security policy, per-stage isolation, and graceful fallback when the module registry is unreachable.

- Deliver self-service onboarding: a template that gives a partner team a working module, account, CDN, and pipeline in one step, and support for teams that bring their own backend.

- Give each feature team visibility into its own module — health metrics, alarms, paging, and user reports — without them having to own the shell.
- Move existing pages out of the monolith as reference implementations, behind feature flags so any rollout can be reversed.
- Build and maintain real-time visualizations of power and cooling data that operators rely on during site events.
- Support the teams you onboard: office hours, design reviews, and security reviews that keep a federated frontend from fragmenting into ten different products.

A day in the life
You will write React and TypeScript against Cloudscape, and you will also write CDK, argue about version sets and pipeline self-mutation permissions, and debug why a module loads in alpha and 403s in beta. Development runs on personal stacks — a Midway-authed copy of the whole shell per engineer, aps deploy / aps hotswap against a shared CDN. The team leans hard on AI tooling (an in-house MFE agent package plus AWT and Cloudscape MCP servers) and expects you to extend it, not just use it.



About the team
DC Console is a small team inside DC Bridge, branched from InfraMap, with a charter that is deliberately platform-shaped: let builders across the organization manage, deploy, and create features hosted on InfraMap and DC Console independently of InfraMap core operations. We inherit InfraMap's tenets — security over user experience, user experience over speed to production, we visualize data rather than create it and always provide provenance back to the source, and we build global capabilities rather than one-off single-site solutions.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development, or 3+ years of software development experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:

Come be part of this tremendous organization and join a dedicated team committed to operational and financial excellence where you will focus on the inputs, think like an owner and where every day is Day One.

Our team supports various North America teams through translating operational KPIs into financial impact to ensure our stakeholders have the most up to date and reliable information to make the best possible decision for Amazon. • End-to-end ownership of the financial planning cycles which include forecast modeling, bridging, network partnership and presentations to senior leadership.
• Perform projects financial validations to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights.
• Collect, analyze and manage quantitative data and create meaningful reports to lead business improvement and defect cost reduction strategy.
• Perform root cause analysis to uncover core issues using data, then assisting the operation stakeholders to improve and create new measures for sites productivity.
• Invent and simply processes to drive efficiency and cost improvement over finance processes related to defect costs.
• Thinking big to deliver scalable solutions to better understand end-to-end cost and identify new improvement opportunities.

Take part in developing and mentoring activities, and leverage diverse perspectives.

• Contribuer à l'identification des vulnérabilités (par exemple, pertes, expérience des associés, amélioration des processus) et définir les actions d'atténuation appropriées tout en assurant le respect des normes juridiques et éthiques
• Servir de point de contact et coordonner les mesures de gestion des risques avec la direction locale et les parties externes (par exemple, les forces de l'ordre et les organisations syndicales) pour toutes les questions liées à la sécurité
• Assurer la conformité de vos sites par rapport aux normes de sécurité mondiales d'Amazon
• Être responsable des projets liés à la sécurité et à la prévention des pertes aux niveaux local, régional et national

A day in the life
En tant qu'Expert Sureté & Prevention des pertes, vous rejoindrez une équipe de professionnels de la Sécurité qui fournissent des services de sécurité aux clients professionnels de plusieurs sites au sein d'une zone géographique dédiée.

Vous effectuez des audits de sécurité physique réguliers et enquêtez sur les violations de politique, les incidents liés à la sécurité et les événements de perte. Au cours de vos enquêtes, vous collectez des informations en surveillant les systèmes et outils, en analysant des rapports de données et en menant des entretiens. Vos conclusions contribuent à identifier les vulnérabilités dans nos processus et vous identifiez et pilotez des mesures d'atténuation. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans le maintien de l'intégrité physique de nos sites en auditant et en surveillant l'état de santé de nos systèmes et, conjointement avec des experts en la matière et des fournisseurs externes, maintenez leur fonctionnalité.

Vous identifiez et agissez sur des initiatives visant à améliorer notre infrastructure de sécurité physique et contribuez directement à la planification budgétaire pour nos fournisseurs. Vous interagissez quotidiennement avec nos prestataires de services de sécurité pour assurer les services de sécurité de qualité et une expérience client fluide. Enfin, vous dispensez des programmes de formation et de sensibilisation liés à la prévention des pertes à d'autres équipes et gérez la mise en œuvre de notre plan de Sécurité et Prévention des Pertes.

About the team
Faisant partie de nos équipes Global Security Operations au niveau mondial, la sécurité et la prévention des pertes soutiennent la réalisation des objectifs commerciaux d'Amazon et le renforcement de notre marque en protégeant efficacement contre les menaces et en gérant les risques de sécurité et de prévention des pertes qui pourraient :

• Mettre nos associés et nos clients en danger
• Perturber la continuité de nos activités commerciales
• Causer des dommages à nos actifs
• Avoir un impact négatif sur la réputation de notre marque

Travaillant en partenariat avec nos parties prenantes, nous sécurisons la chaîne d'approvisionnement d'Amazon de bout en bout et promouvons la sécurité lors des discussions d'affaires. Nous le faisons en prévenant les risques et les vulnérabilités liés à la sécurité et à la prévention des pertes le plus tôt possible. Nous intervenons dans les incidents en cours pour en minimiser l'impact, ainsi qu'en enquêtant en profondeur sur les incidents liés à la sécurité afin d'identifier et d'éliminer les causes profondes, empêchant ainsi leur réapparition.

title: Telco Systems Engineering Lead, Direct-to-Device, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is building a Low Earth Orbit satellite constellation designed to provide connectivity to customers around the world.

We are looking for an experienced telco systems engineering lead to oversee everything the direct-to-device (D2D) service delivers to mobile network operators (MNOs). This role turns the Amazon Leo end-to-end solution into a deployable cellular service within the global telco ecosystem: MNO integration, device and chipset interoperability, carrier profiles and service configuration, and service quality.

The ideal candidate has worked on real D2D, NTN, satellite-to-cellular, or closely related services, or has led MNO-facing technical integration for new network services. We are looking for someone who understands how MNOs, device OEMs, and chipset vendors work, can define what the service must deliver to each of them, and can bring their requirements and findings back into the architecture and development teams.

The successful candidate will combine broad cellular and service knowledge with strong customer and partner skills, strong ownership, and the ability to lead in a fast-moving, international environment.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead the evaluation, design, and delivery of solutions for complex interdisciplinary system problems, including defining system-level use cases, interfaces, and multi-system interactions where the technical strategy may not yet be established.
- Conduct and review trade space studies that balance performance, schedule, cost, risk, and scalability, making cross-functional trade-offs across mechanical, electrical, software, and data domains.
- Derive and refine system requirements, acceptance criteria, and performance specifications through rigorous requirements engineering, identifying gaps and escalating incomplete designs at the sub-system and system level.
- Collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to integrate designs, facilitate communication, and ensure system architecture decisions account for reliability, regulatory compliance, security, and operational readiness.
- Leverage generative AI tools and cloud computing platforms where appropriate to augment productivity, streamline system analysis, and support test-guided development practices throughout the engineering lifecycle.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- 8+ years of professional experience in cellular networks or services, including at least 3 years in the Direct-to-Device (D2D) ecosystem, NTN, or direct satellite-to-cellular connectivity.
- Demonstrated experience leading MNO-facing technical integration of network services.
- Working knowledge of 5G core, IMS voice, interconnect with MNO networks, and carrier configuration.
- Experience working with device OEMs and chipset vendors on interoperability and certification.
- Experience defining service KPIs and SLAs with partners.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Apple and Android carrier configuration and certification processes.
- Experience with MNO First Office Application (FOA) or launch of a new network service.
- Experience working with MNOs in several countries.
- Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively across engineering teams, technology partners, customers, and leadership organizations.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience

title: Manager, Safety Policy Expert: Chemical and Environmental, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance Program
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Policy Manager for Chemical & Environmental Compliance to lead the development and execution of product compliance policies across a complex and rapidly evolving global regulatory landscape. In this role, you will serve as Amazon's senior policy authority on chemical and environmental matters — including PFAS, heavy metals, DOE, and EPA regulations — owning the definitive policy positions that guide how Amazon ensures product compliance with applicable laws worldwide.

You will manage and develop a team of junior subject matter experts, fostering their growth into well-rounded compliance professionals while driving high-quality policy outputs. Working at the intersection of science, regulation, and business, you will partner closely with legal and category teams across the organization to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable policies. You will also serve as a key external voice, engaging directly with regulators to articulate Amazon's compliance positions and shape constructive dialogue on emerging regulatory issues.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives at the nexus of technical expertise and strategic influence, and who is passionate about protecting customers while enabling Amazon to operate responsibly at scale.

Key job responsibilities
Serve as the Senior Policy Expert for chemical and environmental compliance, establishing Amazon's definitive policy positions on product compliance with relevant global laws and regulations.

Lead and manage a team of junior subject matter experts, providing mentorship, coaching, and professional development to help them deepen their expertise and expand their knowledge across compliance domains.

Develop, author, and maintain policies related to key regulatory areas including but not limited to:
PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances) restrictions
Heavy metals regulations and limits
DOE (Department of Energy) compliance
EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) regulatory requirements

Collaborate cross-functionally with legal teams and category teams to ensure product compliance across Amazon's catalog and to align policy positions with business needs.

Engage directly with external regulators and government bodies to represent and explain Amazon's compliance positions, advocate for practical regulatory approaches, and stay ahead of emerging regulatory developments.

Monitor the evolving global regulatory landscape for chemical and environmental compliance, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that impact Amazon's product offerings.

Drive alignment across stakeholders to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance policies across regions and product categories.

Basic qualifications

- Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- 8+ years of professional experience in chemical compliance, environmental compliance, or a closely related regulatory field.
- Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Chemistry, Environmental Science, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology, Environmental Policy, or a related discipline.
- Deep subject matter expertise in one or more of the following: PFAS, Proposition 65, heavy metals, DOE, EPA regulations, or equivalent chemical/environmental regulatory frameworks.
- Strong understanding of global product compliance laws and the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable policy.

Preferred qualifications

- Management experience — prior experience leading, mentoring, and developing a team of compliance professionals or subject matter experts.
- Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant scientific or policy field.
- Experience engaging directly with regulatory agencies (EPA, state-level bodies, international regulators).
- Familiarity with product safety and compliance in an e-commerce or retail environment.
- Experience working cross-functionally with legal, product, and category management teams.
- Knowledge of emerging global chemical regulations (e.g., EU REACH, RoHS, TSCA reform).

locations: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon is seeking a motivated and data-driven category manager to support the Americas data center construction space. The candidate should have strong supply chain and procurement skills, engineering design, architecture, construction, analytical and financial acumen , and passion to dive-deep. Additionally, candidate must have proven skills in managing large-scale supply chain and procurement improvement projects.
As a Procurement Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for at least one services category and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to drive efficiencies, reduce risks, and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. You will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category.
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You will be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you will be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines, succeed in a fast-paced environment; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit.
A successful candidate will demonstrate:
· Proven experience driving large-scale process improvements resulting in measurable value
· High attention to detail including proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
· Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
· Demonstrated ability to influence teams to adopt change utilizing smart technologies
· Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where ambiguity exists and continuous innovation is desired
· Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
· Demonstrated analytical, financial and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
· Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; general manager / owner mentality
· Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the competitive landscape
· Ability to see ahead comprehensively and devise a strong plan of action, and ensure execution happens on time, every time
· Ability to get things done and produce conclusive, measurable results within time commitments
· Strong influencing skills




A day in the life

As a Procurement Manager on the Data Center Construction Procurement team, you will own the end-to-end commercial relationship with General Contractors (GCs) delivering AWS data centers. No two days look the same — you might be negotiating a Guaranteed Maximum Price in the morning, reviewing schedule recovery options with a project team at midday, and evaluating GC proposals for a new campus RFP by close of business.

Day to day you will:

Drive competitive sourcing events — develop RFP strategies, evaluate contractor qualifications, and lead award recommendations for some of the largest construction programs in the industry.
Negotiate and manage contracts — structure contract amendments, negotiate change orders, and hold GCs accountable to cost, schedule, and safety commitments.
Partner cross-functionally — work alongside Construction, Design, Legal, Finance, and Program Management to remove blockers, align on delivery milestones, and ensure data center capacity comes online on time.
Analyze cost and risk — benchmark GC pricing, identify cost-savings opportunities, and flag commercial risks before they become schedule impacts.
Influence at scale — develop procurement playbooks, contract standards, and lessons-learned that raise the bar across AWS's global data center portfolio.
You will support projects across multiple regions and have the opportunity to shape how AWS procures and delivers data center construction — locally and globally.
