title: Robot Technician, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a hands-on, resourceful, and detail-oriented Field Technician to support the maintenance, testing and operation of our advanced robotic systems. As a Field Technician, you will be responsible not only for preparing and maintaining the robotic platforms but also for representing our company in the field, adapting to unexpected challenges, and directly supporting testing with professionalism and technical expertise. As part of this role, you will also assist with production processes for the business and provide continuous improvement in terms of processes and instruction guides. For this position, we can unfortunately only accept applications from citizens of Schengen Area countries.

Key job responsibilities
● On-site Troubleshooting and First Response: Independently diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, and software issues, often under time pressure and changing conditions, utilizing established ticketing systems.
● Customer Interaction and Reporting: Serve as the technical point of contact for customers during field operations, providing clear communication, professional support, and post-mission reporting to internal teams.
● Data Collection and Reporting: Collect operational data, monitor system logs, and provide insights to engineering teams for system refinement.
● Preventive Maintenance and Inspection: Perform scheduled maintenance routines, visual inspections, and component replacements to maximize system uptime and extend hardware life.
● Production and Assembly Support: Assist with robot assembly, sub-system integration, and quality checks during production runs, ensuring builds meet engineering specifications.
● Process Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Create, update, and refine work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deployment checklists based on field learnings and evolving best practices.
● Inventory and Spare Parts Management: Track spare parts, consumables, and tooling; coordinate restocking and ensure field kits are complete and deployment-ready.
● Safety and Compliance: Uphold workplace health and safety standards across workshop and field environments, including proper handling of batteries, electrical systems, and heavy equipment.
● Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with software, hardware, and operations engineers to relay field observations, validate fixes, and support iterative design improvements.
● Test Execution and Validation: Support structured testing campaigns—both in the lab and in the field—by following test protocols, recording results, and flagging anomalies for engineering review.


About the team
RIVR is a Swiss robotics company pioneering Physical AI and robotic solutions to revolutionize last-mile delivery, giving 1 human the power of 1000. Through the combination of artificial neural networks and innovative robot designs with wheels and legs, RIVR aims to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and scalability in last-mile delivery. Founded as Swiss-Mile, the company rebranded to RIVR in 2025 to better reflect its mission of driving the future of intelligent robotics. Join our innovative team, renowned for pioneering robotic design and neural network applications in robotics that improve environmental understanding and decision-making. With a robust research foundation and notable contributions from ETH Zurich, we are leaders in translating artificial intelligence and robotics into practical, real-world applications.
RIVR is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
- Degree or apprenticeship in mechatronics, robotics, or equivalent.
- Proven ability to work independently in the field, diagnose problems under pressure, and perform quick, effective repairs without immediate supervision.
- Ability to follow structured procedures, deployment checklists, safety protocols, and quality standards even in dynamic environments.
- Willingness and ability to travel to field locations - sometimes on short notice. Interest in both maintaining and operating robotics systems

Preferred qualifications

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

title: Sr Product Developer - Food & Bev, Product Development & Sensory
descriptionHtml:
Leads ideation, development, and commercialization of Private Brand Food and Beverage products. Partners cross-functionally with Sourcing, Regulatory, Nutrition, Quality, and Compliance teams to bring products to market that meet Whole Foods Market (WFM), Amazon, and regulatory standards.

Key job responsibilities
Ideation & Insights
- Identify trending ingredients and products using market research, trend-mapping, category insights, competitor shops, and trend treks.
- Research consumer trends and synthesize findings into actionable category insights.

Formulation & Development
- Lead product development, including comparisons against target products and sensory benchmarks.
- Drive formulation development by identifying benchtop and/or retail gold standards.
- Lead organoleptic evaluations and vendor sample comparisons.
- Work with the sensory team to design and execute sensory testing to reduce evaluation bias.
- Communicate sensory, nutritional, and quality parameters to vendors; provide feedback and reformulation requests.

Launch & Production
- Manage first production activities: send requirements, lead conference calls, and oversee vendor execution.
- Evaluate first production samples against approved retains and issue approval/release decisions.
- Attend first productions as needed.

Quality & Compliance
- Review and evaluate supplier-submitted product and formulation specifications; communicate findings to stakeholders promptly.
- Collaborate with Product Safety and Quality teams on input and feedback.
- Evaluate, validate, and finalize product preparation instructions where applicable.
- Uphold WFM and Amazon quality and brand standards; resolve quality discrepancies with internal teams and vendors.

Supplier & Cross-Functional Support
- Help identify new co-packing partners and support co-packers in sourcing raw materials.
- Visit suppliers to review capabilities and explore innovation opportunities.

Other
- Support special projects, including competitive product evaluations and rollout of new policies and technologies.
- Perform other miscellaneous product development duties as necessary.

A day in the life
Part of the appeal of a Product Developer job is the varied activities from day to day and mix of desk work and hands on product work. A day in the life might include a specification review for a new product, a cutting, some competitive shopping, and a meeting with your cross-functional stakeholders who help develop products (Sourcing, Nutrition, Food Safety, Logistics, Packaging, Quality, Sensory, Project Manager).

Basic qualifications

- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- 6-8 years of product development experience in CPG, grocery retail, or ingredient industries.
- Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Food Science, or related field
- Willing and able to sample and evaluate all types of food.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); experience with AI tools and writing prompts.
- Available for occasional travel (<20%) to conferences, trade shows, vendor sites, and first productions.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing natural and organic products.
- Sensory evaluation background.
- Genuine passion for food, beverage, and the culinary world.
- Knowledge of nutrition/labeling (NFL) regulations as they relate to product development.
- Familiarity with retailer web-based specification systems.
- Usage of generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency, with a willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices.
- Ability to recognize opportunities where generative AI could enhance products, workflows, or customer experiences.

title: Ingeniero/a de Automatización Industrial
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of everything Amazon does, and automation is one of the ways we optimise our processes. As an Automation Engineer, you’ll make sure that our automated systems are working at their best so that our customers get their orders on time. By exploring data on everything from control systems to sensors, you’ll maximise the availability of equipment at your sites. This role puts you at the forefront of Amazon’s emerging technology to solve complex productivity challenges.

Key job responsibilities
Monitor, troubleshoot and repair issues with key systems
Work with the EU Controls network to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics
Provide data visualisations of troubleshooting to internal stakeholders
Own or actively participate in continuous improvement projects run by the EU Controls network
Work with different departments to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained
Work with global colleagues to install and commission new equipment
Support other sites in the EU Controls network as needed
Interpret mechanical and electrical drawings, and develop improvement strategies for code conforming to IEC 61131-3

A day in the life
As an Automation Engineer, you’ll be the site expert when it comes to keeping key automated systems running smoothly. You’ll be working with our automation machinery, from conveyors to sortation systems, and ensuring they’re working efficiently. If something has gone wrong or can be done better, you’ll take the lead in coming up with and implementing a solution.

You’ll also share your expertise with your close colleagues. You’ll be keeping your Engineering Technicians up to date with device troubleshooting and preventative maintenance control training, so that your team can keep our automation systems in order.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de ingenieros de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) se encarga de que nuestros sistemas funcionen a pleno rendimiento. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra gran aptitud técnica y nuestra excelente capacidad para el trabajo en equipo, liderados por unos responsables con gran experiencia. Nuestro trabajo comprende el mantenimiento, la reparación y la solución de problemas relacionados con los equipos en toda nuestra red mundial de centros de distribución. El equipo cuenta con una serie de perfiles de dirección que se encargan de supervisar el desarrollo de tecnologías fascinantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.
Nuestro equipo se ocupa de la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon, desempeñando tareas que van desde la instalación de sistemas automatizados de embalaje hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un centro o la reparación de equipos clave de distribución. Esto incluye adaptar los edificios a la legislación vigente, para que todo el personal esté seguro y nuestras instalaciones funcionen con la mayor eficiencia posible. El equipo de RME, al igual que ocurre en otros departamentos de Amazon, ofrece numerosas oportunidades de progresar profesionalmente.
Todo nuestro trabajo gira en torno a reducir los periodos de inactividad en los centros de operaciones cruciales de Amazon, para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Con frecuencia, trabajamos de madrugada o a altas horas de la noche para poder realizar las tareas de mantenimiento ocasionando las mínimas molestias, por lo que hacemos turnos nocturnos. Si descubrimos que hay una forma mejor de hacer algo, tenemos la capacidad y la posibilidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos totalmente nuevos o tecnología punta, como Amazon Robotics y nuestro clasificador de artículos complejos.

Basic qualifications

- Relevant experience with PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Relevant experience supporting different conveyors and sortation systems
- Relevant experience dealing with material handling, flow and capacity visualisation, and monitoring
- Experience with at least one of the following tools:
- Microsoft Office, project management tools and EPLAN
- Ladder Logic and structure programming from Siemens, Allen-Brady or Codesys PLCs
- Ignition SCADA or similar platform and Human Machine Interface (HMI)
- EthernetIP, Profinet, Profibus and AS-i or other fieldbus networks
- VFDs, safety gateways and input and output devices
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, industrial electronics or another technical subject
- Experience working within ISO 13849 and ISO 62061 frameworks
- Experience working in a multi-site environment
- Project management experience with multiple frameworks such as Agile and Waterfall
- Experience of Six Sigma, data analysis or process improvement techniques

title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical, Selling Partner Support Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Selling Partner Support handles tens of millions of contacts annually worldwide. The Selling Partner Support Engagement (SPSE) team owns the technical products and features that enable the end to end support journey. We are in the midst of transforming support into an AI-native agent support experience and redefining how and where sellers can resolve their issues.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Technical (Sr. PMT) who will own part of the product strategy for shaping net new support experiences. You'll own defining the experience, the integration model, and the trust framework for these net new interactions. This means working hands-on with engineering and applied science teams to make decisions about how AI-powered support capabilities translate to new environments.

This is a highly ambiguous space with no established playbook. You'll need to work across multiple teams to align on a path forward, influence without authority, and ship iteratively while building the long-term vision. You'll be expected to drive alignment with senior leaders and make judgments calls in areas where the data is limited and the right answer isn't obvious. If you are energized by working seller-backwards, operating in ambiguous environments, and bringing structure and definition (all while having fun), then you'll like this role!

Key job responsibilities
-Own the product strategy for one or more net new support channels, from zero-to-one definition through launch and iteration

-Define the requirements and partner with engineering and applied science to figure out the right technical approach — what to build, what to reuse, and where the hard problems are

-Design and run the pilot strategy: define who gets it first, what we're testing, what "good" looks like, and how we decide to scale or kill it

-Build the go-to-market plan — how sellers discover and adopt support on a new surface, and how we tell that story internally to Associates and externally

-Define how we measure quality and build the auditing approach for support interactions happening on surfaces we don't fully control

-Partner closely with teams across Amazon — aligning roadmaps, building shared plans, and creating durable working relationships with teams that own adjacent parts of the seller experience

-Write clear, compelling documents for senior leadership that frame the strategy, the trade-offs, and the path forward, and reporting on progress in biweekly leadership forums


A day in the life
You might start the day sitting in on a seller interview with your UX Research partner, hearing firsthand what's working and what isn't. Then you're in a room with engineering and science reviewing pilot metrics, deciding what to adjust and what to cut. After lunch you're tightening up a document that recommends whether or not to launch a new experience, knowing leadership will push on your reasoning. And by end of day you're drafting the early vision for a channel that doesn't exist yet, working with adjacent teams to figure out where to start.

About the team
Our team is based in Seattle and at the center of redefining how millions of Selling Partners get support from Amazon. We are a small, high-ownership and visibility team that partners closely with other support and agentic teams across Amazon. Day to day, we work directly with applied scientists, UX designers, UX researchers, engineers and program managers to build and ship new experiences that don't exist yet. We move quickly, hold a high bar, and have fun doing it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

title: Sr Business Analyst, Competitive Intelligence, Whole Foods Market
descriptionHtml:
Whole Foods Market is looking for a sharp, driven, and analytically minded Business Analyst II to join our Competitive Intelligence team. You will own end-to-end analyses that illuminate the competitive grocery landscape — translating retailer pricing, assortment, and performance data into strategic insights that directly shape our business. As the analytics go-to for competitive intelligence, you'll turn complex competitive data into clear, decision-ready guidance.

This is a high-visibility role with real impact. The right candidate brings a strong foundation in retail merchandising, dives deep into complex pricing and assortment performance metrics, understands the business context behind the data, and continuously strives for deeper insight. As AI accelerates the pace of our work, you'll help shape what's next for competitive analytics — building scalable, self-serve reporting and leveraging emerging AI capabilities to accelerate time-to-insight.

This role goes beyond reporting: you'll conduct deep-dive analyses on pricing, assortment, and competitive positioning, surfacing the "so what" behind the data. Partnering closely with Pricing & Merchandising leaders, you'll develop strategy, launch case studies, and deliver clear, actionable findings — building repeatable analytical frameworks that improve the team's speed and depth over time. We're looking for someone who combines analytical depth with the ability to communicate clearly to senior stakeholders and who thrives on ownership and continuous improvement.

Competitive intelligence is a strategic priority at Whole Foods Market. You'll have the opportunity to shape how we understand and respond to the competitive landscape, with the data, resources, and leadership support to make a real difference.

Skills
Strong ownership mindset — you dive deep, take accountability for your work, and earn trust through consistent delivery
Expert-level SQL (Redshift preferred) and BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau); R or Python a plus
Experience building scalable dashboards and self-serve reporting that drive adoption
Strong quantitative reasoning — comfortable with large, complex datasets and ambiguous questions
Excellent communication — able to distill complex analyses into crisp narratives for senior stakeholders
Proactive and curious — you track food, retail, market news, and natural-products trends, read popular and trade press widely, and experiment with new tools (including AI/ML)
A strong foundation in retail merchandising that lets you contextualize pricing and assortment data within broader market dynamics, operating at both the detail and strategic levels

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end competitive analyses — scope, design, execute, and communicate deep-dives on pricing, assortment, and competitive positioning that surface the "so what" behind the data
Gather retail pricing, assortment, promotion, and location data on competitors, leveraging third-party sources and primary research
Build scalable, self-serve reporting in QuickSight and Redshift SQL that lets stakeholders access competitive insights without analyst dependency
Serve as the analytics subject-matter expert and go-to resource for Global and Regional Merchandising teams in competitive situations
Analyze competitive data to inform strategy, highlight opportunities, and drive recommendations for pricing and assortment adjustments
Partner closely with Pricing & Merchandising leaders to develop strategy, launch case studies, and deliver actionable findings
Build repeatable, scalable analytical frameworks that improve the team's speed and depth
Communicate results clearly to senior business leaders, translating complex data into concise narratives
Accelerate time-to-insight by leveraging emerging AI capabilities and automation
Contribute as a key analytical voice on the Competitive Intelligence team, sharing best practices with fellow analysts

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing a competitor's latest price moves, spotting a gap and opportunity. You inspect a dashboard you built for Merchandising that lets them slice competitive results without filing a request. Mid-morning, you dig into a vendor data feed to validate pricing coverage, then meet with a Merchandising leader to discuss their category's competitive positioning. After lunch, you present findings to a Director-level audience, turning the "so what" into clear action items. You close the day exploring an AI-powered workflow that could halve your analysis time and refining a reusable framework for competitive deep-dives.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS Tools and Technologies (Redshift, S3, EC2)
- Experience utilizing R or Python
- Experience with AI/ML technologies
- Grocery, retail, or CPG industry experience
- Familiarity with competitive price measurement, assortment analytics, pricing analytics, or merchandising analytics

title: Sr. Engineer, JP Robotics
descriptionHtml:
アマゾン社は、何百万の商品をお客様へ提供し続けることによって、世界的に認知度が高く、グローバルリーディングカンパニ—としての地位を確立しています。また、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業”であり続けるため、日々改善と改革を行っており、それらの業務へ貢献できる経験豊富な人材を求めています。

JCFS（Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions／オペレーション技術統括本部）は、アマゾンジャパンのオペレーション業務の中核部門として各部門を効率的に連携し、継続的なプロセス改善とイノベーションを通じて次世代のフルフィルメント能力を創造することをミッションとしています。

本ポジションでは、フルフィルメントセンター（FC）における商品の入出荷設備の自動化計画・導入を担うエンジニアを募集します。迅速な配送スピードと低コストを実現するマテリアルハンドリング・在庫システム等の技術開発エンジニアとして、既存FCに加え新規FCの自動化設備の計画・導入に携わっていただきます。

・グローバルのエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最先端の自動化技術を日本のFCへ導入
・安全性・品質の向上、フルフィルメントコストの削減、入出荷能力の最大化を推進

Key job responsibilities
・グローバルエンジニアリングチームと連携し、最新技術を継続的に把握して日本へ導入。将来日本に必要な技術要件を整理し、新規技術開発を通じて日本のフルフィルメント能力を継続的に向上させる
・複雑な物と情報の流れを理解し、人と機械を組み合わせ、在庫保管設備に合わせた入出荷設備の創案・設計・開発・導入を行う
・大規模なエンジニアリングプロジェクトにおいて技術的なリーダーシップを発揮する
・設備スペック、モノの流れ、プロセス設計、サイトレイアウト、知的財産を考慮し、最適なフルフィルメントソリューションの設計とイノベーション創出をリードする
・社内チームおよび外部ベンダーとコミュニケーション・ネゴシエーションを行い、短期間で高品質かつ低コストの入出荷方法を実現する

A day in the life
朝はグローバルエンジニアリングチームとのMTGで最新の自動化技術をキャッチアップ。日中は担当する入出荷設備の設計レビュー、マテハン・保管設備のスペック検討、プロセス設計やレイアウト最適化を進めます。社内オペレーション部門や外部ベンダーとの打ち合わせで仕様・コスト・納期を調整。週の中では各FCへ出張（約30%）し、現地の設備立ち上げや課題解決を実施。複数部署が関わる大規模プロジェクトで技術的リーダーシップを発揮し、日本のフルフィルメント能力向上を推進します。

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience working with and managing third party vendors
- Experience with Six Sigma, lean manufacturing

title: Chip Design Engineer, Graviton Team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, a fabless semiconductor company, was established by semiconductor industry veterans and is developing leading-edge products manufactured on state-of-the-art technologies. We are looking for talented engineers to help us develop a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.
Take part in the development of state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture. You will have the opportunity to work on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider, in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud, which powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

AWS Graviton is a family of innovative processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), the world's largest leading Cloud vendor.
The Graviton is our own internal home grown solution that re-shaped EC2 offering to AWS customers, and the preferable solution for cloud compute by customers.

We are looking for talented engineers to join our Chip Design team, working on the Graviton product line. Our chip design team is in charge of defining the product's features and working on their architecture and development. Our team members collaborate with multiple teams from different disciplines such as product definition, pre and post silicon validation, physical design, software and others contributing to a full cycle of chip development from idea to mass production. Your design will be integrated into the Graviton products, an important part of the AWS data centers worldwide. This is an opportunity to have a large-scale impact.

Join our innovative team at Annapurna Labs and play a pivotal role in developing next-generation semiconductor platforms that power the world's largest cloud infrastructure. Your expertise will directly contribute to creating transformative chip technologies that shape the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

* AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0
* AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8



Key job responsibilities
* Drive SoC development from micro-architecture definition through tape-out
* Design and implement RTL blocks within a complex semiconductor platform
* Perform system-level debugging and performance analysis
* Lead pre and post-silicon verification activities for your design areas
* Define and execute IP integration strategies
* Ensure quality and reliability standards across your deliverables
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Definition, Verification, Physical Design, and Software Engineering

A day in the life
Your day will be filled with technical challenges and collaborative problem-solving. You'll dive into semiconductor architecture, working on design challenges that require both creative thinking and precise technical execution. Expect to engage with cross-functional teams, prototype innovative solutions, and contribute to chip development that impacts global cloud infrastructure.

About the team
Annapurna Labs started in 2011 as a fabless chip start-up focused on bringing innovation to cloud infrastructure. Acquired by AWS in 2015, we have since developed AWS Nitro technology, AWS Graviton processors, AWS Inferentia & Trainium, and more. Our chip design team defines product features and drives their architecture and development through the full cycle — from concept to mass production.
We combine the agility of a startup with the resources of AWS. Our team collaborates across disciplines — product definition, pre and post-silicon validation, physical design, and software — in a dynamic, open, and fast-paced environment.

Basic qualifications

- BSc in Electrical Engineering / Computer Engineering / Computer Science
- Knowledge of digital logic systems and computer architecture
- Please include your CV and a grade sheet in a single PDF file

Preferred qualifications

- Background in processor or fabric design architectures
- Familiarity with Verilog/System Verilog programming
- Knowledge of communication protocols (AXI, CHI, PCIe, UCIe, DDR)
- Knowledge of CPU architecture
- Familiarity with IP integration concepts
- Fluent English

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Operations Intern
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.
Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.

A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.
This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.
You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship of 3-6 months.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

title: Infra Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the clouds running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.

- Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.
- Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers
- Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
- Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
- Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
- Liaising with internal teams & management groups
- Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
- Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
- Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of people management experience
- 2+ years of data center experience, or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)

title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

- Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

title: Sr. Manager, Post-Silicon Eng, AWS Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services designs and builds the servers and custom silicon that power the world's largest cloud. The Core Hardware team owns the cross-cutting engineering capabilities that every server product depends on: power delivery, PCIe connectivity, signal integrity, CPU and memory quality, board design, thermal and mechanical systems, and the test and quality infrastructure that validates and sustains all of it.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead engineering teams within Core Hardware. This is a manager-of-managers role. Your organization owns PCIe validation and signal integrity, CPU and memory quality engineering, server performance, and test automation infrastructure. These teams are responsible not only for validating that every server platform meets the highest bar for silicon quality, interconnect reliability, and system performance before production, but also for owning the ongoing quality and operational health of those subsystems once they are deployed in the fleet.

This is a technical leadership role with real depth and end-to-end ownership. Your teams operate at the intersection silicon, servers and the fleet, and that boundary does not disappear at production release. They validate PCIe connectivity at the physical and protocol layer, find and resolve bugs in shipped silicon, characterize server performance at scale, build the automation infrastructure that makes all of this repeatable, and then own the outcomes when those platforms are running in production. When a fleet-wide issue surfaces that traces back to silicon, interconnect, or memory behavior, your organization owns the response: root cause, corrective action, and the systemic fix that prevents recurrence. The right leader for this role brings deep fluency in post-silicon validation and uses that fluency to drive outcomes across the full lifecycle, from first silicon through fleet operations.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end technical output and operational health of engineering teams spanning PCIe validation and signal integrity, CPU and memory engineering, server performance, and test automation, from silicon bring-up through fleet deployment and ongoing operations.
• Lead first-line managers and set the technical direction for validation methodology and fleet engineering, ensuring that validation plans, coverage models, debug workflows, and production monitoring strategies reflect the complexity of Amazon's custom server platforms and silicon.
• Build the processes and tooling that connect what your teams learn in validation to how they operate in the fleet, closing the loop between pre-production findings and production outcomes.
• Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for issues that surface at any point in the lifecycle, whether during bring-up, qualification, or in the production fleet. When a fleet-wide issue traces back to silicon, interconnect, or memory behavior, your organization owns the technical response end-to-end: diagnosis, root cause, fix, and the systemic improvement that prevents recurrence.
• Partner with silicon suppliers, firmware, and hardware design teams to drive cross-functional resolution of platform-level issues that span silicon, firmware, board, and operational boundaries.
• Represent your organization's technical findings, fleet health posture, and risk assessments to senior leadership with the depth and clarity expected at the director level and above, translating complex silicon and platform data into actionable decisions for product teams, fleet operations, and architecture teams.
• Build and develop a team of managers engineers who think beyond validation and own outcomes in the fleet, developing the institutional knowledge and end-to-end mindset that Amazon's ownership model demands.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 10+ years of experience in post-silicon validation, silicon bring-up, platform validation, or fleet engineering for server-class hardware.
- 5+ years of engineering management experience with direct people management responsibility.
- 2+ years of experience managing managers, not just individual contributors.
- Direct technical experience with server-class processor debug and validation, including CPU, memory, and high-speed interconnect subsystems such as PCIe, spanning both pre-production validation and production fleet operations.
- Experience owning engineering outcomes across the full product lifecycle, from silicon bring-up through production deployment and ongoing fleet operations, not limited to a hand-off at production release.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with PCIe physical layer signal integrity, including SerDes characterization, compliance testing, and link training debug in both lab and fleet environments.
- Experience with firmware and software validation in a post-silicon environment, including driver-level and protocol-level test development that carries forward into production monitoring and regression.
- Experience building or leading teams that develop test automation infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling used across both validation and fleet-facing engineering workflows.
- Experience with server performance characterization, including memory bandwidth, latency, and CPU microarchitecture-level performance analysis, with the ability to translate findings into fleet-level operational decisions.
- Experience driving root-cause analysis and corrective action for hardware issues discovered in production fleets at scale, including coordination with silicon vendors, firmware teams, and fleet operations.
- Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams, particularly in competitive talent markets or during site buildouts.
- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
· US Citizenship required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

title: Process Engineer , Robotics Manufacturing and Technical Operations (RMTO)
descriptionHtml:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? We apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that delight our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet.

Amazon Robotics (AR) is located in the greater Boston area, the epicenter of robotics innovation. Our diverse team of engineers come from all over the world to design, test and build our dynamic fleet of robots and mechatronic systems. Having our offices, labs, test floors and factories all co-located means that we can design the hardware, write the code, test, build and watch it all come to life. This allows us to innovate quickly and on limitless ideas. Current advancements are underway in robotic movement and mobility, artificial intelligence and machine learning, manipulation, simulation, robotic management software, predictive data, and much more.

The Robotics Manufacturing and Technical Operations (RMTO) organization builds and scales the production systems that bring Amazon's robotic fleet to life. title: Data Quality Specialist - Swedish, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
- Intermediate-level proficiency in English (B2+ or equivalent fluency by CEFR standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
- Experience working with data to identify trends, patterns, and quality issues
- Ability to create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience with external customer interaction
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
- Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
- Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams
- Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments with evolving workflows, priorities, and quality targets
- Experience in machine learning data operations, annotation quality, or content review workflows

descriptionHtml:

- 国内外の協力会社と連携するだけでなく、継続的にそれら協力会社の能力を高め、安全性・品質の向上と低コスト化を推進すること。
- 安全基準とエンジニアリング指針に則り、標準作業作りなどを通してメカニズムを構築し安全な職場を実現すること。

title: Software Development Engineer, ADC2S
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world leader in providing a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world!

Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Experienced in building and leading teams of highly competent software engineers? Want to make a billion-dollar impact? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you.

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud Engineering team is dedicated to building automated platforms and solutions to streamline the AWS build and deployment process in dedicated regions. Our vision is to fully automate and enable zero-touch AWS deployments thereby reducing the time it takes to deploy new features and freeing engineers to focus on building new services and capabilities.

Deployment engineering is a complex process requiring close collaboration with AWS service teams. We are looking for passionate innovators who want to take the challenge. Your work has visibility to leadership across AWS organization and provides huge opportunity to learn new things while solving complex engineer problems, deliver results that make impact on revenue and resources, and grow professionally and personally.

Developers at Amazon work on real world problems on a global scale, own their systems end-to-end, and influence the direction of our technology that impacts hundreds of millions customers around the world. Join a team of super smart, customer obsessed developers that think big and have fun.

This position requires that the candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

A day in the life
On a "typical" day, our engineers may dive deep to find the root cause of a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending in the wrong direction, or discuss radical new approaches to automate operational processes. As a member of our team you will join a dedicated group of engineers who provide automation and scripting support, and innovate to automate operational tasks.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences

- 3+ years of full stack development experience

About the team
About AWS

title: Senior Program Manager - Business Strategy, Amazon Maintenance Operation Center (AMOC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered, from desktop to doorstep. Across the globe we have more than a thousand Fulfillment Centers, thousands of Delivery Stations, tens of thousands of machines, and hundreds of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team, within the Amazon Maintenance Operations Center International (AMOC INTL), a 24/7/365 centralized remote maintenance function serving field RME teams across 845+ buildings so they can focus on hands-on maintenance.

Purpose of job

We are seeking a seasoned Strategy & Business Operations Manager to own the strategy, planning, and rhythm-of-business that enables AMOC INTL to scale its four service pillars across EU, India, LATAM, Australia, and new markets.:
- Refrigeration & Building Maintenance (BBM/RBM)
- Planned & Compliance Maintenance (PPM)
- Purchase-to-Pay (P2P)
- Electric Vehicle Charging (EVC)

This is an individual contributor role operating at organizational scope. The successful candidate sets strategy and standards across the entire AMOC INTL organization, partnering with pillar leaders and regional hubs rather than managing a team. They will own the multi-year planning cadence, the single source of truth for AMOC data, and the expansion workstreams into new countries, removing the internal silos that naturally form in a multi-service organization of AMOC's scale and ensuring the organization plans ahead of demand rather than reacting to it. The role carries influence across the full International organization and its leadership, shaping decisions that span pillars, regions, and multi-year horizons.

Key job responsibilities
- Organization-wide strategy and planning. Own AMOC INTL's strategy and planning rhythm end-to-end (SPS/3YP, OP1/OP2, goal setting) across all four pillars and regions, translating leadership direction into structured multi-year plans and roadmaps. This includes owning the organization's recurring narratives, MBRs, leadership reviews, and executive-ready documents on a predictable cadence that holds the whole organization to a single planning heartbeat.

- Country and market expansion. Drive expansion into new countries (e.g. India, Middle East, South Africa) alongside the RP3 Senior Team Lead, productizing a repeatable country-launch model (workload baseline, vendor onboarding, SOP templates, HC gearing, go-live checklist) so growth scales without scaling effort linearly.

- Data ownership and single source of truth. Own the definitions and governance of AMOC's cross-pillar data layer: a unified vocabulary (work order, autonomous resolution, cost-per-asset, vendor score) applied identically across all pillars and hubs, plus the v1 metric set committed in the 3YP (machine-based uptime, vendor performance scorecards, cost-per-asset, centralized energy dashboards). Owns the standard, not the weekly reporting.

- Cross-regional partnership and de-siloing. Operate as the connective tissue across BBM, PPM, P2P, and EVC and across the BCN1 and HYD16 hubs, standardizing SOPs and operating models, including the follow-the-sun blueprint, so services are delivered consistently regardless of geography.

- Stakeholder alignment and capacity planning. Partner with Finance, pillar leaders, and senior stakeholders across NA, LATAM, APAC, EU RME, the Global Central Team, Procurement/GPO, and the RP3 program to connect confirmed network launches to headcount and gearing inputs, and align AMOC strategy with senior and executive leadership goals.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related field or (equivalent work experience)

- Demonstrated ownership of multi-year planning cycles and executive rhythm-of-business documents (narratives, reviews, reporting) for senior leadership.experience operating at organization or multi-team scope.
- Strong written-narrative skills and the ability to synthesize complex cross-functional inputs into clear, data-backed documents for senior and executive leadership audiences.
- Proven ability to influence and deliver across multiple teams and regions without direct authority.

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems
- Experience driving multi-country or multi-region expansion / launch work streams at scale.
- Familiarity with Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering) systems and tooling (APM, Compass, QuickSight, Quick Suite Spaces) and with metric-definition / data-governance work.
- Experience building repeatable, scalable playbooks and standardized operating models across a broad organization.

title: Installation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation,
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience, or experience in similar technical or vocational roles

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+)
- Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Review quarterly maintenance results and action items for BMS/EPMS and drive resolution.

Attend project meetings, coordinate with project leaders, and report status to Controls management.
