descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Interested in joining our dedicated team at Amazon that makes the return of pickup and packages convenient for our customers at our Locker+ retail locations? Curious to be at the heart of where innovation meets customer obsession? Customer Experience Operations (CXO) is an exciting organization within Amazon specializing in delighting our customers with quality service in an ever-changing environment. Our goal is to go beyond assisting with customer orders. We strive to connect personally with our customers and uplift their lives – even if for just a few moments. We operate out of designated retail locations – where it’s convenient for our customers – helping facilitate the delivery and return of customer orders.

About the Role

We seek an Area Manager to bring Amazon’s customer obsession to life. In this role, you’ll oversee operations across multiple locations, leading shift leaders to deliver exceptional customer experiences. You’ll cultivate a dynamic team culture rooted in customer obsession, trust, respect, continuous learning, and enthusiasm.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead shift leads and associates, overseeing hiring, onboarding, performance, and career growth.
- Drive daily operations by executing SOPs, identifying improvements, implementing solutions, and providing training.
- Foster a customer-focused culture aligned with Amazon’s Leadership Principles.
- Track key metrics, manage performance inputs, and present results in business reviews.
- Oversee multiple sites, prioritize time effectively, and develop strong store leadership.
- Ensure a safe, clean, and secure environment for employees, customers, and packages.
- Handle escalations and guide associates on issue resolution.
- Travel 50-75% between locations.
- Work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Lift up to 49 lbs and stand for shifts up to 10 hours.
- Must be at least 18 years old.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in customer-facing leadership roles
- Experience in problem solving and delivering results
- Experience working independently with minimal supervision
- 2+ years leadership experience in a customer-facing retail, hospitality, or grocery environment, or 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience, or Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions and implement effective solutions
- 2+ years of people management leading teams of 20 experience
- Experience developing and managing a high-performing team

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Certificate Services
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) team is in need of engineers who want to change the way developers across the world think of TLS/SSL certificates. You will work with AWS customers and internal developers on projects critical to the security of communications and identity on the internet. You will get the opportunity to change the way systems interact with certificates, turning a traditionally painful interaction to a painless and automated experience. With your help, we will turn certificate expiration and unencrypted connections into a thing of the past.

We value individuals who don’t accept the status quo. We value those who push leadership and their peers to do the right things for the right reasons. Ideas don’t come from the top, but as a collaboration across all levels. We succeed by enabling and encouraging ideas from all the voices in the room.

You’ll have the freedom to choose from a wide range of technologies to solve complex problems. You will learn how to apply world-class distributed computing practices and deployment safety standards in the world of interconnected, managed, cloud-based services.

ACM is part of the larger AWS Cryptography organization. AWS Crypto is a diverse mix of smart, hardworking, and amusing people who build customer-facing products, encryption libraries, and perform research into the future of cryptographic standards. If you love cryptography and security software, there isn’t a better place to be. If you don’t know anything about security, you’ll learn about it in a supportive and passionate environment.

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Hardware Technical Program Manager, Ring
descriptionHtml:
As a Hardware Program Manager, you'll lead innovative hardware from ideation to production, spearheading the end-to-end development of smart home devices. In this crucial role, you'll orchestrate cross-functional teams across global locations, including platform, hardware, image, motion, operations, and quality assurance experts. You'll drive hardware deliverables from concept to production, ensuring seamless integration and timely delivery while navigating fast-paced product development cycles. Your responsibilities will include overseeing program status, managing critical issues, and allocating resources strategically to meet ambitious deadlines and quality standards.

We're looking for a candidate who can thrive in an open, collaborative environment that values responsiveness, flexibility, and a can-do attitude. You should have strong engineering-oriented product development experience, exceptional communication skills (both written and verbal), and expertise in consumer electronics, particularly in IP camera-related products. The ability to excel in rapid development cycles and manage multiple priorities effectively is crucial, as is enthusiasm for working with diverse, global teams.

Key job responsibilities
• Creating comprehensive, high-level product development schedules

• Managing end-to-end hardware development status with clear and detailed documentation. Hosting weekly status update and program review meetings

• Producing excellent documentation on risk assessments, issue escalations, and decision logs to support informed decision-making

• Demonstrating proactive problem-solving by identifying potential issues early and delegating to appropriate team members for swift resolution

• Efficiently tracking and managing engineering changes and validation status.

• Orchestrating seamless coordination between internal teams and external partners throughout the product lifecycle

• Co-leading the Request for Quotation (RFQ) process and spearheading RFQ package preparation

• Overseeing certification processes and ensuring compliance through cross-functional team collaboration

• Thriving in a fast-paced environment by effectively managing multiple tasks and priorities

• Being prepared for up to 20% travel, including international trips, to support global project needs and foster team collaboration

In this role, you'll be the driving force behind our product development process, ensuring smooth operations from concept to launch while maintaining our high standards of innovation and quality.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 6+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 4+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 6+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

Preferred qualifications

- 7+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about keeping critical infrastructure running at massive scale? As a Data Center Controls Engineer on the global controls team, you will troubleshoot complex issues, manage projects, and maintain the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) that govern the mechanical and electrical systems powering Amazon data centers. You will develop new processes and standards while finding creative ways to improve controls across a rich ecosystem of generators, uninterruptible power supplies, switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, transfer switches, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, and air handling units. These components interact through open and proprietary communications protocols, and you will be at the center of ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, configure, validate, commission, and maintain BMS and EPMS systems while training internal stakeholders on their operation and best practices.
- Plan and execute BMS and EPMS improvement projects end-to-end, defining scope, schedule, budget, and coordinating with partner teams and vendors to deliver on time.
- Troubleshoot high-complexity controls issues, review and iterate on sequences of operation, and develop or modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
- Serve as a technical escalation point for in-service data centers, participating in the global on-call rotation and guiding less experienced engineers through risk mitigation during emergent situations.
- Develop risk assessments and operational dashboards, review quarterly maintenance results, and drive corrective actions to continuously improve equipment reliability.

A day in the life
Your morning may start with a review of overnight BMS alerts and coordination with the on-call team to prioritize open items. From there, you could be on-site at a data center validating a controls sequence change alongside a vendor, then shifting to a project planning session where you scope an EPMS upgrade with partner engineering teams. You will regularly move between hands-on technical work and collaborative discussions with operations, commissioning, and design teams, balancing immediate troubleshooting needs with longer-term improvement projects.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, and customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our products and services to power their businesses. The global controls team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services, working alongside operations, networking, security, and commissioning teams to ensure data center mechanical and electrical systems perform reliably at scale.

We value varied experiences and encourage candidates to apply even if their career has followed a non-traditional path. Our employee-led affinity groups and ongoing learning experiences create an inclusive culture where you can grow, share knowledge, and make a meaningful impact on the infrastructure that keeps the cloud running.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with Industrial Controls Systems, both hardware and software.
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent engineering science plus 5+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 10+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- 5+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).
- 4+ years of general project or vendor management experience (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, and RFI and submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.
- Experiencing using common industrial communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS).
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements, and navigate difficult situations.
- Experience designing data centers or critical MEP infrastructure
- Registered as a Professional Engineer (PE), or certified Project Management Professional (PMP).
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience
- 4+ Yr. Military Service

title: Principal Design Technologist, AWS Search, Security, Observability, & Governance
descriptionHtml:
Are you the person who makes a bold interaction idea technically real? AWS is looking for a Principal Design Technologist to serve as technical advisor for AWS SSOG (Security, Search, Observability & Governance).

You'll sit at the center of a self-learning intelligence flywheel: our Delight Lab validates novel interaction models — graduated autonomy, step-level replay, policy-check loops — and you make them real, stress-testing them through high-fidelity prototypes and landing them as production-ready components in our Rhythm design system on AWS Core. This is a deep-craft builder role with outsized leverage: every pattern you prove out compounds across the portfolio. If you live in the codebase, think in systems, and want your prototypes to become the standard the whole org ships against, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the Director of Design's technical advisor on innovation: judge which novel interaction models emerging from Delight Lab are worth betting on, and chart the path to make them real.
- Push the frontier of agentic interaction design — graduated autonomy, step-level replay, policy-check loops — proving out ideas no one has shipped yet through high-fidelity, working prototypes.
- Invent the patterns, not just implement them: originate new interaction models and reusable components where none exist, and set the technical standard for what "state of the art" means across SSOG.
- Turn breakthrough prototypes into production-ready Rhythm components on AWS Core, so every validated innovation compounds across six products and counting instead of being re-solved.
- Build the connective tissue of the innovation flywheel, the tooling and systems that let the team sense, synthesize, and scale emerging interaction patterns faster.
- De-risk the boldest bets: stress-test feasibility early so the org can commit to ambitious ideas with confidence rather than retreating to safe ones.
- Raise the innovation bar of the entire design org through prototypes, patterns, and pairing, making everyone around you braver and more technical.

A day in the life
Your morning might start in Delight Lab's latest findings — a graduated-autonomy model that tested well — and by mid-morning you're building a working prototype to pressure-test whether it holds up technically, not just in a research setting. After lunch, you're pairing with design-system engineering to turn an approval-gate pattern you proved last week into a production Rhythm component, so every team gets it for free. Later, you're in a working session with the Director of Design, giving a direct read on which emerging interaction models are feasible, which need another pass, and what it'll take to ship them. This team builds in production, not in Figma — and your prototypes are how the org decides what's real.

About the team
We're the SSOG Transformers design team, shaping how builders experience AWS Security, Search, Observability & Governance. We operate as an AI-native builder team running a self-learning intelligence flywheel: our internal design research practice (Delight Lab) senses and validates how people and AI actually collaborate — when they hand off control, when autonomy should be earned through evidence — Design Brain helps us synthesize those signals, and Rhythm scales the proven patterns into a production design system on AWS Core. We don't hand off specs and wait. We prototype, commit production code, run experiments, and compound every validated pattern across six products and counting. If you want your technical craft to set the standard the whole org builds on, this is the team to join.

Basic qualifications

- A demonstrable portfolio of shipped, production-grade interfaces you built — not just prototyped — for complex, data-dense technical products (observability, security, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure).
- Expert front-end engineering ability: you build high-fidelity, interactive prototypes and commit production code (React/TypeScript, HTML/CSS), and partner with engineering as a peer in the codebase.
- Experience building and maintaining design-system components at scale, architecture, accessibility, and cross-team adoption.
- Experience translating novel, ambiguous interaction concepts into technically validated, shippable patterns.
- Experience operating at Staff/Principal level (or equivalent) as a design technologist, creative technologist, or design engineer at a top-tier technology company.
- A track record of influence as a technical advisor or force-multiplier across teams, raising others' craft through prototypes, tooling, and example rather than direct authority alone.

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience prototyping AI/ML and agentic experiences — autonomous agents, human-in-the-loop, progressive/graduated autonomy, step-level replay, policy-check loops.
- Experience building the tooling or systems that let a team sense, synthesize, and scale interaction patterns (design-intelligence pipelines, pattern libraries, instrumentation).
- Direct experience in observability, security, search, or governance product domains.
- Experience taking research or lab findings and operationalizing them into a production design system.
- Proficiency with AI-assisted design and build tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro, v0).
- Published thought leadership or recognized open-source/community contributions in design engineering.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field plus 3+ years of relevant controls experience, OR 8+ years of relevant controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- 3+ years of experience with industrial controls in critical environment (data center, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, oil & gas, petrochemical, laboratory, power, water etc.).
- 2+ years of general project or vendor management experience (request for proposals, bidding, change orders, quality control, and RFI and submittal tracking) associated with construction and project execution.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls or Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, software and networks.

title: Sr Incident Response Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of Redmond, WA, USA .

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Have you wanted an opportunity to secure an advanced satellite broadband telecom service? The Amazon Leo team owns the security of product and operations of Amazon Leo end-to-end. We provide the necessary infrastructure and mechanisms to ensure the security of our satellite constellation and to protect the integrity and confidentiality of our customer data. Our team drives the research & development, deployment and operation of several mission-critical security systems and mechanisms. As a Senior Security Engineer on the Amazon Leo Incident Response team, you work tactically with both internal and external stakeholders to respond to and root cause security issues and solve them at massive scale. The role requires you to think strategically to develop and implement changes to drive automation, scalability and continuous progress for the organization.

Security Engineers in this role will be members of the Leo Incident Response Operations (LIRO) team, a team which drives emergent security issues across Leo environments to closure. LIRO works in close partnership with other AmSec security teams to contain, eradicate and recover from threats to Leo's highly differentiated environments.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen.

Key job responsibilities
* Supply oversight of in-flight security issues.
* Triage new incoming issues to determine the level of risk they present to Amazon Leo, and then accordingly prioritize its remediation in conjunction with the impacted builder teams.
* Communicate the state of these issues to various audiences, both technical and non-technical, at various levels of seniority (up to and including Chief Information Security Officer).
* Escalate issues to senior Amazon Leo leadership if you feel your issues are not being treated at the correct pace due to their impact to ensure that we are putting customers first.
* Explore building and improving our tooling to make your own life easier, and at the same time, sharing that benefit with all our engineers globally.

An ideal candidate should be able to conduct most of the following:

* Participate in efforts to promote security throughout the Company and build good working relationships within the team and with others across Amazon.
* Demonstrate high ability and tolerance for context switching and interruptions while staying productive and effective.
* Develop pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while keeping an acceptable level of risk.
* Help with recruiting activities and administrative work.
* Mentoring of junior staff and proactive knowledge sharing within the team and across the company.
* Fulfill regular on-call responsibilities.

A day in the life
In the morning you will take handover from the previous shift and be delegated ownership of various security issues presently in-flight. The issues could relate to any of our Amazon Leo products, so you will often need to learn on the go.

You will engage various stakeholders, such as the internal builder teams who actually needs to fix the issue, along with Amazon Leo Leadership, Legal, and the leadership from the impacted team.

As the day progresses, new issues will be assigned to you based on your workload and you will be responsible for triaging them, determining their level of impact, and work towards resolving them at the appropriate pace.

At the end of the shift, you will document all the issues you are tracking so they can be taken over by the team member relieving you.

You will have down time and space to work on strategic projects to improve the quality and/or speed of your team’s deliveries, or to raise the security bar across Amazon Leo at scale.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing experience
- 4+ years of non-internship background in troubleshooting systems issues, analyzing logs, or automating complex tasks using command line tools experience
- 5+ years of work in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

title: Data Center Materials Associate, Corporate IT Logistics, Operations, IT, & Support Engineering
descriptionHtml:

We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the customer experience. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Amazon's IT Logistics and Imaging Team (ITS-LIT) operates a warehouse-scale production floor that images, provisions, and manages the lifecycle of every corporate laptop and device deployed to Amazonians across the United States. Our team at SEA124 (Ouroboros) in Renton, WA processes thousands of devices weekly — supporting new hire onboarding, device refreshes, inventory management, reverse logistics, and data destruction.

We are seeking a Data Center Materials Associate to join our warehouse operations team. In this role, you will support daily inventory and logistics work — receiving and inducting IT assets, picking, packing, shipping, and processing returns. You'll follow standard procedures, work through assigned tasks as priorities shift during the day, and focus on accuracy and quality in every transaction. You'll also help keep IT areas clean, organized, and audit-ready.

This is a hands-on warehouse environment where your work directly supports Amazon's ability to deliver devices to employees on Day 1.

Our team approaches work as seeing no job as too small and no challenge as too big!

Key job responsibilities
- Support daily inventory operations, including receiving, induct, storage, picking, packing, and shipping of IT assets and peripherals
- Complete assigned tasks across queues and programs, following daily priorities set by the team
- Restock IT inventory locations, vending machines, and supply stores, and report low stock to your lead
- Process returned IT assets following compute reuse, reverse logistics, and disposal procedures
- Prepare IT assets for transportation in line with IT and InfoSec policies, including safe handling and destruction of IT media
- Assist with removal and recovery of IT assets from campus locations as required
- Prepare new hire equipment kits and support campus IT staff during new hire orientation
- Follow standard operating procedures and flag issues or errors to your lead
- Complete assigned work within SLA and record progress in ServiceNow
- Work with teams across the warehouse (IT Support, Returns, Stock Cart, Imaging) to keep orders moving

A day in the life
You arrive at our warehouse in Renton, WA and check the day's work: inbound shipments to receive, outbound orders to pick and pack, and returns to process. Your lead sets the day's priorities, and you move between tasks as they shift. Some days you're building new hire kits for Monday onboarding. Other days you're processing returned assets, restocking vending machines across campus, or helping with a bulk removal from a decommissioned floor. You follow standard procedures, flag issues to your lead, update ServiceNow, and make sure every asset is accounted for. Your accuracy helps make sure every Amazonian has the equipment they need on Day 1.

About the team
We're Amazon's primary imaging center for North America — a warehouse team that prepares and ships every corporate laptop before an employee's first day. We process thousands of devices weekly across multiple imaging lanes and shifts. You'll work alongside engineers, technicians, and operations specialists who build their own tools, write their own procedures, and own their programs end-to-end. Our culture is hands-on, direct, and team-first. We value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and look for ways to improve how things work. Every day brings something different.

title: Security Incident Response, Security Engineer, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Security Incident Response Analyst to detect, investigate, and respond to threats against a U.S. Government program building a purpose-built, classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with protecting customer trust, and on a fully air-gapped platform with no commercial cloud control plane we build our detection and response capability from the ground up. In this role you monitor security telemetry, triage and investigate alerts, drive incidents through containment, eradication, and recovery, and turn every event into better detections and playbooks. You will work in the trenches with detection engineers, SOC analysts, forensics, and our Government counterparts to keep a high-value classified system defensible around the clock. If you like being the person who runs toward the alarm and closes the loop, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Monitor security telemetry and triage, investigate, and escalate alerts on the disconnected platform.
• Drive incidents through the full response lifecycle: containment, eradication, recovery, and after-action.
• Develop and tune detection content and response playbooks from incident learnings.
• Coordinate incident reporting and handoffs with the ISSM and Government counterparts.

A day in the life
Your shift starts with a sweep of overnight security telemetry on the air-gapped platform. You triage queued alerts, separating noise from genuine threats, then dive deep into a suspicious authentication pattern. As you investigate, you drive it through containment and eradication, coordinating the response with your ISSM and Government counterparts. Midday, you huddle with detection engineers and SOC analysts to tune the alert logic that flagged it, turning today's incident into tomorrow's playbook. By afternoon, you document after-action findings and hand off cleanly to the next analyst. You run toward the alarm, close the loop, and keep a classified AI Factory defensible around the clock.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

descriptionHtml:
The Central Flow (CF) Sr. Process Specialist has Central Flow Experience and will own the strategy, mechanisms and initiatives within Central Flow LATAM that drive sustained CF Performance reflected in Speed and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA) by proactively rightsizing labor to close capacity risk. Those initiatives include labor adjustment strategy and the levers that execute it, real-time capacity risk identification and response, rolled volume recovery mechanisms, and the development of standardized processes, automated reporting, and network-wide controls. Success hinges on balancing three critical metrics that pull against one another: Capped Out Hours (COH) & Capacity constrains, cost as measured by Throughput Per Hour (TPH), and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA). This role partners with Field Operations, Finance, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), planning partner teams, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES), and Last Mile Tech (LMT), and is both a collaborator focused on implementing network-wide initiatives and the labor management partner for Regional Directors and Operations General Managers across two business lines.

The Sr. CF Specialist works independently with multiple teams, they influence priorities through data-driven decision making and present complex solutions to Director-level leadership.

To be successful in this role you need to pair analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong executive communication skills, demonstrate strong judgment in making time-sensitive decisions that impact delivery performance, labor utilization, and customer experience, be comfortable operating with limited guidance in an ambiguous, constantly changing environment, and be able to prepare and deliver detailed, data-driven business reviews with clear and effective narratives to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities

2. The Process Improvement Manager will support DEA and speed by proactively rightsizing labor to close capacity risk before it becomes a delivery miss, and will drive proactive labor management for rolled volume recovery — building the playbooks, escalation paths, and decision guardrails.

3. The Process Improvement Manager will design the governance model for shift labor levers, defining decision rights between Central Flow and the field so that same-day actions are fast, consistent, and auditable across two business lines with different tooling and maturity.

4. The Process Improvement Manager will implement automated reporting, real-time visibility, and model-driven mechanisms that surface FC shift risk before it becomes a delivery miss, and will document Standard Operating Procedures so execution does not depend on a single owner.

5. The Process Improvement Manager will develop trust-based relationships with Regional Directors, General Managers, Operations Managers, and functional partners across S&OP, AMZL and MM.

We are looking for a Senior Finance Analyst to join the US Prime Video Business Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity to use analytical insights to work directly with product and business leaders, and to build the tooling they make decisions with.

Prime Video offers customers the largest selection of any streaming service in the world, combining exclusive content available for Prime members (Amazon Original hits like Fallout, Reacher, and The Boys; licensed content from other studios; live events such as Thursday Night Football), 3P Channel subscriptions such as Paramount+, HBO Max, and Apple TV+, an expansive catalog of transactional (rent or buy) content, and linear ad supported channels with 24/7 programming. The PV team comprises individuals who are all obsessively focused on one mission: to give consumers the world's best in class digital video customer experience.

Our team connects business strategy to financial outcomes for the Prime Video Product and Business teams. You will own analyses that shape how the product evolves - what features drive acquisition and conversion, what drives retention, and where the returns on product investment actually are. While your analysis will focus on the US market, you will also collaborate with International teams to ensure we leverage insights globally.

The ideal candidate is someone who loves to dive into data and transform it into insights that connect back to the customer experience. Familiarity with SQL and large datasets is critical in order to access and combine data to iterate on new metrics and analyses. An interest in going one step further, using Python or AI tooling to automate and scale your own analysis, is a welcome addition. This is a fast-paced environment with inherent ambiguity which requires a self-starter that is comfortable working independently. They must be comfortable performing detailed, complicated analysis and communicating findings to stakeholders in a clear, efficient manner that highlights the most relevant points to the business’ strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner directly with product managers and business leaders to size opportunities before they are built, and measure whether launches delivered what was sized
- Own and extend analytical tooling that lets product leaders size opportunities and measure results directly
- Develop performance tracking metrics that provide strategic insights for Prime Video's product and business leadership
- Prepare strategic analyses, reports, and recommendations that directly influence business strategy and investment decisions
- Collaborate cross functionally to support data driven decision making

A day in the life
Some days are analysis: pulling data, building a model, writing up what it means for a product decision. Others are building: extending a tool so it answers a question it could not answer last week, or automating a report so the time can go into the insight instead of the assembly. Most days are both.

About the team
We love Prime Video, but more broadly TV and film entertainment in general. Applying that passion on a daily basis and being able to connect our work to how Prime Video delivers for customers is what keeps us going. While we are a Finance team, we very much feel like part of the business and product teams and are treated as such.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards), or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- 3+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

title: Sr. Product Manager,  External Services, AWS Training and Certification, AWS T&C: AI Innovation
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Are you excited about defining a new category of software, AI teammates that help people learn and grow in the flow of their work? Do you want to shape how millions of professionals build skills, earn certifications, and get better at their jobs every day? Do you want direct and immediate impact on the way people and AI learn together?
As part of the AWS Training and Certification team, we are building AI learning teammates: agentic systems that don't just answer questions or hand out courses, but work alongside people, notice where they are getting stuck, and turn everyday tasks into moments of learning. These teammates bring the right guidance, practice, and credential right into the tools and tasks they already use. This is a new product space where the right experience is still being invented, and we are looking for a product leader who partners deeply with design to define it.
As a Senior Product Manager - Technical, External Services, you will partner with design and lead the development of AI learning teammates, owning the product vision, requirements, and roadmap from concept through go-to-market. You will champion the needs of learners and the organizations that train and certify them, and translate ambiguous, open-ended problems into clear product definitions and detailed business requirements documents. You will work hand-in-hand with design, engineering, science, learning scientists, and operational stakeholders to prioritize the roadmap and spearhead the definition of new capabilities.

This role sits where product, learning, and design meet. A great learning teammate is built on more than a strong model and solid systems. It depends on trust, on clear interaction patterns, and on how it feels to be coached while you work. You will co-own the end-to-end experience with design. That spans how a teammate joins a team, how it surfaces learning in the flow of work, how it recognizes mastery and guides someone toward certification, and how people stay in control of their own development.

The successful candidate must have exceptional problem solving skills, strong business judgment, and demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams. We are looking for a proven ability to execute both strategically and tactically, and someone who is excited to take on new, ambiguous projects that will be industry defining. This position requires a solid technical background, and the candidate should be customer-focused with a passion for learning, AI, agents, and the future of how skills are built.

AWS Training and Certification helps people and organizations build the cloud and AI skills they need to be successful, from foundational learning through role-based certifications recognized across the industry. As a member of this team, you'll support the development and management of AI-powered learning experiences that reach learners worldwide, including the agentic learning teammates that will define the next decade of how people grow their skills.


Key job responsibilities
Partner with design to define and own the end-to-end experience for AI learning teammates, from onboarding and interaction patterns to how learning is delivered in the flow of work.
Define product requirements and author business requirements documents that align engineering, design, science, learning scientists, and leadership around a shared vision for each capability.
Own the roadmap for one or more learning teammate product areas, making trade-off decisions across competing priorities, customer commitments, and technical investments.
Represent the product externally with enterprise customers, translating their workforce development and certification needs into product direction and measurable adoption goals.
Drive cross-team alignment to ensure teammate capabilities are composable and reusable across the learning portfolio, partnering with learning science and certification stakeholders to keep in-the-flow experiences grounded in proven learning principles.


A day in the life
You might start your morning in a design review, working through the interaction model for how a teammate offers a quick coaching moment the instant someone hits a task they haven't done before. By midday, you are reviewing skill-progression and certification-completion metrics and preparing a decision narrative for leadership on a proposed new capability. In the afternoon, you connect with learning scientists and engineering to pressure-test whether an in-the-flow learning experience is effective and feasible this quarter, then close out by refining requirements for the next capability and drafting a narrative that will guide customer-facing conversations.

About the team
About AWS
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 3+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
- Experience partnering closely with design (UX/product design/accessibility) to define and ship customer-facing experiences

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing strategy documents for executive audiences with clear recommendations in the midst of ambiguity
- Experience communicating with customers, technical, regulatory, business teams, and management to collect requirements, describe product features, and technical designs
- Experience building AI, machine learning, agentic, or conversational products
- Experience building learning, education, training, or certification products, or embedding learning in the flow of work

title: Sr Manager Package SIPI, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Package Signal & Power Integrity to lead a small team of engineers delivering SI/PI solutions for next-generation 2.5D/3D chiplet-based products. This is a player-coach role: you will set the technical direction for package-level SI/PI across advanced packaging platforms (CoWoS, EMIB, 3D die stacking) while staying hands-on with modeling, simulation, and post-silicon correlation.

You will own the SI/PI strategy from early architecture through high-volume production, partnering with silicon design, physical design, system architecture, and possible with OSAT/substrate vendors to ensure robust signaling and power delivery across die-to-die, memory, and high-speed SerDes interfaces.

What You Will Do
• Lead and develop a team of SI/PI engineers, setting priorities, driving career growth, and building world-class packaging expertise.
• Define and execute SI/PI design methodology for 2.5D/3D IC packages—including silicon interposer, RDL, TSV, and bridge-based architectures.
• Drive chip-package-system co-design by performing end-to-end SI/PI analysis and optimization for HBM (HBM3/HBM3E+), PCIe Gen5/Gen6/Gen7, UCIe die-to-die interconnects and high-speed SerDes (112G+/224G PAM4).
• Own PDN design and sign-off across die, interposer, package substrate, and PCB, including AC/DC/transient droop analysis and decoupling strategy.
• Develop and validate channel models (S-parameter, IBIS-AMI) and perform BER/eye-diagram analysis for multi-lane high-speed links.
• Establish SI/PI design guidelines, sign-off criteria, and automation flows; drive continuous improvement in accuracy and productivity.
• Partner with ASIC architects, PHY/IP teams, package layout, thermal/mechanical, PCB, and system design teams to close electrical specifications.
• Collaborate with other internal partners and external partners (possible like foundry, OSAT, and substrate suppliers etc.) on technology assessment, DFM trade-offs, and new package platform enablement.
• Lead post-silicon validation and model-to-hardware correlation using VNA, TDR, oscilloscope, and spectrum analyzer measurements.

Required Qualifications
• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, with emphasis in electromagnetics, signal integrity, power integrity, or microelectronics.
• 12+ years of progressive SI/PI engineering experience in semiconductor packaging (IC package, interposer, or substrate design).
• 3+ years of direct people-management experience leading SI/PI or packaging engineering teams.
• Demonstrated expertise in 2.5D/3D advanced packaging technologies (CoWoS-S/L/R, EMIB, Foveros, 3D die stacking, TSV, RDL, flip-chip BGA).
• Hands-on experience with SI/PI analysis for high-speed SerDes interfaces at 56G NRZ / 112G+ PAM4 data rates.
• Strong background in HBM3/4 SI/PI design and timing budget methodology (HBM3/HBM3E/HBM4 or newer).
• Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 channel design, compliance, and sign-off at the package and system level.
• Working knowledge of UCIe or comparable die-to-die interconnect standards for chiplet architectures.
• Proficiency in industry EDA/simulation tools: Ansys HFSS/SIwave/Q3D, Cadence Sigrity (PowerSI, SystemSI), Keysight ADS, HSPICE/Spectre.
• Strong scripting skills (Python, MATLAB, Tcl) for simulation automation and data analysis.
• Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across silicon, package, board, and system teams in a fast-paced product environment.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with PCIe Gen7, 200G/400G Ethernet SerDes, or NVLink-class ultra-high-speed interconnects.
• Expertise in UCIe advanced (UCIe 2.0) protocol-level SI/PI considerations and latency-sensitive chiplet integration.
• Familiarity with next-generation HBM standards (HBM4e) and associated PHY/package co-design challenges.
• Track record of new product introduction (NPI) from concept through high-volume manufacturing.
• Experience with on-die EMIR/DVD analysis and chip-package PDN co-simulation workflows.
• Exposure to EMI/EMC analysis and mitigation at the package and system level.
• Knowledge of thermal-aware SI/PI design—understanding package warpage, material Dk/Df drift, and reliability impacts on signal performance.
• Experience evaluating emerging packaging platforms (glass substrate, hybrid bonding, fan-out panel-level packaging).
• Active participation in industry standards bodies (IEEE, UCIe Consortium, JEDEC, OIF).

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
- Master's degree in Electrical/Communications Engineering, or 8+ years of practical semiconductor design work including full-chip and subsystem integration experience
- 3+ years of direct people management, including managing managers or senior individual contributors experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with PCIe Gen7, 200G/400G Ethernet SerDes, or NVLink-class ultra-high-speed interconnects.
- Expertise in UCIe advanced (UCIe 2.0) protocol-level SI/PI considerations and latency-sensitive chiplet integration.
- Familiarity with next-generation HBM standards (HBM4e) and associated PHY/package co-design challenges.

title: Technical Program Manager, GES NA, Technical Vendor Management, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
Are you an innovative leader that wants to lead the cross-functional design and deployment of innovative solutions into our world-class existing fulfillment centers and logistics systems? Do you want to take ownership of solving the industry’s most complex problems? Does the challenge of designing and implementing ground breaking solutions for automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing appeal to you? If you’re looking to be challenged in a fast paced and often ambiguous environment, and you have strong technical problem solving and project management skills, then this job is for you!

Amazon is searching for an innovative and solutions-oriented Technical Program Manager who is able to collaborate effectively with internal and external technical teams and be responsible for the design, development and deployment of our material handling systems across multiple building types. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
- Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
- Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
- Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
- Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
- Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
- Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
- Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
- Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
- Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
- Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
- Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
- Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
- Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review
- Coordinate annual Charter/Strategy and Headcount Reviews, maintaining documentation in SharePoint and WorkDocs
- Support annual goal-setting processes and provide monthly goal update reminders
- Manage the Team Request Tracker — assign and track action items across team members
- Maintain and optimize operational mechanisms in Smartsheet and Slack to support team workflows

A day in the life
Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Technical Vendor Management operates at the intersection of engineering execution and vendor partnership across North America. A day in the life may involve leading a weekly business review with a general contractor, reviewing scorecard data to identify systemic performance patterns, conducting a strategic planning session with your team leads, or presenting portfolio risk assessments to GES leadership. You will engage with vendor executives, coordinate with GPO on sourcing decisions, align with TVM counterparts, and drive cross-portfolio intelligence that no single project team can see. GES NA Technical Vendor Management is highly collaborative, working daily to make vendor performance consequential, vendor relationships strategic, and Amazon’s construction supply base stronger every year.

About the team
The Technical Vendor Management (TVM) organization is an engineering and performance-focused function within NA GES, consisting of five pillars: TVM MHE Vendor Management, TVM MHE Vendor Development, TVM MHE Components, Construction Contracts, and Technical Vendor Management, Construction. We manage the full project lifecycle of Amazon’s vendor relationships for general contractors and specialty subcontractors—from qualification through active project execution, performance accountability, and continuous improvement. Technical Vendor Management exists because vendor performance directly impacts whether Amazon’s network launches on time, on budget, and at the quality level operations require. With our team, vendor performance improves year over year because we make it consequential. We build strategic relationships that unlock decisions site-level teams cannot reach, see patterns across the portfolio that no single project can see, and act on them before they repeat.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 2+ years of software development experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or other STEM field
- 3+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience managing end-to-end project lifecycles including scope definition, scheduling, risk management, vendor coordination, and delivery
- Experience with project management tools and reporting frameworks (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent) and data-driven decision-making
- Position includes travel up to 50% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- Experience in vendor management, RFP and RFIs
- project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Knowledge of controls engineering, mechanical/electrical systems, or software integration as it relates to automation infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (AWS)에서는 고객이 전문지식 역량을 개발할 수 있도록 돕고, 이를 위해 파트너와 협력할 수 있는 뛰어난 기술역량을 갖춘 클라우드 아키텍트를 채용하고 있습니다. AWS의 컨설턴트들은 아키텍쳐 검토와 파일럿 개발, 주제별 워크샵, 그리고 프로젝트를 통한 딜리버리를 담당하게 됩니다.

프로페셔널 서비스팀은 다양한 프로젝트를 통해 축적한 경험을 바탕으로 고객의 성공을 돕습니다. 또한, AWS 내부 다른 조직과 협력하여 제품과 서비스, 그리고 적절한 해결책을 고객에게 제공하고 고객 요구 사항에 따라 혁신을 추진합니다.


Key job responsibilities
We are looking for hands-on cloud architects who will work with other Professional Services consultants in a project to:
- Dive deep into inventory and application data of the customer’s on-premise services to assess the portfolio and develop decision criteria to create initial migration wave plans.
- Analyze the customer’s existing infrastructure design including network, storage, computing resources, along with the operational processes / policies to design a secure, robust, and highly tolerant multi-account AWS environment based on AWS best practices.
- Develop required operating and governance models, and help customers to migrate applications to AWS.
- Help customers and partners to be prepared for cloud operations, and identify the areas for automation to accelerate the migration and transformation of the organization.
- Establish the future operating model for cloud and plan, guide and support an efficient progression of the operational model during the migration.

프로페셔널 서비스팀에서는 여러 컨설턴트들과 협력하여 다음의 실무 역할을 수행할 클라우드 아키텍트를 채용하고 있습니다.

• 온 프레미스 서비스의 대상 시스템과 애플리케이션 데이터를 심층 분석하여 포트폴리오를 평가하고 의사 결정 기준을 개발함과 동시에, 초기 마이그레이션 계획 수립
• 고객의 네트워크와 스토리지, 컴퓨팅 리소스 등 현 인프라 설계를 분석하여 더욱 안전하고 견고한 내구성이 높은 다중 계정의 AWS모범 사례 설계
• 운영과 거버넌스를 위한 모델을 개발하고 고객의 애플리케이션을 AWS로 마이그레이션하도록 지원
• 고객과 파트너가 클라우드 운영에 대비할 수 있도록 지원하고 자동화 가능한 영역을 찾아 고객의 마이그레이션과 변화을 가속화
• 향후 클라우드 운영 모델을 수립하고 마이그레이션 중 모델의 효율적인 개선을 위한 계획을 수립하고 안내, 지원

A day in the life
This is a customer facing role. You will be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services as needed.

고객을 대면하는 역할이며, 필요에 따라 전문적인 서비스 제공을 위해 고객을 방문해야 할 수 있습니다.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

다양성
AWS는 다양한 경험을 중요하게 생각합니다. JD에 나와 있는 자격 및 기술을 모두 충족하지 못하더라도 지원자가 지원하도록 권장합니다. 경력을 이제 막 시작하였거나, 전통적인 경력을 쌓지 않았거나, 조금 다른 경험을 쌓았다고, 지원을 중단하실 필요는 없습니다.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS를 선택해야 하는 이유
아마존 웹 서비스 (AWS) 는 세계에서 가장 포괄적이고 널리 채택된 클라우드 플랫폼입니다.우리는 클라우드 컴퓨팅 시장을 개척했으며 혁신을 멈추지 않았습니다. 이것이 바로 가장 성공적인 스타트업부터 Global 500 기업에 이르는 고객이 AWS의 제품 및 서비스 제품군을 신뢰하는 이유입니다.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

멘토십 및 경력 개발
우리는 세계 최고의 고용주가 되기 위해 노력하면서 지속적으로 성과 기준을 높이고 있습니다.그렇기 때문에 더 다재다능한 전문가로 발전하는 데 도움이 되는 지식 공유, 멘토십 및 기타 경력 개발 리소스를 찾을 수 있습니다.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

일과 삶의 균형
우리는 일과 삶의 조화를 중요하게 생각합니다.직장에서의 성공을 위해 가정에서의 희생을 감수해서는 안 됩니다. 그렇기 때문에 유연한 근무 시간과 근무 방식이 우리 문화의 일부입니다.직장과 가정에서 지지받는다고 느낄 때 클라우드로는 달성할 수 없는 것이 없습니다.
