title: Manager I, Facilities
descriptionHtml:
Are you a people-focused leader who thrives on keeping operations running smoothly? Amazon is looking for a Manager I, Facilities to lead a team responsible for the day-to-day operations of our facilities. In this role, you will directly supervise a team of individual contributors, ensuring that building systems perform reliably, maintenance tasks are completed on schedule, and service level agreements are consistently met. You will play a hands-on role in solving operational challenges, driving process improvements, and creating an environment where your team members feel valued and empowered to grow.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and manage a team of facilities individual contributors, providing tactical direction on daily priorities, coaching team members on skill development, and conducting regular performance conversations that recognize strengths and address opportunity areas.
- Monitor facility system performance, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate routine maintenance activities to ensure uninterrupted building operations and adherence to service level agreements.
- Champion a safe work environment by following established safety protocols, identifying potential hazards, and encouraging your team to maintain rigorous safety standards across all work processes.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, communicating priorities clearly and partnering across teams to resolve conflicting needs and deliver successful outcomes for customers.
- Identify opportunities to improve tools, procedures, and workflows, recommending enhancements that drive operational efficiency and raise the quality of facilities services.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing work queues and open maintenance tickets, then meet with your team to align on priorities and address any urgent facility issues. Throughout the day, you will walk the facility to inspect building systems, connect with stakeholders to understand their needs, and guide your team through troubleshooting efforts. You will also dedicate time to one-on-one conversations with your direct reports, discussing their progress toward development goals and providing real-time feedback.

About the team
Our Facilities team is committed to providing reliable, well-maintained environments that enable Amazon employees to do their best work. We take pride in operational excellence and continuously look for smarter ways to manage our buildings and serve our internal customers. As we grow, we are investing in people and processes that keep pace with Amazon's expanding footprint. If you are excited about leading a team, solving real-world operational problems, and making a tangible impact every day, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of industrial maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon experience
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience working with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) integrators
- Experience maintaining material handling equipment and integrated systems
- Experience in project management
- Experience with statistical analysis

title: Trust and Privacy TPM, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility
descriptionHtml:
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our India-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.
- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.
- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.
- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.
- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life
As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team
Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 2+ years of software development experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Cloud Infra Architect, Migration, APJ-Delivery-Japan
descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムのアプリケーションの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？
Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にあるワークロードをAWSへのマイグレーションを支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的に加速できるようにプロジェクトをリードするCloud Infra Architectを募集しています。
お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産をクラウドへマイグレーションし、継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。しかし、移行・モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。マイグレーションとモダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現を支援するのが Cloud Infra Consultant です。オンプレミス環境の知識と経験を持ち、これらの上で稼働する様々なワークロードのクラウドへのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションに経験、興味のある方を求めています。


Key job responsibilities
当ポジションのコンサルタントは、お客様とパートナーのオンプレミス環境と稼働するワークロードの評価、計画、動員、設計、実行を支援します。AWS ProServeのコンサルタントは、スケーラブルな移行・モダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、オンプレミス環境よりクラウドへのマイグレーションおよびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。お客様の経営課題を把握しそれを実現する上で、現行システムのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションの最適アプローチとそれを実現する全体計画の策定を支援します。また、関係する技術コンサルタントとともに、移行・モダナイゼーションのための最適技術手法や技術選択肢の決定などを支援し、お客様が AWS のサービスを活用してスケーラブルで可用性の高いアプリケーションソリューションを構築できるよう支援します。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。
お客様の成功のために複数の Professional Services のメンバーやAWS パートナーのメンバー、そして、グローバルの Professional Services を含む社内の多くの AWS チームや AWS パートナーと連携し、価値提供にまい進することで技術者としての成長も期待できます。

About AWS:

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
• Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes.
• Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
• Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
• Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
• Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or innovative tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management
- Experience using CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) to plan proactive maintenance and record reactive tasks

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements

title: Software Development Engineer II, Selection Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Help Amazon understand every brand in the world and make sure customers can find the brands they love in our store. As a Software Development Engineer on the Universal Brand Catalog (UBC) team, you'll design and own large-scale data systems, AI/ML-powered services, and self-serve tools that show brand recruitment teams which brands are missing from Amazon and where to act. This is a new space with key architecture decisions still on the table, so you'll have real influence over the technical direction from day one. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborate closely with applied scientists and product managers, and see your work translate directly into wider selection for Amazon customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate scalable, highly available services and large-scale data pipelines (Spark on Amazon EMR) that process brand, product, and marketplace data across Amazon's global catalog.
- Own features end to end — requirements, design documents, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — and lead design reviews where you make sound tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, cost, and scalability.
- Partner with applied scientists to put ML models into production, measure data quality through precision and recall metrics, and iterate on brand-matching and gap-detection signals.
- Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, break large projects into shippable deliverables, and build self-serve tools that let business teams slice brand and selection data by market, category, and competitive trends without engineering support.
- Mentor junior engineers and interns through code reviews, design guidance, and pairing, while driving operational improvements in monitoring, alarming, and on-call health.

A day in the life
You might start the day at stand-up, then review a design document for a new pipeline that scores brands across marketplaces. Later you could meet with a product manager and a scientist to figure out how to measure whether a brand gap signal can be trusted, then turn that into a data model and plan. In the afternoon you'll write code, review a teammate's pull request, and help a junior engineer debug a Spark job. Your internal stakeholders include category and vendor management teams who use your data to recruit brands, partner catalog teams, and science teams.

About the team
The UBC team builds the foundation for how Amazon understands brands: which brands exist, how they relate to each other, where they're sold, and where they're missing from our store. We own Brand Gaps (finding brands and selection absent from Amazon) and Brand Cohort Management (grouping and prioritizing brands so teams can focus on what matters most to customers). Engineers and applied scientists work side by side on problems like signal precision, cohort ranking, and entity matching. The space is new and growing, so you'll have real ownership, see the business impact of your work directly, and grow through mentorship, design reviews, and a sustainable on-call culture.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services はすべての AWS グローバルインフラストラクチャの設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。私たちは、クラウドを稼働させ続ける人々です。すべての AWS データセンターとお客様がイノベーションに継続的にアクセスできるようにするすべてのサーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電源、冷却設備をサポートしています。私たちはサプライチェーンに影響を与える数千もの要因を考慮しながら、最も困難な課題に取り組んでいます。そして私たちと共に支援したいと考える優秀な人材を探しています。

ソフトウェア、ハードウェア、ネットワークエンジニア、サプライチェーンスペシャリスト、セキュリティエキスパート、オペレーションマネージャー、その他の重要な役割を担う多様なチームに参加していただきます。AWS 全体の人々と協力して、お客様に最低コストで無限の容量を提供しながら、安全性とセキュリティの最高基準を提供できるよう支援していただきます。そして、大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、それを完成まで自分のものとして進める力を与える包括的な文化を体験していただけます。

Data Center Operationsチームは AWS のバックボーンであり、急速に成長する AWS ビジネスとお客様を 24 時間 365 日サポートしています。私たちは AWS の物理インフラストラクチャを維持し、安全性、セキュリティ、可用性、生産性、容量、効率性、コストの分野における運用パフォーマンスの基準を確保することに取り組んでいます。



Key job responsibilities
主な職務内容

Facility Engineer - Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) の役割は、大規模で高密度のデータセンターにおいて、施設（電気/機械システム、制御/消火システムなど）の展開、運用、保守、および関連プロジェクトの管理を担当します。
日常業務では、以下の業務に携わります:
• 建物システムの点検と監視、および施設の問題のトラブルシューティング
• 運用効率の改善とエネルギー削減
• ベンダーやパートナーとの定期メンテナンスと修理の計画と実施。これには、ブレーカー操作、機械/電気設備操作などの重要な施設運用が含まれます
• プロジェクトチームメンバーと協力してテストなどをサポート

勤務時間

12時間のシフト勤務 (うち2時間休憩)など、標準外の時間帯勤務が可能な方（4勤3休のシフトで働ける方。標準勤務時間は 8:00 ～ 20:00、20:00 ～ 8:00、または 9:00 ～ 21:00、21:00 ～ 9:00 です）



About the team
多様な経験

AWS は多様な経験を重視しています。職務内容に記載されているすべての資格やスキルを満たしていなくても、応募することをお勧めします。キャリアが始まったばかりの場合、従来の道を歩んでいない場合、または関連しない経験がある場合でも、応募をためらわないでください。

なぜ AWS なのか?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアであり、イノベーションを止めることはありません。だからこそ、最も成功しているスタートアップから Global 500 企業まで、幅広いお客様が当社の堅牢な製品・サービスを信頼し、ビジネスを推進しています。

包括的なチーム文化

AWS では、学び、好奇心を持つことが私たちの本質です。従業員主導のアフィニティグループは、私たちが自分たちの違いを誇りに思える包括的な文化を育んでいます。Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) や AmazeCon (ジェンダーダイバーシティ) カンファレンスを含む継続的なイベントや学習体験は、私たちが独自性を受け入れることを決して止めないよう刺激を与えてくれます。

メンターシップとキャリア成長

私たちは、地球上で最高の雇用主になるために、継続的にパフォーマンスバーを引き上げています。だからこそ、ここには、より多角的な専門家に成長するのに役立つ、無限の知識共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリア向上リソースがあります。

title: Program Manager II, AMZL Field Support
descriptionHtml:
Keeping tens of thousands of safety technology devices active and compliant across a large third-party rental vehicle fleet takes more than day-to-day upkeep, it takes an owner who can see the patterns behind the problems and reshape how the work gets done. You will own device compliance and operational performance for rental vehicles across hundreds of delivery sites, turning device health data into root-cause insight and leading cross-functional partners to durable fixes, not one-off corrections. This role brings that program under a single accountable owner, one person who runs the day-to-day operation and continuously raises the bar on how it performs.

In this role you will own the mechanisms that keep devices installed, accounted for, and active across the rental fleet: the recurring site and partner engagement, the case resolution path, and the operational reporting leaders rely on. You will go beyond resolving individual issues to analyze why they recur, designing process improvements that reduce failure rates at the source. You will work across field operations, partner, and support teams to align priorities and drive systemic resolution, delivering difficult cross-functional work independently and escalating when a decision falls outside established mechanisms.

The ideal candidate pairs operational ownership with program-management judgment: the analytical depth to turn recurring issues into root-cause insight, the influence to move multiple stakeholder groups toward a shared outcome without direct authority, and the instinct to simplify and improve the processes they inherit. You will thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you own outcomes, not just tasks.

Key job responsibilities
● Own the compliance program for the rental vehicle fleet end to end, keeping devices installed, accounted for, and active across hundreds of sites through the recurring mechanisms you run and improve
● Analyze case and failure trends to identify root causes, then design and implement process improvements that reduce recurring issues rather than resolving them one at a time
● Lead cross-functional stakeholder groups across field operations, partner, and support teams to align priorities, drive systemic resolution, and move compliance and device utilization in the right direction
● Own the operational reporting and device-health analysis that turn raw data into the insight leaders use to make decisions across rental fleet segments
● Identify risks and blockers early, drive crisp and timely decisions, and escalate appropriately to keep the program aligned with its goals

A day in the life
Your day blends operational ownership with cross-functional problem-solving. You will dig into device-health and case data not just to clear what is in front of you but to find the trend underneath it, then bring field operations, partner, and support teams together to fix the root cause. You will design improvements to the mechanisms you own, influence stakeholders toward a shared plan, and build the operational reporting that gives leaders a clear read on program health. Expect to move between focused analysis and the cross-functional work of aligning people and raising the bar across the rental fleet.

About the team
We keep the technology devices on Amazon’s last mile and middle mile fleets working, owning device repair, reliability, and availability so vehicles stay on the road. Our group sits at the intersection of field operations, data analysis, and vendor partnership, owning both the daily execution and the strategy behind a healthy device fleet. This role owns the rental fleet program at the heart of that work. You will join a team of program managers who take ownership of fleet readiness, dig past symptoms to root cause, and build fixes that hold up at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - WWPS
descriptionHtml:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.


Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

Key job responsibilities
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.

A day in the life
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

Why AWS?
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become

Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Program Manager III, Relay Product Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Want to be the person who keeps a fast-moving organization running in rhythm? Relay Product Excellence (RPE) protects Customers, Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon globally through fast-paced investigation and analytics, and we need a senior program manager on our Strategic Programs and Organizational eXcellence (SPOX) team to own the operating rhythms and delivery mechanisms that keep the whole organization on cadence.

This is a true program management role. The operating rhythms you run (Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs), Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), and the operating plan cycles) are the mechanisms through which RPE delivers on its programs and hits its goals, and you'll own them end to end to make sure it does. You'll own the operating rhythms, execution standards, and governance mechanisms that bring consistency and rigor across a growing portfolio of risk and investigation initiatives, running deck production, forum prep, facilitation, and follow-up, and continuously optimizing the mechanisms so they drive the right focus and outcomes. Goal tracking is central: you'll keep RPE's goals visible, surface where delivery is on or off track, and drive the follow-through that closes the gap. This is a role for someone who thrives on orchestration and cross-team coordination: herding many inputs from many owners into one coherent, on-time narrative, and being the single point of contact that partner teams engage instead of a dozen individuals.

You'll serve as the owner of the mechanism, strategy, and frameworks for how RPE's cross-functional work runs, partnering closely with Workforce Intelligence & Strategic Planning (WISP) on the headcount and entitlement inputs that feed the planning cycles, while content and program owners retain authorship of their own numbers and narrative.

Alongside the operating rhythms, you'll own RPE's Special Programs: the stage gate for net-new programmatic efforts requested of RPE, where you own intake, scope and pressure-test each ask, incubate the ones that move forward, and transition them to a permanent owner once they are stood up (or decline the ones that should not proceed). Special Programs also includes the ad hoc, leadership-driven initiatives that land without warning, so you'll build and run the mechanisms that triage, route, resolve, and communicate them with speed and rigor. The ideal candidate brings exceptional communication skills, attention to detail, and a data-driven mindset, with the ability to manage many stakeholders at once, earn trust across partner teams, and deliver independently in a fast-paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive the annual operating plan cycles (OP1 and OP2) for RPE end to end, setting the workback, running intake and prioritization, orchestrating inputs across partner teams and RPE team leads, and owning the all-up plan as the single point of accountability, while partnering with WISP on headcount and entitlement as inputs you consume rather than own.
- Own RPE's core operating rhythms end to end, producing and program-managing the Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) and Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) (deck production, prep, facilitation, follow-up), while content owners own their inputs, numbers, and narrative.
- Own goal tracking for RPE, using the operating rhythms to keep goals visible, surface where delivery is off track, and drive follow-through so RPE hits its commitments.
- Continuously optimize the operating rhythms so they stay focused on the decisions that move RPE's goals, retiring what no longer adds value.
- Serve as the single conduit between RPE and partner teams for recurring reviews and communications, so outside teams engage one accountable owner.
- Own the strategy, frameworks, and execution standards for how cross-functional work is governed and delivered.
- Own Special Programs as the stage gate for net-new efforts: own intake and scoping, decide what moves forward, incubate it, and transition each to a permanent owner or orderly sunset.
- Influence stakeholders through data-driven insights and written narratives, handling sensitive data per Amazon's data classification and privacy policies.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll navigate ambiguity daily, reading program health against RPE's goals, making high-judgment calls on where to focus, and course-correcting as new information emerges. You'll orchestrate the operating rhythms and the operating plan, turning many owners' inputs into one coherent narrative and driving the decisions and follow-through that keep RPE on track. When a new Special Programs ask lands, you'll scope it and set a path forward without waiting for perfect information. You'll drive alignment across teams through influence, not authority, and continuously raise the bar on the mechanisms that hold the organization accountable, partnering with WISP on headcount and entitlement.

About the team
Middle Mile Transportation Technology moves millions of packages across Amazon's network daily, and Relay Product Excellence (RPE) ensures those systems stay protected. Our program managers, analysts, and investigators deliver rapid-cycle investigation and analytics that safeguard Customers, Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon globally.

Within RPE, the Strategic Programs and Organizational eXcellence (SPOX) team is the connective tissue, spanning Program Delivery, Escalations, Team Growth, Continuous Improvement, and Special Programs. SPOX owns the program management frameworks, milestone governance, execution methodology, and operating rhythms that give teams structure to move fast. We partner closely with Workforce Intelligence & Strategic Planning (WISP), which owns the headcount and entitlement core, while SPOX owns the mechanisms, strategy, and frameworks around everything else.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience tracking goals and program health against targets and driving cross-functional follow-through to closure
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, visualization tools (Tableau, QuickSight, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience building and scaling operating-rhythm mechanisms (for example WBR/MBR, operating reviews) and coordinating recurring cross-functional forums
- Experience driving operating rhythms (WBR/MBR) and partnering on capacity planning frameworks at scale
- Experience building goal-tracking or program health mechanisms (scorecards, KPI dashboards, path-to-green tracking) that drive delivery against organizational goals
- Experience running an intake or stage-gate process and incubating new initiatives through to transition to a permanent owner
- Demonstrated ability to orchestrate many stakeholders and inputs into a single coherent narrative under deadline
- Experience serving as a single point of contact between an organization and its external partner teams

descriptionHtml:
The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is chartered to define, build, deploy, govern, and enable the solutions that empower 200+ ABM practitioners globally to operate efficiently and at scale. We create, manage, and support the end-to-end delivery of ABM capabilities — from AI-powered technologies to process automation to content management — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.
We are seeking an ABM Program Manager to own and scale the AI, data, and operational solutions that support our ABM community. This role sits at the intersection of marketing and technology: you will take complex, ambiguous problems and deliver AI-based solutions end-to-end — from problem definition through design, build, testing, and global rollout. You will act as the key partner between ABM stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors, translating strategic ABM objectives into scalable solutions.
This role combines strategic thinking with a builder mindset. You will not simply route requirements to a cross-functional support team — you will assess ABM requirements, and where a solution can be built using out-of-the-box AI tools (such as Amazon Quick, MCP integrations, and Asana), you will build it and enable ABMers to use these solutions effectively. Success means ABM practitioners have an integrated, easy-to-use set of AI-powered tools embedded in their daily workflow that adapt as their accounts evolve — delivered with rigor, field-tested adoption, and measurable impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the business lead for ABM AI, data, and operational solutions end-to-end — define the vision, program strategy, requirements, and success criteria for AI-based ABM solutions with limited guidance, operating in problem spaces where the solution is not yet defined.
• Design and build AI-powered tools and automation flows from problem definition through production — including customer journey engines, Quick Skill automations, MCP integrations across enterprise platforms (CRM, Highspot, Asana), and reactive signal-monitoring layers that keep solutions current as accounts evolve.
• Drive delivery and support of complex, cross-functional solutions — including design, AppSec compliance, build, user acceptance testing with field practitioners, documentation (SOPs and training guides), product demonstrations, and global rollout.
• Serve as the key partner between marketing stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors — translating business requirements into technical specifications, and communicating technical constraints back to marketing stakeholders.
• Drive AI enablement and adoption across a globally distributed practitioner community — assess AI maturity, build leveling frameworks, deploy Quick Skills tooling, and coach practitioners (e.g., via a Champions program) to scale adoption across all Geos.
• Spot risks and drive appropriate trade-offs — understand design approaches within the ABM technology domain (AI/ML frameworks, MCP integrations, data sources, agent orchestration, UI/UX) and ask the right questions to ensure sound decisions.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (adoption, usage volume, practitioner impact, time savings, delivery quality). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.

• Partner with the Martech team on ABM solution lifecycle management — contributing requirements and field-informed input to platform builds such as buying-group identification services, account planning platforms, and ABM experience products.

descriptionHtml:

The role will have responsibility for creating, managing and expanding our content provider network and relationships. The individual in this role will be responsible for deep diving into the English entertainment market segment, identifying and closing deals, slates and titles that fit into the overall service programming for the category, and planning content selection for the forward looking 12+ months. This role will also involve negotiating license agreements and securing great content selection for Amazon (Prime Video). It's a mix of strategy and execution.

Key job responsibilities
Create Amazon's English entertainment content strategy driven by data analysis, customer preferences and market dynamics.
Identify content opportunities and partnerships with studios, independent producers and content owners/aggregators.
Negotiate license agreements in line with Amazon's guardrails with content providers to secure high demand content for the service. title: SDE II, EC2 Instance Networking, EC2 Nitro
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the networking infrastructure that powers every virtual machine in the world's largest cloud? Are you excited by the challenge of writing systems software that runs on millions custom networking cards across millions of hosts?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) Instance Networking team builds and operates the software-defined networking stack at the heart of AWS. Our code is what makes Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) work, what enforces customer security policies, and what enables workloads to scale from a single instance to clusters of tens of thousands. Every packet that enters or leaves an EC2 instance flows through software we write, running on custom silicon designed in-house.

This work sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and the AI revolution. As machine learning workloads grow to unprecedented scale - training runs spanning thousands of accelerators, clusters demanding millions of network endpoints, and fabrics pushing hundreds of gigabits per second. We build the networking primitives that make these workloads possible: high-performance interfaces, low-latency data plane protocols, and scalable network virtualization that operates predictably even under heavy churn. When the world's most ambitious AI companies scale on AWS, they're relying on the software we build.

You'll write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time
embedded environment. You'll work on network virtualization protocols, packet processing pipelines, and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements. You'll solve problems that span hardware, firmware, and
software, and see the direct impact of your work on customers running some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities
Own the design, development, and delivery of data plane networking features for EC2 instances running on custom Nitro hardware
Drive operational excellence for network virtualization systems serving millions of AWS customers worldwide
Ensure the reliability, performance, and security of VPC connectivity and policy enforcement at scale
Lead technical investigations into complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, delivering root cause analysis and long-term fixes
Contribute to the technical roadmap for EC2 Instance Networking, identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and customer experience
Partner with cross-functional teams — including hardware, control plane, and ML platform teams — to define and deliver end-to-end solutions
Raise the bar on engineering quality through code reviews, design reviews, and operational best practices

A day in the life
Write low-level systems code in C and Rust running on custom hardware in a real-time embedded environment
Design and implement data plane networking software across the full lifecycle — from design through deployment and operations
Build and improve network virtualization systems that deliver VPC connectivity, security policy enforcement, and performance isolation for EC2 customers
Develop packet processing pipelines and availability mechanisms that must perform correctly at massive scale with sub-second latency requirements
Investigate and resolve complex production issues across distributed embedded systems, driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes
Collaborate with partner teams across hardware, control plane, and ML platforms to deliver end-to-end solutions

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: Sr. Product Manager, Customer Experience Improvement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.
We are looking for a customer-obsessed product leader to join us in the EU Customer Experience Improvement org within Customer Service. You will be a part of the EU team of program managers, product managers, business analysts, and business intelligence engineers who dig deep into customer friction, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to improve CX. You and your team will own the roadmap of EU strategic initiatives while also responding to emerging issues that need immediate attention.

Key job responsibilities
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.

You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
You will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.

This is the right role for you if:
- You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
- You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
- You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
- You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
- You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.

A day in the life
- Lead customer experience workstreams by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction.

- Create scalable mechanisms to work across cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
- Establish data-driven approaches to detect issues, surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.

- Understand how AI is reshaping CX product architectures, product development and customer workflows; apply AI to enable faster learning cycles, accelerate development, make better decisions and unlock new forms of innovation

- Influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, engineering and business approach (internally and externally if applicable), vendors, partners, and organization priorities.
- Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues through high-quality analytics and communication.
- Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
- Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
- Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.

- Coach and develop high-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma, or Bachelor's degree
- Experience building and effectively executing a strategy from the ground up, including designing roadmaps to drive incremental progress towards long-term vision and goals
- Experience in technical product or program management
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with technical and business stakeholders from global cross-functional teams
- Experience using data and metrics to influence senior leadership and drive organizational change
- Experience managing the end-to-end product life cycle as a product manager

title: Senior Program Manager, Prime Video Beta, Prime Video AI and Automation
descriptionHtml:
Want to help decide when a new Prime Video experience is ready for customers in 240+ countries? The Prime Video Global Beta Team makes sure pre-release products, features and services meet a high quality bar before they go live. We put new experiences in front of real users on real devices around the world, collect their feedback on design, function and usability, and give product teams the confidence to launch.

As a Senior Program Manager on this team, you will own betas from intake to final report-out. You will work with product, engineering, UX, QA and launch teams to define what each beta needs to prove, figure out how to run it, and translate participant feedback into clear launch recommendations. You will also help the program itself grow by using data and technology to make betas faster and less manual. If you are a program manager who is comfortable bringing many teams to a single decision, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own each beta from start to finish: set objectives, define entry and exit criteria, run the beta, and deliver measurable results back to the product team.
- Run the intake and prioritization process, working with stakeholders across product, engineering, UX and QA to sort competing requests and make clear go/no-go calls.
- Dig into participant feedback and program data, spot trends and risks early, and present launch-readiness recommendations to product owners and senior leaders.
- Design the participant experience, covering sample size, surveys, communications, device setup and support, while keeping the participant pool healthy for future betas.
- Improve the program's day-to-day operations, from intake workflows and survey templates to dashboards and reporting, and explore where generative AI tools can save time without sacrificing quality.

A day in the life
You might start the morning on an intake call, helping a product team figure out whether their new feature needs a beta, a QA pass or a UX study. By midday you could be reading through survey responses from a live beta in several countries and flagging a usability issue to the feature team. In the afternoon you might work out how to split participants between two overlapping betas, then write up a report that gives leaders what they need to greenlight a launch.

About the team
The Beta team is part of Prime Video's Automation and AI organization. We are program managers and technical program managers who each own betas end to end, partnering with product, engineering and business teams across organizational lines. Over the next year we are focused on automating more of our beta operations and using generative AI to turn participant feedback into insights faster, so product teams can get answers in days rather than weeks. If you want a role where your work directly shapes the quality of what hundreds of millions of viewers see, this is a great place to be.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the technical background, customer experience, and skills necessary to help accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses? Join the Applied AI Solutions team as an Amazon Connect Specialist Solutions Architect!

The Applied AI Solutions Architecture team is seeking a hands-on, customer-obsessed Solutions Architect to accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities. Applied AI Solutions is part of the AWS Specialist & Partner (ASP) org, which works backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

A critical dimension of this role is Customer Data Readiness — assessing, preparing, and structuring customer data assets so that AI agents can reliably access, retrieve, and act on the right information. You will help customers evaluate their data landscape, identify gaps, establish data pipelines, and ensure their knowledge bases, CRMs, and backend systems are AI-ready before agents go live. You will work at the intersection of contact center operations and applied AI, helping customers move from proof-of-concept to pre-production for their Amazon Connect deployments. We stay closely connected to our customers and bring valuable data and insights to our product teams, strengthening the product roadmap. Our team is at its best when a customer is thinking big and needs specialized experience to innovate for their business.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Customer Engagement: Lead technical discovery sessions with customer teams to understand business requirements, existing contact center architecture, and AI readiness. Translate findings into actionable implementation plans.
Customer Data Readiness: Conduct data readiness assessments to evaluate the quality, accessibility, structure, and governance of customer data assets (CRMs, knowledge bases, ticketing systems, order management, etc.). Identify data gaps, recommend remediation strategies, and help customers build the data foundation required for effective AI agent tool use and RAG-powered responses.
Agentic AI Architecture and forward deploy implementation: Design and configure agentic AI solutions within Amazon Connect, including AI agent creation, AI prompt engineering, model selection, guardrail configuration, and tool/action integration.
A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Integration: Architect Agent-to-Agent communication patterns that allow Amazon Connect AI agents to collaborate with specialized agents across the enterprise (e.g., billing agents, order management agents, IT support agents), enabling multi-agent workflows that span organizational boundaries.
Integration Architecture and Development: Build serverless integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and scripting (Python, Node.js) to connect Amazon Connect AI agents with customer data systems (CRMs, ERPs, databases, knowledge bases).
Cloud Data Access: Architect secure access patterns to cloud-based data systems to power AI agent tool use and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Agentic IDE Proficiency: Leverage agentic development environments such as Kiro (and similar AI-assisted IDEs) to accelerate development workflows, including spec-driven development, agent hooks, MCP server configuration, and AI-assisted code generation.
Pre-Production Validation: Guide customers through testing, evaluation, and validation of AI agent performance against defined success criteria before production deployment.
Field Enablement: Share learnings, delivering technical deep-dives, and mentoring other SAs on agentic AI implementation patterns.

A day in the life
Conducting data readiness assessments, identifying gaps in knowledge base coverage, and recommending data preparation steps before AI agent configuration
Designing prompt strategies and evaluating model performance across different foundation models
Building Lambda functions and API integrations that serve as tools for AI agents
Configuring MCP servers to expose customer APIs, databases, and tools in a standardized format for agent consumption
Designing A2A workflows where Amazon Connect agents hand off to or collaborate with specialized agents across the customer's enterprise
Configuring knowledge bases and data connectors for RAG-powered agent responses
Running evaluation frameworks to measure AI agent accuracy, latency, and customer satisfaction
Conducting architecture reviews and providing prescriptive guidance for production readiness
Documenting implementation patterns and contributing to the team's knowledge base

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

This role will be physically based at our new MDD Pecos, TX site.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

descriptionHtml:

Logistics Specialists monitor inventory levels to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained to support build and repair activities. They receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Datacenter Technicians and Engineers. They will also be responsible for loading and unloading shipments and transporting parts between different locations. This position involves frequent lifting of materials and products. Logistics Specialists will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company. They must also maintain the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all workspace. They must be available to work shift work.
The ideal candidate will have experience working in a warehouse or distribution environment, as well as experience and knowledge of reverse logistics processes. Experience handling vendor relationships is helpful.


Key job responsibilities
- Receive logically and phisically material for Data Center Operations
- Mantain control of storage rooms, ensuring inventory accuracy and tidiness
- Attend Data Center operations requests, providing information and ticket resolution
- Physically move and lift objects

- Check your ticket que and locate parts needed for the Data Center Operations
- Receive physically and in the system incoming inventory
- Cycle count storage rooms to check if there is any inventory adjustment to be made

title: Embedded Software Development Engineer, Applied Automation Controls/Embedded Software
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer specializing in controls and embedded software to join our robotics team developing advanced workcell automation solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy real-time control systems that orchestrate complex robotic manipulation tasks within automated workcells. You will work at the intersection of embedded systems, motion control, and distributed software architecture to deliver reliable, high-performance automation solutions for production environments.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement real-time embedded control software for robotic workcells, including motion controllers, trajectory planners, and sensor integration modules that enable precise manipulation and coordination of robotic systems.
- Develop software architectures that balance real-time performance constraints with maintainability and extensibility, ensuring control systems can reliably execute complex automation sequences with microsecond-level timing precision.
- Own the development of embedded software components within the Workcell Controls Architecture, working closely with other teams to implement primitives and coordinate multi-robot operations.
- Partner with hardware teams to define control interfaces, implement device driver, and optimize software performance for industrial automation embedded platforms, and real-time operating systems.
- Lead technical design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions that impact the scalability, reliability, and performance of our control systems.
- Mentor team members on embedded systems best practices, real-time programming techniques, and controls engineering principles.
- Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems and drive root cause analysis for control system issues.

A day in the life
Lead technical design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions that impact the scalability, reliability, and performance of our control systems. Mentor team members on embedded systems best practices, real-time programming techniques, and industrial engineering principles. Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems and drive root cause analysis for control system issues.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that assist you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
You will join a focused team of approximately 10+ Software Development Engineers working at the forefront of robotic workcell automation. Our team is responsible for developing and maintaining the core software systems that power automated manipulation solutions, with primary focus areas including manipulation systems, Workcell Controls Architecture (WCA) development. We operate in a highly partnership focused environment where engineers work closely across disciplines to solve complex technical problems that span embedded systems, real-time control, motion planning, and distributed software architecture.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 2+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 4+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience

title: Software Development Engineer, MADS
descriptionHtml:
Build the attribution systems that connect ad interactions with real customer outcomes. You'll process more than 50 billion events per day to produce the measurements that power experiences across all of Amazon Ads and help millions of advertisers understand the true value of their campaigns. Attribution is at the heart of advertising measurement, and your work will directly influence how advertising budgets are optimized at global scale.

Accurate attribution at Amazon scale is one of the hardest engineering problems in advertising. Our systems connect signals across advertising products, customer journeys, devices, channels and conversion sources. That means solving problems in massive-scale data processing, distributed systems, identity and signal fragmentation, evolving privacy requirements and complex attribution methodologies. The measurements we produce are foundational signals for reporting, campaign optimization, machine learning models, analytics applications and emerging AI-powered advertising experiences.

What Makes This Role Stand Out

- 50B+ events per day: petabyte-scale data pipelines using Spark, EMR, Apache Iceberg, DynamoDB and other AWS services
- Engineering meets science: work directly with applied scientists and economists to turn new measurement methodologies into scalable production systems
- End-to-end ownership: take an ambiguous measurement problem through design, implementation, launch and operations
- Direct business impact: the data you produce helps millions of advertisers make better investment decisions and powers optimization across Amazon's full advertising suite
- Build new, not just maintain: design new architectures that improve scalability, data freshness, correctness, reliability and cost efficiency

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop and deliver software that produces measurement data used across Amazon's full advertising suite, including display, search, native and video
- Build and maintain petabyte-scale data pipelines and services using Spark, EMR, Apache Iceberg and Java, developing new big data approaches to keep pace with rapid growth
- Solve complex attribution challenges as technical requirements, privacy rules and priorities change
- Collaborate with applied scientists, economists, product managers and engineers across teams to turn measurement methodologies into scalable production systems
- Apply a range of architectural approaches and design patterns to deliver maintainable, scalable, well-tested solutions in a high-throughput environment
- Contribute to technical design discussions, identify tradeoffs and propose solutions that balance performance, cost and long-term maintainability
- Uphold engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing strategies and operational excellence (alarms, runbooks, monitoring), and mentor peers through design and code reviews

About the team
The Measurement, AdTech, and Data Science (MADS) team defines and produces the metrics advertisers rely on to analyze the performance of their ad investments. Our charter covers the systems that compute and distribute estimated conversions at massive scale. We work across a rich technology stack, combining AWS services like EMR, Kinesis and AWS Batch with open-source technologies such as Spark and Presto, to deliver fast, reliable measurement at the speed advertisers demand.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
