title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Border Network Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building systems that keep one of the world's largest networks running? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a team that builds traffic engineering and fast-reroute solutions for the AWS global backbone network — the infrastructure behind S3, EC2, Direct Connect, and every AWS service.

In this role, you'll design and build software that detects congestion and failures across 400+ global sites and automatically reroutes traffic to healthier paths. You'll work at the intersection of distributed systems and networking, solving problems that directly impact the reliability and performance of AWS for millions of customers.

You'll be part of a hybrid team of software, systems development, and network engineers across the US and Australia. This position is based in Seattle and sits at the heart of AWS global networking.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain software services that steer traffic across the AWS global backbone network
- Develop and extend traffic engineering controllers that detect congestion and failures in real time and automatically reroute traffic to healthier paths
- Write clean, well-tested code in a production environment where availability directly impacts AWS customers
- Contribute to system design discussions — from API design to data modelling to choosing the right trade-offs for scale and reliability
- Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and automation tooling to give the team better visibility into network health
- Collaborate with network engineers, systems engineers, and partner teams to translate operational needs into software solutions
- Participate in code reviews, providing thoughtful and constructive feedback to teammates
- Participate in on-call rotations (typically one week every two months), working with the team to resolve issues and fix root causes
- Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve existing systems and processes

A day in the life
You'll spend most of your time building software that gives us visibility and control over traffic across the AWS backbone. On any given day you might be designing a new feature, reviewing a teammate's code, or debugging issues. You'll work closely with network engineers and partner teams — a lot of what you build is about detecting problems and mitigating them before customers notice. Beyond coding, you'll join design discussions and on-call rotations. The work mixes building new things with keeping existing systems reliable at massive scale.

About the team
We build the systems that keep traffic flowing across the AWS global backbone — connecting every region and edge location worldwide. Our network grows ~70% year-on-year, so the problems we solve constantly evolve. The team is distributed across the US, Canada and Australia, and this role is based in Sydney. We have a broad mix of experience levels and backgrounds, and we genuinely value mentorship and knowledge sharing. What matters most is curiosity and a willingness to solve hard problems.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:

Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Work with partners and customers to deploy Amazon WorkSpaces - Personal, Pools and Core; Amazon AppStream 2.0, and Amazon WorkSpaces Thin Client

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

title: Sr. Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer / Architect, AWS Bespoke Solutions
descriptionHtml:
The Bespoke Solutions group in AWS Region Services is looking for a Interdisciplinary Systems Engineer with technical leadership experience leading hardware, software, and FGPA developers through the systems engineering lifecycle from conception to delivery.

We develop AWS owned hardware solutions in order to scale globally, minimize cost, and maximize value for our customers. We are a growing team of hardware, software and FPGA engineers with a dedicated product development lab in Arlington, VA.

You will perform system/product definition, requirements decomposition, technical risk assessments, and end to end testing for scalable high assurance embedded systems in the AWS technology ecosystem.

As a member of the Bespoke Solutions Team in Region Services, you will be joining a talented full-stack development team (hardware and software) that is laser-focused on developing network security products that enable our Amazon Dedicated Cloud to operate efficiently at scale.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Evaluate, develop, and deliver solutions for the lifecycle of complex interdisciplinary system design problems for which the technical strategy is frequently not defined
- Derive requirements for system efficiency, operational excellence, and user experience.
- Lead design and system engineers to perform verification and validation of certification requirements.
- Generate technical artifacts that ensure design completeness and improve system traceability.
- Lead design meetings to plan development and review peer designs.
- Test/verify new technologies to improve the customer experience.
- Mentor and educate other engineers on systems goals and constraints in relation to physical, interfaces, compliance, data management, and risk management.

A day in the life
You will be a technical leader on a cross-functional team of hardware and software developers, focusing on system-level integration and verification. You will help set and maintain the standard for system testing and verification, understanding and planning for the impact of team decisions on overall system architecture in team meetings, design reviews, and through written documents. You will lead architectural discussions, and strategic planning meetings.

You will use and develop CI/CD pipelines to automatically run your own unit tests, and hardware in the loop tests. You help deploy embedded software onto hardware targets and help debug issues that come along in RTL, hardware, or software. You will develop and document software sub-systems and components in Rust, you will coordinate with the team daily to make design decisions, resolve blockers, and review code.

You will guide system architecture development and trade studies for encryption devices, key management systems, FPGAs, and ASICs. You will generate artifacts for design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) as part of the government certification processes. You will work with various teams to establish requirements, develop verification methods, and ensure system specifications are met. You will use tools such as Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) or Systems Modeling Language (SysML) to create and maintain system documentation, including test procedures, requirements documentation, and verification matrices.

You will demonstrate a high standard, help prioritize development activities and educate others about systems engineering best practices and tools.

title: Data Center Materials Associate, Corporate IT Logistics, Operations, IT, & Support Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the customer experience. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Amazon's IT Logistics and Imaging Team (ITS-LIT) operates a warehouse-scale production floor that images, provisions, and manages the lifecycle of every corporate laptop and device deployed to Amazonians across the United States. Our team at SEA124 (Ouroboros) in Renton, WA processes thousands of devices weekly — supporting new hire onboarding, device refreshes, inventory management, reverse logistics, and data destruction.

We are seeking a Data Center Materials Associate to join our warehouse operations team. In this role, you will support daily inventory and logistics work — receiving and inducting IT assets, picking, packing, shipping, and processing returns. You'll follow standard procedures, work through assigned tasks as priorities shift during the day, and focus on accuracy and quality in every transaction. You'll also help keep IT areas clean, organized, and audit-ready.

This is a hands-on warehouse environment where your work directly supports Amazon's ability to deliver devices to employees on Day 1.

Our team approaches work as seeing no job as too small and no challenge as too big!

Key job responsibilities
- Support daily inventory operations, including receiving, induct, storage, picking, packing, and shipping of IT assets and peripherals
- Complete assigned tasks across queues and programs, following daily priorities set by the team
- Restock IT inventory locations, vending machines, and supply stores, and report low stock to your lead

title: Data Analyst Apprentice - 42 month Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Are you a curious problem-solver who loves finding the story hidden in the numbers? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as a Data Analyst Apprentice.

You'll be part of a dynamic team that turns complex, messy data into insight the business can act on - working with teams across the organisation to solve real-world challenges. The problems you solve will help shape experiences for millions of customers.

This apprenticeship is where you'll grow. You'll build your technical toolkit alongside the critical thinking to understand a problem before you solve it, and the confidence to communicate what your findings actually mean.

A day in the life can involve:

- Diving into diverse data sets, cleansing and transforming them into structured formats for analysis

- Leveraging powerful data visualisation tools to bring information to life and tell a story

- Collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation, understanding their needs and translating them into actionable insights

- Staying up to date with the latest trends and developments

- Participating in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities


Our data team is a passionate group who thrive on turning complex information into meaning. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster - so you'll be encouraged to bring your ideas, test them, and learn as you go, with the mentorship and support to help you excel.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds. What matters most is a meticulous eye for detail - you'll be working with large datasets where accuracy and quality really count - along with the flexibility to adapt as priorities shift.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing – putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions (Data Analysis Pathway) Degree. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time, developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 42-month period, starting in September. Your apprenticeship will combine classroom/virtual-based training, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, and mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities – provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're also continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer, so you'll have the resources and support to develop into a well-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine curiosity about data and a passion for finding the story behind the numbers
- Great analytical and logical thinking ability, with an enjoyment of problem-solving

- Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a team

descriptionHtml:
Mechatroniker / Elektroniker / Mechaniker / Servicetechniker oder vergleichbare Fachkräfte als Instandhaltungstechniker:in in unserem Logistikzentrum in Kobern-Gondorf bei Koblenz gesucht!

Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

*** Die Stelle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einem rotierenden Dreischichtsystem, welches Samstage, Nachtschichten sowie Rufbereitschaft umfassen kann. ***

Wir bieten:
- Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon
- Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket
- Eine kostenlose Lebens- und Erwerbsunfähigkeitsversicherung und Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
- Amazon Career Choice Programm, mit dem wir Weiterbildungen mit bis zu 8.000€ unterstützen
- Mitarbeiterrabatte auf amazon.de sowie Amazon Extras (z.B. Rabatte in Reisen, Restaurants, Unterhaltung, Elektronik, Heim etc.)
- Pendlerleistungen: Kostenloses Parken oder Kostenübernahme für das Deutschlandticket
- Familienbonus (Einmalzahlung für Eltern in Elternzeit)
- Vermittlungsservices für die Betreuung von Kindern, Senioren und Menschen mit besonderen Bedürfnissen
- Ein kostenloses Mitarbeiterhilfeprogramm (auch für Familienmitglieder) für eine Beratung bei beruflichen oder privaten Angelegenheiten
- Hervorragende Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem globalen Unternehmen

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life


Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

title: Security Clearance Processing Administrator, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Clearance Processing Administrator to build and sustain the cleared workforce for a U.S. Government program standing up a classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with getting the right people cleared, badged, and mission-effective as fast as the rules allow, because clearance throughput is the single biggest driver of whether this program starts on time. In this role you own personnel clearance processing end to end: submitting and tracking crossover packets and SCI access requests, verifying eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and coordinating adjudications and access determinations with our sponsoring security office. You will work in the trenches with personnel security, program security officers, and hiring managers to turn a 120-plus person staffing plan into people who can actually walk into the SCIF and work. If you thrive on high-volume, high-stakes personnel security, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Submit and track clearance crossover packets and SCI access requests (e.g., via the Government clearance-submission system).
• Verify eligibility, citizenship, SSBI/CIP currency, and need-to-know prior to access.
• Coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and access determinations.
• Maintain the personnel-security database and access records, and remove access when no longer required.

A day in the life
Each day starts with the clearance queue. You triage incoming crossover packets and SCI access requests, verify eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and push the cleanest cases forward first to keep throughput high. You coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and pending access determinations, chase down the one missing document holding up a start date, and update the personnel-security database so records stay audit-ready. Between submissions you partner with program security officers and hiring managers to sequence the staffing plan, flagging risks before they stall a start. By day's end, more people can walk into the SCIF.

title: Equipment Engineer, Equipment Engineering , Equipment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) in Pasadena, CA, is looking to hire an Equipment Engineer who will aid in AWS’s effort to bring cloud quantum computing services to its worldwide customer base. The candidate will work in a cleanroom environment alongside research scientists and process engineers, keeping complex semiconductor fabrication & characterization equipment in working order. Responsibilities include troubleshooting equipment-related issues, performing preventative maintenance and calibrations, interacting with vendors during the installation of new equipment and scheduled repairs, making self-guided & team-guided improvements to the lab infrastructure, and taking the lead on aspects of our equipment health program. The facility is focused on research and development, which utilizes equipment ranging from reactive ion etchers, to various material deposition tools, to advanced characterization instruments, most of which are classified as vacuum systems. The candidate will evaluate and develop procedures that provide maximum tool up-time for wafer processing and characterization while maintaining the equipment at optimal performance. Candidates must have a demonstrated background in fundamental engineering principles and must have excellent problem solving and communication skills. Successful candidates will have prior experience working in an academic or industrial fabrication facility, or similar. Working effectively within a team environment is critical.

Key job responsibilities
An Equipment Engineer troubleshoots problems related to equipment and other lab infrastructure, then devises and documents the solutions such that the problems can be more easily solved the next time they occur. When necessary, the Equipment Engineer works with field service engineers from the company that manufactured the equipment, scheduling service calls and supervising & documenting those engineers' work in our labs. The Equipment Engineer is responsible for improving the up-time of equipment, which involves developing better preventative maintenance (PM) plans, executing the PMs, performing equipment calibrations, owning equipment health initiatives, implementing new equipment-tracking initiatives in our manufacturing execution system (MES), and obsessing over the details of the equipment such that it can operate at peak performance. The Equipment Engineer may assist with the development and/or implementation of hardware modifications and new lab upgrades. The Equipment Engineer has ownership of equipment and lab spaces and is responsible for the reliable, excellent performance of our labs and everything that operates within it.

A day in the life
The Equipment Engineer performs a daily morning lab walkthrough to assess the state of their assigned lab areas and equipment. Based on priorities set by the team, the engineer works on solving new problems or existing problems from the previous day. Preventative maintenance checks and/or calibrations are performed according to a schedule. When time permits and there aren't problems to solve that are limiting team productivity, projects centered around the improvement of equipment and lab spaces are undertaken. In all aspects of the work, documentation of notes, procedures, fixes, and projects is pivotal. The engineer's goal is to maximize equipment up-time and performance so their teammates can operate the equipment reliably, and the whole team can deliver fabricated devices for quantum computing experiments.

About the team
Export Control Requirement:

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be either a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be able to obtain a U.S export license. If you are unsure if you meet these requirements, please apply and Amazon will review your application for eligibility.

Our team is comprised of scientists and engineers who are building hardware that enables quantum computing technologies. Doing that requires the fabrication of quantum devices, which necessitates the operation of a suite of fabrication and characterization equipment. Equipment Engineers work to maintain and improve the equipment – and the labs in which the equipment is installed – and work alongside Process Engineers and Research Scientists to help deliver fabricated devices for quantum computing experiments.

- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Experience with prototyping and implementation
- Experience problem solving and root cause analysis

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or 5+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
- Experience in development in the last 3 years, or experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware
- Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings, or experience with electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment
- 5 years or more of Semiconductor Equipment Engineer Experience in one of the Semiconductor modules (Photolithography, Deposition, Etch, Wet Processing Equipment, and Packaging and Assembly Equipment).
- Statistical Process Control (SPC)
- Equipment Qualification
- Associate's Degree (A.S.) in Electronics, Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, Industrial Maintenance, Semiconductor Manufacturing, or a related technical field; or Military Electronics training; or higher degree (B.S., M.S.) in an engineering discipline.
- Proficiency troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, and automation systems.

Preferred qualifications

AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

私たちは数億という膨大な商品を取り扱っており、多くのサプライヤーから入荷したアイテムはフルフィルメントセンターという物流拠点に集約され、各地のデリバリーステーション（DS）を経てお客様先に届けられます。この職種の主な役割はこのデリバリーステーションと呼ばれる物流拠点のマネジメントになります。

具体的には膨大な数の商品を効率的かつスムーズにお届けするためのオペレーションの工程管理やピープルマネジメントなどをお任せします。

アマゾンの物流の根幹を支えるポジションです。そして、私たちは今、日本全国にデリバリーステーション(DS)を展開し、Amazonの物流ネットワークを日々拡大し続けています。そのような事業成長環境の中で、挑みがいのあるミッションにあなたの経験を活かしてみませんか。

Key job responsibilities
■オペレーションの工程管理
入荷した商品の仕分け・出荷作業計画や効率的な配送地域の計画や見直し・改善立案します。
“どのアイテムを、いつ、何人で仕分けするか”などをプランニングしてください。
チームメンバーと連携をしっかり取り、仕分けや配送などが滞りなく進む計画を立ててください。
あなたのプランで実際に顧客が望んでいる日に届けられるかが決まる責任感とやりがいの中で、積極的に提案ができる裁量権の大きいポジションです。

■ピープルマネジメント
仕分けや出荷、配送などを担うスタッフの育成や業務指示などのマネジメント業務です。
人員は数十名で拠点ごとによって異なります。物流量に合わせてシフトを組むほか、業務がスムーズに進捗しているかなどを管理します。
シフト調整を担当するアシスタントスタッフ（2～4名）と連携し、状況把握や指示出しなどをしてください。業務管理は社内システムで行います。

■業務改善
安全・品質・生産性向上や業務効率化などを実現するための業務です。
データや現場で得た仮説から、業務フローや業務環境、作業内容などにおける問題を見つけ、改善案やその実施計画を立案します。
マネージャー陣とともに定期的に業務改善の議論を行い・サポートをするため、物流業界が初めてのご経験でも安心してキャッチアップいただけますし是非積極的に改善の提案をお願いします。

A day in the life
日勤・夜勤のシフト勤務になります。
※各拠点ごとにシフト勤務の詳細が異なりますので詳しくは面談や選考時にご確認下さい。

■教育制度
入社後、8週間ほどのトレーニング期間がございます。Amazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。

（店舗管理（アパレルや飲食など）、サービス、営業、コンサルティング、ホテル業界、航空業界、官公庁など）

title: 2027 Account Rep Intern, Amazon Payments
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is continually evolving and is a place where motivated employees thrive and also where employee ownership and accountability lead to meaningful results.

Are you willing to dive deep to develop those solutions and deliver results? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires us to work with a dynamic network of retail, HR, marketing, tech and operations partners. We help others understand finance and are trusted business advisors. We employ every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and our leaders have the most up to date and reliable information to help them make the best possible decision.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop the analytical and problem-solving skills that our people are known for
- Build an understanding of customer pain points, requirements, and potential value that can be delivered by advertising or merchant services
- Identify target accounts using market data and industry intelligence
- Learn the advertising or merchant services portfolio and the Amazon culture
- Identify opportunities to improve our products, services, processes, systems, and tools
- Work with different parts of the Amazon business to implement improvement projects, including working with category teams, product teams, and technical support teams
- Available to commence an internship in Q2 2027. You should be available for 3 to 6 months, full time (40h/week).

A day in the life
As an intern, you will be matched to a mentor.
In addition to learning about an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real-world setting.

About the team
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.
- Competitive pay
- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
- Mentorship and career development

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies

Internship length is 3 to 6 months, full-time.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in or will receive a Bachelor's or Master's Degree with a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English
- Available to commence an internship between January and December 2027. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available for 3-6 months, full time (40h/week).

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you

title: Senior Social Media Manager, Seller External Relations
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Social Media Manager to lead platform-native storytelling and drive audience growth and engagement across YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Reddit, and emerging platforms. In this role, you'll architect SER's vision for high-impact social experiences that build sustainable audiences, drive channel discovery, fuel authentic engagement, and directly support Amazon's perception work.

This is a strategic role operating at the intersection of content strategy, creator ecosystems, audience psychology, and business impact. You'll own the social strategy that amplifies SER's core programs, working across internal teams, external creators, agencies, and platforms to maximize reach and perception lift among sellers and the audiences who shape public opinion about Amazon's impact on small business.

ABOUT YOU
You are a digital creative strategist obsessed with audience behavior, creator ecosystems, and platform mechanics. You bring a proven track record of growing audiences and engagement on social video platforms, with deep expertise in YouTube, TikTok, and Meta algorithm optimization. You are not just a content creator, you are a builder who understands how to architect sustainable growth through strategic positioning, format innovation, and cross-platform amplification.

You are comfortable leading ambiguity and building consensus across multiple stakeholders. You navigate the tension between creative vision and business objectives with confidence. You understand that great social strategy isn't about vanity metrics—it's about the data behind what actually moves audiences: retention, identity alignment, actionable value, and authentic connection.

You bring an innate understanding of:
● Platform-native storytelling: How different platforms reward different formats, cadences, and narrative approaches
● Creator psychology: What motivates creators to cross-promote, what formats drive engagement vs. what drives consumption
● Virality mechanics: Not just what goes viral, but how to engineer sustainable growth through repeatable formats and audience building
● Perception lift: How social content drives measurable business outcomes (brand lift studies, CTR benchmarks, engagement that converts)
● Cross-platform strategy: How to architect content that lives differently on YouTube (long-form discovery), TikTok (format experimentation), Meta (amplification), and emerging platforms.
● You have led or significantly influenced creator campaigns, influencer partnerships, or social initiatives that delivered measurable results. You're comfortable navigating Amazon's scale, complexity, and stakeholder landscape while maintaining creative velocity. You understand how to work with agencies, talent, and internal teams without losing editorial vision.

Key job responsibilities
STRATEGY & VISION
● Develop and own SER's comprehensive social strategy with a clear mandate: grow new audiences, deliver standout engagement, and drive perception lift among audiences on YouTube, TikTok, Meta, Reddit, and emerging platforms.
● Define what SER's "voice" is across platforms—ensuring content feel cohesive while respecting platform-native norms and audience expectations.
● Map editorial calendars across multiple channels and initiatives, balancing evergreen programming (serialized shows, recurring formats) with timely, culturally relevant content drops that capture attention and perform on algorithms.
● Build a repeatable content framework that reduces friction and maintains consistency—templates for copy, shorts, thumbnail design, title framing, CTAs, and posting cadences that work across platforms without feeling formulaic.

PERFORMANCE & ANALYTICS
● Establish and monitor KPIs aligned to business objectives: subscriber growth, watch time, view duration, CTR, engagement rate, retention curves, and perception lift where applicable. Define benchmarks and weekly/monthly reporting cadence.
● Analyze performance and platform trends deeply and frequently to optimize future content. Move beyond vanity metrics—identify which content drives identity alignment, what drives retention vs. abandonment, and what leads to cross-promotion and algorithm amplification.
● Conduct format experiments systematically (e.g., longer episodes, interactive segments, shorts) with clear success metrics and decision criteria for scaling or sunsetting.
● Report on how social efforts ladder into SER's broader perception goals.

CULTURE & MINDSET
● Stay obsessed with what actually performs on social platforms. You read platform release notes, study competitor strategies, and build a mental model of algorithm incentives that informs every content decision.
● Bring creative confidence balanced with data discipline. You can argue for a format experiment based on platform trends, then course-correct quickly if the data doesn't support it.
● Operate with strategic patience. Building sustainable audiences on social takes time. You understand the difference between viral moments and compounding growth, and you're committed to the latter.
● Thrive in ambiguity. SER is a fast-moving org where priorities shift, budgets change, and the landscape evolves. You stay grounded in core objectives while adapting your tactics.
● Lead up and across. You are able to articulate SER's social strategy to executives, collaborate effectively with creators and agencies, and inspire internal teams around the vision.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team experience
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- AI-competent, integrating AI into workflows for enhanced productivity
- Experience leading creative agencies
- Experience with social media analytics platforms like Sprinklr to translate data into insights.
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value

title: Data Center Technician (Night)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum payment will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required

Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds

Working in cramped and/or elevated locations

Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Work in a noisy environment

Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:

Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution

Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context

Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of network design, protocols and Layer 1/2 troubleshooting
- Associate's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering), or experience in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Networking Engineering)
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Experience effectively prioritizing work time to ensure efficiency

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Insurance, AWS Global Financial Sevices
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by helping enterprise customers reimagine what's possible in the cloud? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to partner with one of the fastest-growing accounts in the insurance industry. In this role, you will combine deep technical knowledge of AWS services with business acumen to architect solutions that address real challenges, from modernizing legacy platforms to exploring agentic AI implementations that unlock new value across customer lines of business.

You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to identify net new opportunities, shape technology strategy, and accelerate cloud adoption. If you enjoy translating complex business needs into practical, well-architected solutions and thrive when your work directly drives measurable growth, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver end-to-end cloud architectures tailored to insurance industry use cases, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, cost-optimized, and aligned with the customer's long-term business goals.
- Lead technical discussions with customer teams, from engineers to senior executives, to build consensus on solution approaches, communicate trade-offs clearly, and influence technology strategy across lines of business.
- Identify and develop net new opportunities by mapping AWS services, including emerging capabilities such as agentic AI, to customer pain points and growth areas.
- Create and deliver thought leadership content such as workshops, proof-of-concept demonstrations, whitepapers, and blog posts that educate customers on cloud best practices and accelerate adoption.
- Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to relay customer feedback, shape service improvements, and contribute reusable solution patterns that benefit the broader Solutions Architecture community.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review alongside the customer's engineering team, working through the architecture for a new claims-processing workload. After that, you join a strategy call with sales and business development to map upcoming opportunities across the account. In the afternoon, you prototype a proof of concept that demonstrates how AWS services can streamline an underwriting workflow, then wrap up by documenting the pattern so other architects can reuse it. Throughout, you balance deep technical work with relationship-building conversations that keep the customer's cloud journey on track.

About the team

title: Security Clearance Processing Administrator, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Clearance Processing Administrator to build and sustain the cleared workforce for a U.S. Government program standing up a classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with getting the right people cleared, badged, and mission-effective as fast as the rules allow, because clearance throughput is the single biggest driver of whether this program starts on time. In this role you own personnel clearance processing end to end: submitting and tracking crossover packets and SCI access requests, verifying eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and coordinating adjudications and access determinations with our sponsoring security office. You will work in the trenches with personnel security, program security officers, and hiring managers to turn a 120-plus person staffing plan into people who can actually walk into the SCIF and work. If you thrive on high-volume, high-stakes personnel security, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Submit and track clearance crossover packets and SCI access requests (e.g., via the Government clearance-submission system).
• Verify eligibility, citizenship, SSBI/CIP currency, and need-to-know prior to access.
• Coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and access determinations.
• Maintain the personnel-security database and access records, and remove access when no longer required.

A day in the life
Each day starts with the clearance queue. You triage incoming crossover packets and SCI access requests, verify eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and push the cleanest cases forward first to keep throughput high. You coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and pending access determinations, chase down the one missing document holding up a start date, and update the personnel-security database so records stay audit-ready. Between submissions you partner with program security officers and hiring managers to sequence the staffing plan, flagging risks before they stall a start. By day's end, more people can walk into the SCIF.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Annapurna Labs Silicon Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS-Annapurna team develops the silicon used in our most advanced machine learning accelerator servers at cutting edge process nodes. These SoCs are used in massively scaled server clusters to provide best hardware platform for our customers to run training and inference workloads.

Our final product is a server, not just the silicon, so you will find yourself stretching beyond traditional silicon product engineering boundaries and dealing with various system issues and data sets, providing ample opportunities to learn.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end execution for complex silicon products from development through qualification, production ramp, and high-volume manufacturing.

You will own the integrated product schedule across Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Design, DFT, System Validation, Packaging, Quality, Reliability, Supply Chain, Foundry, OSAT, and external silicon partners.

This role requires you to be the owner of the outcome, not the status update -
You will identify the critical path, expose technical and execution risks early, establish clear owners and dates, drive decisions, and hold teams accountable for closure. You will dive deep enough into technical issues to identify owners, distinguish real blockers from noise and escalate when a decision is required.

Success means products hit committed milestones with the required quality, capacity, and manufacturing readiness


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end silicon product schedule from tapeout and first silicon through bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, ramp, and HVM.
- Build and maintain integrated execution plans across silicon, package, test, quality, reliability, manufacturing, and supply-chain dependencies.
- Define milestones, entry and exit criteria, owners, critical paths, and recovery plans.
- Drive Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Design, DFT, Packaging, System Validation, Quality, Reliability, and Supply Chain teams to committed deliverables.
- Dive deep on execution blockers; identify owner, root cause, decision required, and recovery path.
- Drive closure of risks affecting schedule, quality, yield, test coverage, qualification, cost, capacity, or production readiness.
- Own execution/communication of schedules and needs across foundry, OSAT and other external manufacturing partners.
- Identify long-lead dependencies early, including wafer starts, masks, test hardware, package material, sockets, load boards, qualification hardware, equipment capacity, and translate product demand into manufacturing-capacity requirements and ensure capacity is available when the product needs it.
- Drive readiness reviews for first silicon, characterization, qualification, production release, and volume ramp.
- Establish mechanisms that expose schedule health, risks, decisions, and dependencies without relying on manual status collection.
- Escalate early when teams cannot meet commitments. Bring options, trade-offs, and a recommended path.
- Drive decisions when engineering quality, schedule, cost, capacity, and product requirements conflict.
- Communicate program health to senior leadership with clear facts: what changed, why it matters, what decision is required, who owns the action, and when it will close.
- Identify recurring execution failures and drive mechanism changes so the same problem does not reoccur on the next product.
- Scale common planning, readiness, and execution mechanisms across multiple silicon programs.

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering technology programs that create real impact for Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. We are building an inclusive environment where program managers and engineers work side by side to simplify complex systems and ship meaningful improvements. If you are looking for a role where your program management expertise directly shapes outcomes and where you can grow alongside talented colleagues, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology
- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, silicon operations, manufacturing, or technical program management.
- Demonstrated ownership of semiconductor programs through major milestones such as tapeout, first silicon, bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, ramp, or HVM.
- Working knowledge of semiconductor product-development and manufacturing flows across wafer fabrication, wafer sort, package assembly, final test, SLT, characterization, qualification, reliability, yield, and failure analysis.
- Experience driving execution across engineering teams that do not report to you.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with CPU, GPU, AI/ML accelerator, networking, or other large advanced-node SoCs.
- Experience driving products into high-volume manufacturing.
- Experience with advanced packaging, chiplets, 2.5D/3D integration, or HBM.
- Experience with ATE, SLT, product characterization, manufacturing test, yield ramp, and product qualification.
- Direct experience with leading foundry and OSAT partners.
- Experience managing capacity across wafer, package, assembly, and test.
- Experience owning multiple products or silicon generations concurrently.
- Experience creating execution mechanisms for a silicon organization that is scaling rapidly.

title: Senior Site EHS Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, PXT Central Science
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross-team measurement-science initiatives from definition through delivery. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, can create structure where none exists, and can force-multiply across many teams and organizations to land significantly complex technical programs.

This is a technical program role that demands technical depth in science and software engineering. You will bring strong, data-driven judgment about the statistical systems that power employee listening, using that judgment to frame trade-offs, sequence delivery, and keep significantly complex scientific programs on track across teams.

As our senior technical program leader, you will operate with complete independence across the Corporate, Worldwide Operations, and cross-cutting portfolios. You will drive program delivery where the business and methodological strategy has not yet been defined — working from research questions and methodology owned by science leadership, and orchestrating the science, engineering, and business teams required to deliver them at scale. You will advise VPs and senior leaders on program status, risks, and trade-offs.

Key job responsibilities
Cross-Team Technical Program Delivery
• Own the delivery lifecycle of significantly complex, cross-team measurement-science programs — from requirements and sequencing through delivery, iteration, and long-term sustainability.
• Force-multiply across science, engineering, and business teams, aligning many contributors toward coherent delivery of programs that no single team owns end to end.
• Drive delivery in ambiguous, novel problem spaces where methodological and business strategy has not yet been defined, creating structure and a path forward where none exists.

Science-Systems Technical Judgment
• Bring deep, data-driven judgment about the measurement-science systems that power employee listening — sampling, weighting, instrument pipelines, and statistical methods — to frame technical trade-offs and identify delivery risks. Expertise is expected in measurement science, not software engineering.
• Identify risks and opportunities in measurement-science strategies and the systems that implement them, driving simplification and efficiency across complex, interdependent scientific programs.
• Recognize when a program needs additional scientific guidance and engage science leadership or subject-matter experts at the right moments.
Science Partnership & Translation
• Partner with research scientists to understand research questions and methodology, and translate them into cross-team technical program plans, sequencing, and delivery milestones.
• Independently author accurate, decision-driving documents for senior leadership, including program plans, technical narratives, and launch reviews. Accuracy is non-negotiable: errors in how the science is represented undermine both trust and program integrity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
• Build and maintain trusted relationships across PXT LT organizations, representing measurement-science programs.
• Influence organizational priorities, resource allocation, and technical direction across teams and VP organizations without direct authority — aligning diverse teams toward simple, coherent approaches.
• Manage escalations (is escalated to), proactively driving program and senior-leader reviews that surface risks, opportunities, and trade-offs clearly.
Business Expansion & New Populations
• Drive the technical program delivery required to extend measurement science to new business expansions, including Whole Foods Market, One Medical, Last Mile/Middle Mile, and future workforce populations.
• Ensure new populations are integrated into the measurement framework without degrading existing program quality or scientific standards.

Process Improvement & Automation
• Identify and drive automation and process improvement across measurement-science delivery — reducing manual overhead and recurring effort while preserving data integrity.
• Create, optimize, and drive adoption of cross-organizational mechanisms that accelerate delivery and ensure programs succeed long-term, with or without your direct involvement.
• Actively develop the TPM community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and sharing best practices.


A day in the life
You might start your morning unblocking a cross-team dependency between a science workstream and the engineering team building its data pipeline, then move into a working session with scientists to sequence the delivery of a new weighting approach across several populations. After lunch, you could be driving a program review that aligns three teams on a shared delivery plan, surfacing a methodological risk that needs science leadership’s decision. Later, you present a program narrative to a VP, distilling a significantly complex cross-team effort into a clear, data-driven recommendation. You end the day mentoring a TPM on the team. No two days are identical — the common thread is the combination of science-systems judgment, cross-team orchestration, and delivery precision.

About the team
PXT Central Science (PXTCS) is Amazon’s people-science R&D organization. We develop causal inference methods, predictive models, and decision-support tools that operate at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and organizational science. Our work spans employee experience, workforce planning, compensation, talent acquisition, and employee relations — always grounded in rigorous methodology and always aimed at real-world impact.

The eXperience Measurement Science (XMS) team owns the experience measurement strategy and execution for global Amazon, operationalized primarily through Amazon Connections. We set and execute a scientific data collection strategy that underpins listening, modeling, prediction, and insights across Amazon’s workforce of over one million employees — while prioritizing a positive responder experience. Our work sits at the intersection of science, engineering, and business strategy.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

title: Account Manager, Amazon
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business は、個人事業主から大企業まで、あらゆる規模の法人のお客様に、新しく効率的な調達体験をお届けする B2B 事業です。日本の Amazon Business マーケットプレイス（3P）は、すでに多数の販売事業者（セラー）にご参加いただき高い成長を続けていますが、法人のお客様が「Amazon で必ず買える」と感じられる品揃えには、まだ大きな空白が残っています。


本ポジションは、この空白を埋めることをミッションとする Account Manager です。担当する販売事業者の売上拡大のコンサルティングを行うとともに、品揃えの空白を特定し、新たな販売事業者の獲得から立ち上げ・育成までを担います。社内の各機能チーム（法人顧客側の営業、Retail カテゴリー、プロダクト、BI、Finance、Legal 等）および社外のパートナー企業を巻き込みながら、担当領域の成長戦略を自ら設計し、実行していただきます。


Amazon Business 3P の事業は、成熟した領域、これから一気に伸ばす重点領域、まだ勝ちパターンが確立していない立ち上げ領域という、性質の異なる複数のセグメントで構成されています。選考を通じて、ご経験と志向に最も合うセグメントへの配属を決定します。いずれのセグメントでも、進め方があらかじめ定義されていない部分が多く、曖昧さの中で自ら仮説を立て、優先順位を決め、データと現場の声で検証しながら前進していただくことを期待します。




Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities


1. 担当領域の成長戦略の立案（ゴール、対象、手法、KPI）
チームおよび自身の年間目標を達成するために、担当の販売事業者・担当業界の売上をどう拡大するかの戦略を立てます。その戦略は、論理的・効果的・効率的・現実的であることが求められます。

2. 販売事業者への提案と実行
立てた戦略に基づいて迅速に営業・コンサルティング活動を行い、結果を出します。どのようなタイプの事業者にも分かりやすく説明できるコミュニケーション力と、販売事業者社内のブロッカーを把握して課題を解決しきる実行力が必要です。

3. 品揃えの空白を埋める（セラーリクルーティング / セレクション拡充）
法人需要に対して何が足りていないかをデータで特定し、適切な販売事業者・商品を獲得して品揃えを拡充します。新規販売事業者の獲得から立ち上げ、育成までを担います。

4. データ分析に基づくコンサルテーション
販売実績データ、カテゴリー別の売上ランキング等を多角的かつ迅速に分析し、短期・中長期に取るべきアクションを特定して、販売事業者に提案・実行いただきます。

5. 社内外のステークホルダーマネジメント
直接の指揮権がない相手も、データと信頼で動かし、共通のゴールに向けて連携を推進します。

6. 成果の可視化とレポーティング
追うべき成功指標を定義し、進捗を可視化してリーダーシップに報告します。日本および海外のリーダーシップに対して、英語でのレポーティングを行います。


External job description (English)


Amazon Business is a B2B business that delivers new, efficient purchasing solutions to organizations of every size, from individual proprietors to large enterprises. The Amazon Business marketplace (3P) in Japan is growing fast with a large base of participating sellers, yet significant selection gaps remain before business customers can count on finding everything they need on Amazon.


As an Account Manager, your mission is to close those gaps. You will consult with your assigned sellers to grow their sales, identify where selection is missing, and own the recruitment, launch, and development of new sellers. You will design and execute the growth strategy for your area of ownership, partnering across internal teams (B2B customer-facing sales, Retail category, Product, BI, Finance, Legal) and with external partner companies.


The Amazon Business 3P business is organized into segments of different character: established, high-priority growth, and early-stage build. We will determine your segment through the interview process, based on your experience and interests. In every segment, much of the "how" is undefined; you will be expected to form your own hypotheses, set priorities, and validate them with data and the voice of customers and sellers.

Key job responsibilities


- Build the growth strategy for your area of ownership (goals, targets, approach, KPIs) and deliver against annual team and individual goals.

- Execute quickly against that strategy: consult with sellers, explain clearly to any audience, identify blockers inside the seller's organization, and drive issues to resolution.

- Close selection gaps: use data to identify what B2B demand is not being met, then recruit the right sellers and products, and own them from launch through growth.

- Analyze sales performance and category ranking data from multiple angles, identify short- and long-term actions, and drive sellers to adopt them.

- Influence without direct authority, aligning internal and external stakeholders around shared goals.

- Define success metrics, build tracking, and report progress in English to leadership in Japan and abroad.



A day in the life

Amazon では、家族と過ごす時間や、趣味に没頭するなど充実したプライベートの時間を大事にすることは、常に Innovative であり続けるためにとても重要なことと考えます。Amazon セラーサービス事業本部では、出産、育児、介護など、様々なライフステージイベントなどに合わせ、社員が自由な勤務体系を選択できる環境が整備されており、多くの社員がこうした制度を活用しながら活躍しています。（例：フレックスタイム制、産休・育休、時短勤務制度、など）
